--- owner: @esengine backup: @SivanCola status: active reviewed: 2026-10-17 --- # dsh-plugin-reasonix English | [中文](#中文) [Website](https://reasonix.io) · [Documentation](../../docs/DSH.md) · [Source](../../README.md) Use [Reasonix](../../README.md) as a subagent in [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`). The package is configuration only: one patch layer that points Harness's `subagent-acp` provider at `reasonix acp` and exposes it to the model as a `reasonix` tool. It contains no code. ## Before you install 1. Install Reasonix and run `reasonix setup` once on the same machine. Reasonix reads its provider key from its own home, not from environment variables, so Harness cannot pass one. 2. Make sure `reasonix` is on the `PATH` of the process that runs `dsh`. ## Install ```sh dsh plugin --profile add github:esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix#path:/integrations/dsh-plugin ``` The package is not on npm; `pnpm` installs the `integrations/dsh-plugin` subdirectory of this repository (the `path:` selector, see [pnpm package sources](https://pnpm.io/package-sources)). ## After installing: switch it on An installed plugin starts **off**. Open its page in the DSH Web UI and turn the switch on. - The switch and both components must read Running. Turning it on in a running `dsh web` is enough: the next new session has the `reasonix` tool (observed on `dsh` 0.2.1-rc.2). Restart `dsh` only if it is still missing. - While it is off the model may run `reasonix -p` in its own shell. - That looks like a delegation and is not one: there is no subagent, and the permission policy below does not apply. ## What it changes | Row | Effect | | --- | --- | | `subagent-acp-reasonix` | Spawns `reasonix acp` for each delegation; `permission: reject`. | | `tool-subagent-reasonix` | Adds the `reasonix` tool (`prompt`, `description`, optional `cwd`); `maxDepth: provider-managed`, which the provider requires. | ## Permissions - `permission: reject` is the default. Every approval card Reasonix raises is declined, so the child can read and research but cannot write files or run commands that need approval. - `permission: allow` makes Harness accept every card automatically. The delegated task can then do anything Reasonix's tools can do in that workspace. - Change the policy only in your own `cordis.patch.yml`, for a task and workspace you would approve wholesale. Details, what the parent receives, and limits: [Using Reasonix from DeepSeek Harness](../../docs/DSH.md). ## Versions The provider version must equal your `dsh` version. This release pins `dsh` 0.2.1-rc.2. --- ## 中文 [官网](https://reasonix.io) · [文档](../../docs/DSH.md) · [源码](../../README.md) 把 [Reasonix](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix) 作为子智能体接入 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（`dsh`）。本包只有配置，没有代码：一层补丁，让 Harness 的 `subagent-acp` 提供方去启动 `reasonix acp`，并以 `reasonix` 工具的形式暴露给模型。 **安装前** 1. 在同一台机器上安装 Reasonix 并运行一次 `reasonix setup`。Reasonix 只从自己的主目录读取模型密钥，不读环境变量，所以 Harness 无法替它传密钥。 2. 保证运行 `dsh` 的进程的 `PATH` 里有 `reasonix`。 **安装** ```sh dsh plugin --profile add github:esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix#path:/integrations/dsh-plugin ``` 包不在 npm 上：`pnpm` 通过 `path:` 选择器安装本仓库的 `integrations/dsh-plugin` 子目录（见 [pnpm package sources](https://pnpm.io/package-sources)）。 **安装后：打开开关** 插件装好后默认是“关闭”的。到 DSH Web 界面的插件页打开它的开关。 - 开关和两个组件都显示 Running 才算生效。在运行中的 `dsh web` 里直接打开就够了，下一个新会话里就有 `reasonix` 工具（在 `dsh` 0.2.1-rc.2 上实测）；仍然没有再重启 `dsh`。 - 没打开时，模型可能改在自己的 shell 里直接运行 `reasonix -p`。 - 这看起来像委派，其实不是：没有子智能体，下面的权限策略也不起作用。 **权限** - 默认 `permission: reject`：Reasonix 弹出的每个审批卡都会被拒绝，子智能体只能读和调研，不能写文件或执行需要批准的命令。 - `permission: allow` 会让 Harness 自动同意所有审批卡，被委派的任务可以在该工作区里做 Reasonix 工具能做的任何事。 - 只在你自己的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里，为你愿意整体放行的任务和工作区才改成 `allow`。 详细说明见 [Using Reasonix from DeepSeek Harness](../../docs/DSH.md)。 **版本**：提供方版本必须与你的 `dsh` 版本一致，本版本固定为 `dsh` 0.2.1-rc.2。

> [!NOTE] > **DeepSeek-Reasonix-rs is a Rust + Vue + Tauri rewrite adapted from [DeepSeek-Reasonix](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix).** Reasonix is no longer maintained as of 2026-11-12 (final release v2.61.0, MIT-licensed); this rewrite carries it forward.

English  ·  简体中文  ·  Guide  ·  ACP  ·  Extensions  ·  Spec

Open source · MIT · runs on your computer, model of your choice

An open-source coding agent for your terminal, desktop, browser and editor.

It reads your project, edits files and runs commands and tests. Have it ask before each step, or work on its own within limits you set. Files its edit tools changed can be rewound. New here? Start with the Studio desktop app.

Maintained by @1012905. Adapted from Reasonix by Huahui Yu.


## What it is Reasonix is an open-source AI coding assistant. The program runs on your computer; the AI model is a service you configure, which receives what it reads. You describe a task in plain language; it reads code, edits files and runs commands and tests inside the project folder you choose, and shows you each step. You pick the model: a DeepSeek preset is built in, any OpenAI-compatible service is one config entry, and you pay the model provider directly. ## What you get - **Read, edit, run.** It reads code, edits files and runs tests and commands, all inside your project folder. - **Permission levels.** Have it ask every time, or let everyday actions run on their own; your forbid rules always hold. To see the approach first, use plan mode: it starts work only once you approve. - **Rewind.** A file is saved before it changes, so you can rewind by conversation turn without touching your git history. Only files its edit tools changed are covered, not what a shell command did. ## 30-second start Download, add a model key, open a project. New here? Start with the Studio desktop app. 1. Download and install the desktop app, Reasonix Studio, from this repository's [releases](https://github.com/1012905/DeepSeek-Reasonix-rs/releases?q=studio-v&expanded=true) — every `studio-v*` tag packages Studio and the `reasonix` CLI. No tag in this repository yet? [Build from source](#build-from-source). 2. Open it and enter your model provider and key when asked. 3. Open your project folder and write what you want, for example "add retry on failure to the http client". 4. At the level you chose, it stops and asks before anything that needs your say-so. Allow it to continue, or refuse. Prefer a terminal? The release archives carry the `reasonix` CLI beside the Studio packages (or [build it from source](#cli)); run `reasonix setup` to pick a model, then run `reasonix`. See [Install](#install) and [Quick start](#quick-start). ## Four ways to use it - **Desktop app (Studio).** A graphical app; the best place to start. - **Terminal.** A full-screen text interface; `reasonix run "task"` also works in scripts. - **Browser.** `reasonix web` opens a web interface on your own machine. - **Editor.** Install the extension in VS Code; other editors that support ACP (Agent Client Protocol, a common way for an editor to connect to an AI assistant) can connect to `reasonix acp`. All four are the same program underneath. What follows is for advanced users and contributors. ## Use it from DeepSeek Harness DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) can hand a task to Reasonix as a subagent over ACP. This repository publishes a plugin index for it: 1. Run `reasonix setup` on the machine that runs `dsh`. In the DSH Web UI turn on Custom plugin markets (Plugins, More) and add this index in the Discover tab: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/1012905/DeepSeek-Reasonix-rs/studio/integrations/dsh-plugin/market-index.json` 2. Install "Reasonix subagent" from it. 3. Open the plugin's page and turn its switch on. While it is off the model has no `reasonix` tool and may run `reasonix -p` in its own shell, which looks like a delegation and is not one. Setup details, the permission policy and limits are in [Using Reasonix from DeepSeek Harness](./docs/DSH.md). ## Versions Reasonix ships on two lines. See the [version roadmap announcement](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/discussions/10748) for the reasoning behind the split. | Line | Branch | Status | Get it | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | **Reasonix 2.x** | `studio` (this branch) | Active development | [Studio releases](https://github.com/1012905/DeepSeek-Reasonix-rs/releases?q=studio-v&expanded=true) | | **Reasonix 1.x** | [`main-v2`](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/tree/main-v2) | Maintenance / stable | `npm i -g reasonix` · [desktop download](https://reasonix.io/?download=desktop#start) | - **Want something stable?** Stay on 1.x. It keeps receiving bug fixes, provider/API compatibility, updater and security fixes; its core architecture is no longer being extended. - **Want the new architecture?** Use 2.x Reasonix Studio. It is still moving quickly; reports are welcome. Valuable fixes, tests and behaviour from 1.x are reviewed one by one and ported or reimplemented on 2.x where they fit the new architecture. - [Moving from 1.x to 2.x](./docs/MIGRATING.md): what the two lines share, and how to run both on one machine without losing sessions. - [2.x roadmap](./docs/ROADMAP.md): what 2.x still has to deliver, how it ships, and the decisions still open. ## Features Technical highlights for advanced users. - **Config-driven.** Providers, the agent, enabled tools, and plugins are all declared in `reasonix.toml`. No hardcoded models. - **Multi-model & composable.** DeepSeek ships as a preset; any OpenAI-compatible endpoint is a config entry, not new code. Optionally run two models together (executor + planner) in separate, cache-stable sessions. - **Plugin-driven.** MCP servers contribute tools, prompts, and resources; Extension Protocol v1 sidecars can also intercept runtime events, contribute Providers and structured UI, and ship versioned plugin packages. - **Cache-aware context maintenance.** Startup injects a small stable environment summary, stale tool output is snipped/pruned before summary compaction, and the built-in tool schema contract is documented for regression review. - **Zero-friction distribution.** `CGO_ENABLED=0` single binary; cross-compile to six targets with one command. The result is a fully self-contained static binary — nothing to install on the target machine beyond the binary itself. ## Install This branch is **Reasonix 2.x**. Its desktop app is Reasonix Studio; the CLI, Studio, and editor integrations all run the same local Reasonix engine. ### Reasonix Studio (2.x) Download the package for your platform from the latest [Studio release](https://github.com/1012905/DeepSeek-Reasonix-rs/releases?q=studio-v&expanded=true) (tagged `studio-v2.*`; candidates such as `-rc.N` are marked as pre-releases): | Platform | Package | Architecture | | --- | --- | --- | | macOS | `.dmg` or `.zip` | Apple Silicon (`arm64`) / Intel (`amd64`) | | Windows | Installer `-installer.exe` or portable `.zip` | x64 | | Linux | `.deb`, `.rpm`, or `.AppImage` (download only) | x64 (`amd64`) / ARM64 (`arm64`, aarch64) | No `studio-v*` tag has been cut in this repository yet — until the first one, [build from source](#build-from-source). The pipeline that produces these artifacts is [documented](./docs/STUDIO_RELEASE.md). Every package ships with a `.minisig` signature, and the release carries `SHA256SUMS`. Once installed, Studio updates itself in place. The same release also carries the 2.x `reasonix` CLI as archives for `darwin|linux|windows × amd64|arm64`. The npm and Homebrew channels still belong to the upstream 1.x line — this repository's CLI ships as release archives and from source. Publishing to npm or Homebrew from this line is gated behind `STUDIO_PUBLISHES_CLI` and awaits its own endpoints (the npm `reasonix` name and the tap are upstream's). ### Reasonix 1.x (upstream) The 1.x line lives on the upstream repository; its channels install from there on any supported platform, or Homebrew on macOS: ```sh npm i -g reasonix # any OS; pulls the prebuilt native binary brew install esengine/reasonix/reasonix # macOS ``` The 1.x desktop app is on the [official download page](https://reasonix.io/?download=desktop#start). Windows installers are code-signed with a Certum code-signing certificate. ### VS Code extension The extension does not bundle the CLI; it starts your local `reasonix acp` backend and adds native chat, editor context, tool-call approvals, model selection, and workspace sessions. Install the 1.x CLI first. - **VS Code:** [install from Visual Studio Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=SivanLiu.reasonix-agent) - **VSCodium / Eclipse Theia:** [install from Open VSX Registry](https://open-vsx.org/extension/SivanLiu/reasonix-agent) - **Extension ID:** `SivanLiu.reasonix-agent` · [source and usage guide](https://github.com/SivanCola/reasonix-vscode) ### Build from source Clone this repository; `studio` is its only line and builds 2.x (the upstream 1.x line lives on [esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix)): ```sh git clone https://github.com/1012905/DeepSeek-Reasonix-rs.git cd DeepSeek-Reasonix-rs ``` #### CLI The CLI build requires **Go 1.25+**. The module pins a `toolchain` directive; keep `GOTOOLCHAIN=auto` so Go downloads the pinned toolchain, or install it. ```sh make build # -> bin/reasonix(.exe) make cross # -> dist/ (darwin|linux|windows × amd64|arm64) ``` #### Studio Studio additionally requires **Node 24+ and pnpm 10** (`npm install -g pnpm@10`) for the frontend. ```sh make studio ``` See the [Studio build guide](desktop/README.md#prerequisites) for platform webview dependencies and Linux build tags. #### Studio Tauri shell (desktop-tauri) The Tauri shell is the target desktop stack (Rust + Vue) and runs beside the Electron shell during the transition. It needs Node 24+, pnpm 10 and a stable Rust toolchain; on Linux, cargo also needs the Tauri system libraries (`libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev`, `libgtk-3-dev`, `libayatana-appindicator3-dev`, `librsvg2-dev`). ```sh make studio-tauri-test # frontend build + vitest wire-parity witness make studio-tauri-check # cargo check of the Rust shell ``` ## Quick start ### Reasonix Studio Install and launch Studio, then connect a provider and model in the app. No CLI setup is needed. ### CLI / TUI ```sh reasonix setup # configure a provider and model reasonix # start an interactive session reasonix run "implement the TODOs in main.go" ``` In an interactive session, run `/init` when you want Reasonix to create project instructions. For advanced CLI usage and configuration, see the **[CLI reference](./docs/CLI.md)**, **[Guide](./docs/GUIDE.md)**, and **[configuration paths](./docs/CONFIG_PATHS.md)**. ## Documentation - **Getting started:** [Guide](./docs/GUIDE.md) · [CLI reference](./docs/CLI.md) · [Configuration paths](./docs/CONFIG_PATHS.md) · [ACP editor integration](./docs/ACP.md) · [Use from DeepSeek Harness](./docs/DSH.md) - **Features & troubleshooting:** [Subagent profiles](./docs/SUBAGENT_PROFILES.md) · [Context Engine v2](./docs/SESSION_MEMORY_RETRIEVAL.md) · [Capability diagnostics](./docs/CAPABILITY_DIAGNOSTICS.md) · [Recovery and updates](./docs/RECOVERY.md) · [Checkpoints & rewind](./docs/CHECKPOINTS.md) - **Agent presets:** [Session Agent compositions](./docs/AGENT_COMPOSITIONS.md) - **Engineering & migration:** [Spec](./docs/SPEC.md) · [Task contracts & pause policy](./docs/TASK_CONTRACT.md) · [Tool contract](./docs/TOOL_CONTRACT.md) · [Moving from 1.x to 2.x](./docs/MIGRATING.md) · [2.x roadmap](./docs/ROADMAP.md) - **Extension development:** [Skills](./docs/SKILLS.md) · [Extensions](./docs/EXTENSIONS.md) · [Plugin packages and Manifest v1](./docs/PLUGIN_PACKAGES.md) · [Extension Protocol](./docs/EXTENSION_PROTOCOL.md) · [Go SDK and starter](./sdk/go/README.md) ## Star History
## Acknowledgments A small list of folks whose work has shaped Reasonix the most — the current top 20 contributors by commit count. The full contributor graph is on [GitHub](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/graphs/contributors?all=1). | Contributor | Contributor | Contributor | Contributor | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | [**SivanCola**](https://github.com/SivanCola) | [**KHG420**](https://github.com/KHG420) | [**ttmouse**](https://github.com/ttmouse) | [**chuiwenwei**](https://github.com/chuiwenwei) | | [**lifu963**](https://github.com/lifu963) | [**XTLine**](https://github.com/XTLine) | [**HUQIANTAO**](https://github.com/HUQIANTAO) | [**xxoingr**](https://github.com/xxoingr) | | [**Harbor404**](https://github.com/Harbor404) | [**GTC2080**](https://github.com/GTC2080) | [**mchenziyi**](https://github.com/mchenziyi) | [**Li-Charles-One**](https://github.com/Li-Charles-One) | | [**light-front-theory**](https://github.com/light-front-theory) | [**imcreazy**](https://github.com/imcreazy) | [**eghrhegpe**](https://github.com/eghrhegpe) | [**noreply**](https://github.com/noreply) | | [**par73e**](https://github.com/par73e) | [**Bernardxu123**](https://github.com/Bernardxu123) | [**lancy69**](https://github.com/lancy69) | [**Guan0923**](https://github.com/Guan0923) | Special thanks to [**Bernardxu123**](https://github.com/Bernardxu123) for designing the project logo and intro video.

# 赛博鸡蛋查询 · Cyber Egg

> 一个面板，看全你机器上所有能白嫖的积分余额和每日签到状态。
> **只做两件事：查询、手动签到。** 不替你登录，不自动签到，不保存任何凭据。

[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-%E2%89%A50.2.0-4B32C3)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](./LICENSE)

---

## 它是什么

装进 DeepSeek Harness 之后，侧栏多一个图标，点开是一张表：每行一个平台，显示**剩余积分 / 今天签到没有 / 一个手动签到按钮**。

它**不自己发明数字**。每个平台的数值都读自该平台已有的插件或本机 App 自己写下的记录——所以面板上的数和你打开那个 App 看到的数应该一致。

### 明确边界（请先读这段）

| 它做 | 它不做 |
|---|---|
| 读各平台已经存好的余额与签到状态 | ❌ 不弹任何登录/授权界面 |
| 你点「签到」时，调该平台已经存在的签到接口 | ❌ 不自动签到（自动签到交给各插件自己的功能） |
| 展示签到前后余额变化，只有真的涨了才算成功 | ❌ 不保存、不转发任何 token / cookie |
| 记录你自己设的刷新间隔、排序、折叠、隐藏 | ❌ 不改上游账号的任何设置 |

---

## 依赖：装了才有数，没装就空着

**本插件是聚合层，不是数据源。** 下面这些插件是它的数据来源，**缺任何一个只是少几行，不会报错**。
缺哪个插件，面板顶部会给出**一条**汇总提示（不是每行一条），附带安装命令与仓库地址。

| 平台 | 数据来自 | 推荐 |
|---|---|---|
| Loomy · MiniMax Code · Qoder 国际 · Qoder 中国 · Raccoon (商汤) | [`dsh-our-free-model`](https://github.com/Ebony-Vinyl/dsh-our-free-model) 的 channel-pack RPC | ✅ 强烈推荐 |
| **Trae（CN）** | [`dsh-connect-trae`](https://github.com/dingminhua/dsh-connect-trae) 的 `/usage` 文档 | ✅ 推荐（比 channel-pack 多签到状态与厂商包名） |
| WorkBuddy（腾讯 CodeBuddy） | [`dsh-connect-workbuddy`](https://github.com/dingminhua/dsh-connect-workbuddy) | ✅ 推荐 |
| CodeArts（华为云） | [`dsh-codearts`](https://github.com/elegant01/dsh-codearts) | 可选 |
| WPS 灵犀 | 本插件自带（读灵犀桌面端 Cookies，或手填 `wps_sid`） | 可选 |
| MobileClaw（移动云震泽） | 本插件自带（读 App 自己的日志） | 可选 |

三个推荐插件的共同点：它们各自管账号、自动签到、模型接入；**本插件只借用它们已经提供的只读路由**，不重复实现登录。

> 如果你一个都没装，面板会正常打开，但每行都会写着「读取失败」——这是预期行为，不是 bug。

---

## 支持矩阵

「核对」一列说明该平台的数字是否被逐条比对过，而不是"看起来对"。

| 平台 | 剩余积分 | 今日是否签到 | 手动签到 | 核对 | 备注 |
|---|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|---|
| WorkBuddy | ✅ 每账号 | ✅ 账号级 | ✅ **仅当前账号** | ✅ 逐包 | 签到 100/天，30 天有效 |
| Trae（CN） | ✅ | ✅ **账号级** | ✅ | ✅ 逐包 | 签到 100/天，30 天有效；读 `dsh-connect-trae` 的 usage |
| Qoder 国际 / 中国 | ✅ 汇总 | ✅ | ✅ | ⚠️ 仅汇总 | 每日 10:00 刷新；逐包明细接口不提供，走官网 |
| Loomy | ✅ 永久池 + 每日池 | ✅ | ✅ 每日额度初始化 | ✅ 实测 | 每日池 5000，登录后重置 |
| Raccoon (商汤) | ✅ 奖励池 + 每日池 | ✅ 每日池已发放 | — 走网页 | ✅ 流水归纳 | 每日 300，发放后 7 天有效 |
| CodeArts | ✅ 套餐剩余 + 过期日 | ✅ 每日福利 | ✅ | ⚠️ 仅汇总 | 签到 100/天；批次明细走官网 |
| MiniMax Code | ✅ | ✅ 账号级 | ✅ | ✅ 签到 | **有效期未验证** |
| WPS 灵犀 | ✅ 累计智点 | ✅ 连续天数 | ✅ | ⚠️ 未实测 | **有效期未验证**；需灵犀已登录或手填 sid |
| MobileClaw | ✅ token 余额 | ✅ 今日打卡礼是否到账 | — 只读 | ✅ 日志 | 打卡礼 100 万 token/天，30 天有效 |

---

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add github:1015677515/dsh-cyberegg
```

装完刷新页面，侧栏出现「积分」图标。

### 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> remove dsh-cyberegg
```

---

## 使用

- **刷新**：默认每平台 2 小时自动刷一次；每个平台可单独设 15m/30m/1h/2h/4h/6h/手动，也可以只点它自己的「刷新」
- **排序**：拖动平台行
- **折叠**：点平台名折叠该组（折叠的平台不自动刷新，展开时才拉）
- **隐藏**：平台名旁「隐藏」按钮；隐藏后从统计里剔除，底部「已隐藏：…」可恢复
- **签到**：点行尾按钮。**只有签到前后余额真的增加，才显示绿色「已签到」**；上游说领了但余额没动，会显示红色「签到未生效」
- **到期预警**：按「到期日」逐日归并，只统计 3 天内的金额；CodeArts 这种只给汇总额的，单独显示「周期末总共作废 + 到期日」。展开可看每天到期的具体金额
- **近两天历史**：每个平台展开后底部有近两天的总积分变化，用来事后核对
- **平台备注**：每行下面一行小字说明「签到给多少 + 有效期」，无法验证的会明确写「有效期未验证」

---

## 本机路径（灵犀 / MobileClaw 专用）

| 用途 | 路径 |
|---|---|
| 灵犀 Cookies（只读 SQLite） | `%APPDATA%\WPS 灵犀\Cookies`（Windows）/ `~/Library/Application Support/WPS 灵犀/Cookies`（macOS） |
| 手填的 `wps_sid` | `%DSH_HOME%\dsh-cyberegg\lingxi-sid.json` |
| MobileClaw 日志（只读） | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\com.cmss.mobileclaw-desktop\logs\MobileClaw-YYYY-MM-DD.log` |

手填 sid（灵犀没装或 Cookies 加密时）：

```bash
curl -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:<DSH端口>/plugins/dsh-cyberegg/lingxi?action=sid" \
  -H "content-type: application/json" -d "{\"sid\":\"你的wps_sid\"}"
```

清空：`-d '{"sid":""}'`。

---

## 隐私

- 面板里出现的只有**数字**。`wps_sid` 只存在于 Host 半身内存与上面那个 `lingxi-sid.json`（你自己填的），**永远不回传给页面**。
- 不收集遥测，不发任何自建服务器请求。
- 所有网络请求都发往各平台官方域名（`lingxi.wps.cn`、`wps.cn`），或本机 loopback。

---

## 已知限制

1. **不做自动签到**。各平台自己的插件都有自动签到，本插件不重复实现，避免一天内多打一次上游。
2. **MobileClaw 只读**：它的 token 由 App 用 AES-GCM 加密，密钥来自 App 懒加载的 `master.key`，外部拿不到；面板读它日志里的余额快照，所以只有 App 运行过才会更新。
3. **Raccoon 每日积分是网页端发放**，桌面端接口没有该动作，因此按钮直接跳转网页。
4. 平台接口都是各 App 的非公开接口，**上游改版会失效**——失效时该行会显示具体错误码，而不是空白。

---

## 开发

纯 JS，无构建步骤。改 `client.js` 刷新页面生效；改 `index.js`（Host 半身）需要重载插件或重启宿主。

```
index.js           Host 半身：灵犀读 Cookies + 调 lingxi；MobileClaw 读日志；面板底图路由
client.js          浏览器半身：平台表、读取、签到、偏好、到期预警
cordis.patch.yml   bundle 挂载行
locale/*.json      文案
assets/icon.svg    宿主插件列表用的图标
assets/icon-*.png  市场卡片图标（市场只收 GitHub 托管的位图）
assets/cyberegg-mascot.webp  面板右下角的装饰底图（可选，缺失时面板正常显示）
screenshots.json   市场详情页截图清单
```

### 关于底图

面板右下角那张装饰图由 Host 的 `/plugins/dsh-cyberegg/mascot` 路由提供，前端以
`pointer-events: none` + `opacity: 0.5` 渲染在内容层下方，宽度上限是内容列右侧的空白
（`calc((100vw - 1000px) / 2)`），因此不会压住任何账号行，也不会拦截点击。
文件缺失时路由返回 404，页面自动不渲染——不影响其它任何功能。

---

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-knowledge-wiki — DeepSeek Harness 知识库插件

把 Word / PPT / Excel / PDF（文字版与扫描版）/ OFD 版式文档等资料整理成**适合大模型阅读、学习的形式**，
存放在**固定、可命名、可导出、可持续修订**的知识库中；deepseek 通过一组 `kb_*` 工具
随时调用知识库内容进行问答、推理、整理、课件与文档制作等工作。

## 能力

| 工具 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `kb_import` | **只在用户明确要求把资料收进知识库时使用**；只是读取/查看本机文件请用 `kb_read_file`（只读、不入库、不建库）。导入文件或目录（.docx / .doc 自动转换 / .pptx / .xlsx / .xlsm / .pdf / .ofd / .md / .txt / .epub / .mobi / .azw3，扫描版 PDF 与图片型 OFD 自动逐页 OCR 中文，自动识别文字层损坏页并只对问题页 OCR，文字层只剩水印/无文字层的图片页也会自动补 OCR，文字层双栏页自动重排；Word OMML 公式转 LaTeX；Excel 按工作表转 Markdown 表格；.txt 自动识别 UTF-8/UTF-16/GBK；MOBI/AZW3 自动经 Calibre 转 EPUB）。旧版 .doc/.ppt 与 MOBI/AZW3 一律在后台任务中转换；正在导入中的同名文档自动跳过。**导入前自动查重**：同库重合跳过、跨库重合默认跳过并报告；同库同标准号不同年份/阶段（多版本）默认暂停并提示，加 `allowSameNumber: true` 确认后仍可入库（见下文）；标准/书籍正文/封面优先（文件名没有标准号时按封面区取号，通知/附件不参与），其他资料只用文件名；扫描页 OCR 前默认做水印净化（`watermark=auto/off/strong`）；`path` 也可以是 http(s) 链接（网页经 DeepSeek Fetch 转 Markdown，PDF/Office 直链下载后按原管线导入，需宿主配置 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`）；`ocrEngine=deepseek` 时扫描页走云端 OCR（会上传页面图、按页计费，元数据记录页数）；`path` 是 kbpack 包（.zip）时自动路由到 `kb_import_package` |
| `kb_find_sources` | **找资料**（只返回候选，不自动入库）：标准号/标准名优先在标准网检索；公文、规范、文献、教材等走 DeepSeek 网页搜索；可传本机图片（封面/截图），先 OCR 出标准号或标题再搜。候选带来源、权威度、日期与“库内已有”标记；确认后用 `kb_import` 的 `path` 传链接入库。图片 OCR 默认本地，显式 `ocrEngine=deepseek` 才上传云端并计费 |
| `kb_import_package` | 导入 kbpack 知识库包（`kb_export format=zip` 产出的 `.zip`，带 `manifest.json`）：安全校验（坏包/路径穿越/符号链接/版本过高拒绝）、同 id 相同内容幂等跳过、同 id 不同内容另存新 id、同标准号不同 id 走导入查重；同名库**不静默写入**，返回 `merge` / `rename` / `replace` 三选一（replace 需 `confirm:"replace"`），`dryRun=true` 只预演；包内 `*Source=manual` 字段不覆盖目标库人工值 |
| `kb_reparse` | 从库内 `sources/` 重新解析文档（无需重新上传），用于 OCR/解析器升级后刷新旧管线产物；`doc` 单个、`all=true` 批量，支持 `forceOcr`、`forceOcrPages`/`skipOcrPages`、后台任务 |
| `kb_list` | 列出知识库 / 知识库内文档与状态（旧管线/已修订/文字层损坏/OCR 低置信会标注），每条带一行摘要与标签；省略 `kb` 时只列本会话范围内的库；默认最多 50 条，支持 `limit/offset/query/status/kind` 分页过滤（`kind=note` 只看笔记、`kind=source` 只看资料）；本库有维护规范时会提示 |
| `kb_query` | 全文检索（纯文本优先 FTS5/BM25 条款索引，正则/索引不可用时回退 ripgrep；中文短语直接搜；标准号自动兼容 GBT=GB/T=GB_T=GB∕T 与年份分隔符变体）；按标题/标题行/命中密度/更新时间排序，每文档默认 5 条；`kb="*"` 跨库检索；限定模式下省略 `kb` 检索范围内全部库；命中项带 part、页码、条款与笔记类型；**中文提问会按内置中英术语表补充英文检索**（英文提问同理补中文），英文文献也能命中；返回结构化 `sources`（含深链）供界面引用 |
| `kb_read` | 按分块精读、读大纲、读整篇；大纲条目带页码/部分，读取时返回页码范围与结构化 `sources`；支持虚拟页 `doc="schema"`（维护规范）、`doc="index"`（内容索引）、`doc="log"`（操作日志），按 part 分页读取 |
| `kb_read_file` | **只读**读取本机文件（不导入、不建库、不写盘）：docx/doc/pptx/ppt/xlsx/pdf/ofd/epub/mobi/azw3/md/txt；PDF/OFD 扫描页按需 OCR，`pages`/`maxChars` 控制范围；返回临时文本，不是知识库文档 |
| `kb_view` | 查看原始页面图片（PDF 按页渲染；Word/PPT/EPUB/MOBI/OFD 提取内嵌图；OFD 无版式渲染引擎，只能看内嵌图片）——公式、原理图、电路图专用 |
| `kb_edit` | 精确替换修订（持续修改完善）；`doc="schema"` 可修订该库维护规范（index/log 自动维护，不能编辑） |
| `kb_describe` | 给文档写一行摘要与标签（编目）：摘要会显示在 `kb_list` 与 `index.md`，并作为摘要行进入 FTS 索引（只在摘要里的词也能被 `kb_query` 命中），重解析/重导入不会覆盖模型写的摘要；存量文档可 `all=true` + `auto=true` 批量回填缺失摘要（抽取式，不递增版本号，`limit` 分批） |
| `kb_retitle` | 修正标题：单篇传 `doc`（默认按 `cleanTitle` 去掉站点域名、`GB_T`、序号、span 残留等噪声），批量传 `all=true`（默认 `dryRun=true` 只预览，确认后 `dryRun=false` 应用）；加 `standardPrefix=true` 把有标准号的资料统一成「标准号 + 名称」；会重建合并版首行标题、保留历史、版本+1 |
| `kb_trust` | 标注来源可信度：`high`（已发布现行标准、正式教材）/ `medium`（企业文件、培训资料、报批稿）/ `low`（草案、征求意见稿、已废止标准）/ `unknown`（清除）；支持单篇、`docs` 列表、`all=true` + `query`/`stage` 过滤（批量默认 dryRun）。检索会优先高可信、标注低可信并提醒用户 |
| `kb_lint` | 机械体检：导入失败、旧管线、文字层损坏/OCR 低置信、内容重复、同标准号同期同阶段重复、同号多版本、正文完整性/文件名与封面不一致、标题像标准但没解析出标准号、未编目、笔记无来源、续/修订版提示、无入链笔记、临时/锁文件（`~$*`、`.~lock.*`、`Thumbs.db`/`desktop.ini`/`.DS_Store`）、缺 schema；输出分组问题与建议动作（`kb_reparse`/`kb_describe`/`kb_remove`/`kb_edit`）；限定模式下省略 `kb` 逐库体检 |
| `kb_edit_batch` | 批量精确修订（事务语义）：一次提交 1–50 条 `{doc, old_string, new_string, replaceAll?}`，**先全部校验再写入**；任一条失败整批不改并回滚已写分块；`dryRun=true` 只校验。适合“一次改 10–15 页”的跨文档维护；同一文档一批只允许一条编辑 |
| `kb_snapshot` | 库级快照：把 `kb.json`、`schema/index/log`、派生 `markdown/`（可选 `sources/`）打包到知识库 `snapshots/`，用于批量编辑/重解析前留档；`list=true` 列出已有快照 |
| `kb_snapshot_restore` | 从快照恢复：`list=true` 列快照，`snapshot`/`latest` 选择；默认 `dryRun=true` 只预演新增/移除/变更篇数，`dryRun=false` 才写入；恢复前自动留 `before-restore` 快照，`prune=true` 时快照外文档的 markdown/sources 移到 `trash-restore/`；重建索引与 FTS 并写 log |
| `kb_add_note` | 写入编译页/笔记（单篇上限 2MB）：`kind=summary/entity/concept/topic/note`、`tags`、`sources`（docId#页码 或 [[标题]]）；**同一标题再次调用=更新同一篇**（版本+1、保留历史），不要用「续」「修订版」另起新页 |
| `kb_remove` | 删除文档（默认软删除，可用 `kb_restore` 恢复；`soft=false` 永久删除）或整个知识库（删整库需显式 `kb` + `removeKb=true` 且 `confirm` 逐字等于知识库名称） |
| `kb_restore` | 恢复软删除文档（不带 `version`）或恢复历史版本（`version=N`，来自 `kb_history`） |
| `kb_history` | 列出文档保存过的历史版本（覆盖导入/重解析/编辑前的快照，最多 10 个） |
| `kb_export` | 导出 md（单文件）/ jsonl（分块，RAG 用；`chunkSize`/`chunkOverlap` 可切 RAG 小块）/ zip（完整包，内置 JSZip 打包、不依赖系统命令；带 `manifest.json` = kbpack/v1，可被 `kb_import_package` 还原；`docIds` 可只导出选中资料）/ **vault**（Obsidian Vault：`index.md` + `wiki/` 笔记与资料页 + `[[双链]]`，`includeSources=true` 时带 `raw/`） |
| `kb_rename` | 重命名知识库（`kb` 必填，须在本会话范围内） |

大文件（如整本扫描书）导入自动转为**后台任务**，与内置 `job_list` / `job_output` 联动查看进度；
取消后台任务会在 `job_output` 中显示为 cancelled。后台任务会写逐文件统计：
**只要有文件失败，任务状态就是 `failed`（详情写明“部分失败：成功 X，失败 Y”）**，不再把部分失败显示成完成。
长任务每 60 秒刷新一次 `heartbeatAt`（不改文档 `updatedAt`）；进程崩溃后，残留的 `.lock`
带 owner PID，下一个操作可在 PID 消失且锁超过 60 秒时快速回收，不必等满 30 分钟。

**旧版 .doc 自动转换**：Windows 用本机 Microsoft Word（COM 自动化，无对话框、禁宏）；
macOS 用自带 `textutil`；Linux 可用 LibreOffice。未装任何转换工具时会给出明确提示。

## 知识库存储结构（默认 `~/.dsh/knowledge/<知识库名>/`）

```
kb.json                    清单：文档列表（id/标题/类型/页数/大纲/版本/状态/
                           sha256/解析管线版本/contentSource/OCR 元数据/
                           summary·tags·笔记 kind/sources/linksOut）
schema.md                  维护规范（每库可定制；建库导入时写入模板）
index.md                   内容索引（清单自动渲染：笔记在前、资料在后，每条一行摘要）
log.md                     操作流水（只追加：ingest/edit/note/describe/remove/restore…）
sources/<docId><ext>       原始文件（逐字节保留）
markdown/<docId>/<docId>.md   合并版（整篇通读）
markdown/<docId>/parts/NNNN.md 分块版（检索、精读、RAG）
markdown/<docId>/parts/index.json 分块索引（合并版行号 → part/页码）
markdown/<docId>/pages.json   逐页质量（文字层/OCR、损坏标记、置信度）
exports/                   导出产物
```

- **知识库名称**：`kb_import` 的 `kb` 参数决定（可含中文），不存在即创建。
- **持续修改**：同名文件且内容未变 = **跳过不重跑**（返回 `skippedUnchanged`）；内容变化
  或 `forceReparse`/`kb_reparse` 时原位更新（版本号 +1）。`kb_edit` 精确替换并标记
  `edited=true`；`kb_add_note` 写编译页（同标题再次调用=更新该笔记）。清单会记录每个文档的 `sourcePath`：**同一路径**重复导入是原位更新，
  不同目录下的同名文件（如 `A/通知.pdf` 与 `B/通知.pdf`）会另建文档，不会互相覆盖。
  旧版本清单没有 `sourcePath` 的条目无法追溯来源，首次重导仍按原位更新，并在导入结果的
  warnings 里提示一次；担心覆盖时请先备份或导入到新库，重导一次后就会记录来源路径。
- **导出**：md 适合直接上传对话类产品（目录带摘要，笔记带 YAML frontmatter）；jsonl 适合 RAG 管道；
  zip 是完整可迁移包（含 README、`index.md`/`schema.md`/`log.md` 与全部 markdown，
  `includeSources=true` 时含原始文件）。
  zip 用 `generateNodeStream` **流式写盘**，不会把整包（含原始文件）先读进内存；
  导出清单剥离本机 `sourcePath`，失败条目整条略过。

## 知识库工作台（0.20.4）

插件在 web profile 下提供 `/kb/` 工作台（可通过配置 `uiEnabled: false` 关闭）：

- 总览：库卡片、简介、文档/笔记/页数/字数、类型与可信度分布；
- 新建知识库、编辑简介/标签、重命名、归档（含非空库，移动到 `.trash/`）；
- 回收站：列出归档库，支持恢复（原名冲突时可改名恢复）与彻底删除（需逐字输入库名确认，删除后磁盘文件不可恢复）；
- 库详情：概览 / 资料 / 笔记 / 日志 / 设置 / 标准更新；
- API：`GET /kb/api/status|kbs|kbs/:name|kbs/:name/docs|...`。

打开方式：在浏览器访问 `http://127.0.0.1:<dsh-web-port>/kb/`（端口见 `dsh web` 启动行）。

工作台支持直接在浏览器里上传资料：选文件 / 选目录 / 拖拽文件 → 逐个上传（并发 2）→ 后台导入；
目标库可在上传前切换；导入标题自动按 `cleanTitle` 去掉站点域名、`GB_T`/序号等噪声；逐文件进度与报告可见，
失败可重试。扫描件可选 OCR 精度（best 更准 / fast 更快）与「强制 OCR」（文字层损坏时）。批次临时目录在
导入成功后删除、失败保留 24 小时供排查（过期批次在新建批次时清扫）。单文件与单批次上限见配置
`uiMaxUploadBytes` / `uiMaxBatchFiles`。

- 上传/导入会自动跳过 Office 所有者文件（`~$…`）、LibreOffice 锁文件（`.~lock.…`）与
  `Thumbs.db` / `desktop.ini` / `.DS_Store` 等系统垃圾文件，并在上传面板与导入结果里报告
  「已跳过 N 个临时/锁文件」；普通 `.tmp` 文件不跳过。

概览页/库详情页「导入知识库包」：选择 `.zip` 上传后先预检（同名库返回 merge/rename/replace 三选一），
确认后后台导入；大包可点「选择本机文件…」调用宿主原生文件对话框，直接取本机 `.zip` 绝对路径
（不经过 HTTP 上传，也不需要手输路径；宿主无法打开原生对话框时仍可手输路径）；
「导出知识库」支持正文包 / 完整包 / Markdown，后台生成后在弹窗内下载；下载有百分比与
已下载/总大小进度（大文件由浏览器原生下载接管时会明确提示）。

「标准更新」面板（库详情 tab）：读取 `.std-check.json` 的上次检查时间、缓存有效期（TTL 7 天）
与待下载数（有新版 / 草案转正 / 可补下载）；支持仅检查 / 检查并下载 / 补下载 / 强制全查 / 本轮上限，运行中可取消（当前正在处理的标准完成后停止，之后不再发起新的下载）；新增「按标准号补下载」：输入编号先检索并校验站点确认页（防串档）与金币，确认后再下载并导入；
下载前必须勾选金币确认（每个标准约 6 金币，VIP 免金币）；`bzCookie` 只在状态里显示“已配置 / 未配置”，
不会回传给浏览器。

当前版本仍不支持合并知识库；后续版本再加入。

### 实现偏差 / 已知限制（0.20.4–0.22.0）

- 拖拽只接收**文件**，不做拖拽文件夹递归；整理整个目录请用「选择目录」。
- 资料列表沿用按标题排序，不支持按更新时间排序；导入完成在弹窗内直接给出逐文件结果。
- 失败批次仅用于排查：没有删除或重试**失败批次**的 API（`DELETE` 只接受未开始导入的 open 批次），
  目录保留至清扫；重试是客户端用本地失败文件重新上传。
- 批次 24 小时过期由「创建批次」触发清扫（create-triggered），不是后台定时任务。
- `refreshKbIndex` 仍留在 `lib/import-job.js` 的导入收尾里，尚未拆成独立模块。
- UI 没有真实浏览器 DOM 测试：资料工具栏（搜索防抖/输入法/跳页/清除/焦点）用 fake DOM 单测
  （`test/ui-docs-controls.test.mjs`），胶囊用 `node:vm` 跑 `lib/client.js`；样式、真实焦点顺序与
  布局仍需手工验收，另有 `scripts/check-ui.mjs` 的语法门禁。
- 范围只约束 `kb_*` 工具：工作台 HTTP API 与 UI 不受范围影响（范围不是权限边界）。
- `kb_edit_batch` / `kb_add_note` 为单库策略：范围有多库时必须显式 `kb`，不做跨库事务。
- 切换范围会改写一次 system prompt 前缀（同一范围下前缀稳定）；范围变更在下一轮模型步生效。
- `restoreKb` / `removeKbDir` 未做范围同步；失效库名由读取时清理（prune）兜底。
- 胶囊只注册在 `conversation.input.left`；`conversation.session.header.utilities` 未接入。

## 0.25.0 回收站增强与 CI

回收站的已删除资料支持跨库批量彻底删除、搜索与排序，并可按天自动过期清理；仓库新增 GitHub Actions，
跑单元/构建门禁与真实浏览器 E2E。

### 跨库批量彻底删除

- 「已删除资料」多选不再限制同一个库：勾选来自不同库的条目后仍可点 **彻底删除所选**。确认弹窗要求逐字输入
  **`彻底删除 N 篇`**（N 为去重后的篇数）；有重复条目时按勾选数输入也接受。服务端做同样校验，不一致回
  `400 CONFIRM_REQUIRED`。
- 行内单篇彻底删除仍走本库接口，逐字输入 **库名** 确认；资料页「清空本库已删除资料」同样输入库名。本库单篇/清空
  与跨库批量一样在清单锁内复验已删除状态（`requireDeleted`）。
- 删除前对**全部条目做只读预检**：库不存在/已归档（原目录不在活跃库中）、资料不存在或不在回收站（例如在用资料）都会
  **整批拒绝**（`409 KB_NOT_FOUND` / `409 DOC_NOT_DELETED`，`details` 带首个问题条目），合法条目也不会被提前删掉。
- 逐篇删除都在清单锁内**复验仍在回收站**：预检后到真正删除前被恢复（或重新进入导入）的条目拒绝删除，按
  「彻底删除失败：文档已不在回收站」计入 `failed` 并继续；不会因为并发恢复回 500。
- 预检通过后逐篇 `removeDoc(..., { requireDeleted: true })`；单篇失败不中断其余条目，返回 `{purged, failed, byKb}`，失败项只带库、标题与固定文案
  「彻底删除失败」，不跨 API 回传本机路径。每篇写所属库日志 `remove`（detail「彻底删除（跨库批量）」），
  每个受影响库刷新一次 `index.md`；日志/索引是附属写入，失败不会回滚已完成的永久删除。
- 单次最多 **500 篇**；`items` 为空、缺 `kb`/`id`、超过上限都是 `400 INVALID_ARGS`。请求仍要求工作台写头与同源。
- HTTP：`POST /kb/api/trash/docs/purge`，body `{items:[{kb,id}], confirm}`。

### 搜索与排序

- 「已删除资料」工具条新增搜索：对**库名、标题、类型、来源文件**做大小写不敏感子串匹配；输入 **300ms 防抖**，
  `Enter` 立即搜索；输入法组合期间不发中间请求，`compositionend` 后立即应用并恢复焦点。
- 排序下拉：**删除时间（新→旧）**（默认）/ **删除时间（旧→新）** / **标题 A→Z** / **标题 Z→A** /
  **库名 A→Z** / **库名 Z→A**。切换排序立即请求并清空当前选择；未知/非法 `sort` 回落默认值，响应回显解析后的 `sort`。
- 过滤和排序在截断前对全量已删除资料执行：`total` 是命中总数，列表最多 **500** 篇，超出时显示「仅显示前 500 篇」。
- 搜索命中 0 篇显示「没有匹配的已删除资料」并提供 **清除搜索**；回收站本来为空则显示「没有已删除的资料」。
- 排序稳定性：删除时间相同或标题/库名相同时按「库名 + id」兜底；`deletedAt` 缺失/非法的行始终排在最后。
- HTTP：`GET /kb/api/trash/docs?query=&sort=`，响应额外返回归一化后的 `query` 与 `sort`。

### 自动过期清理

- 新配置 `trashRetentionDays`：默认 `0`（关闭），允许 **0–3650** 天。配置为 N 后，**工作台启动时**与
  **访问回收站时**（同一 `kbRoot` 每小时最多扫描一次，进程内节流）永久删除 `deletedAt` 超过 N 天的普通
  软删除资料。
- **跳过跨库移动留下的源库墓碑**（带 `movedTo` 的行）：撤销移动还要依赖它，即使过期也不自动清理，只能手动处理。
- 只扫描活跃（非归档、非合并）库；`deletedAt` 缺失或**不是 ISO 日期时间**（`YYYY-MM-DDTHH...`）的行无法判断年龄，
  跳过并计入 `skipped`；单篇删除失败（含锁内复验时已被恢复/重新导入）也计入 `skipped` 并继续处理其余条目。
- **单轮最多清理 500 篇**：达到上限即停止，返回 `capped=true`（表示可能还有未处理条目）；`byKb` 只统计实际删除的条目。
- 删除调用同样传 `requireDeleted: true`，锁内复验已删除状态；重新导入已软删除资料时 `markImporting` 会清除
  `deletedAt`/`deletedFromStatus`，导入期间不会被回收站列表、自动清理或批量彻底删除选中。
- 每篇写日志 `remove`（detail「自动清理（超过 N 天）」），有变动的库刷新一次 `index.md`；清理失败不影响工作台启动与
  回收站列举。目前只有配置入口，没有 UI 开关，也不是后台定时任务。

### CI / E2E

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` 两个 job：
  - `unit`（ubuntu-latest）：`npm ci` → `npm run typecheck` → `npm test`。
  - `e2e`（macos-14，手动）：安装 `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2` → 用临时 `DSH_HOME` 首次启动 `dsh web` 生成 profile →
    用 `install-to-machine.sh` 注册本仓库 → 安装 Playwright WebKit → 跑 `npm run test:e2e`；失败时上传
    `test/e2e/.artifacts`（目录以 `.` 开头，workflow 用 `include-hidden-files: true` 才会收集）。
  - `e2e-windows`（自托管 Windows，手动 `run_e2e_windows=true`）：`dsh.cmd` + Chromium，
    跑同一套件；需 runner 有可用 profile。
- 全新 CI profile 没有历史会话/模型凭据：胶囊用例自动 **skip** 并说明原因；工作台/回收站/搜索排序/移动/重试/预览用例
  照常执行，其余失败仍会让 job 红。
- 本地有真实 profile 与凭据时跑完整套件（当前 12 项；来源面板在 CLI 0.1.x 会 skip）；CI 为核心用例通过 + 胶囊/来源面板按宿主 skip（Office 可选预览在无转换引擎时也会 skip）。
- E2E 宿主兼容两种 profile 布局：优先 profile 自带 `node_modules`，否则使用 `profiles/node_modules` 共享目录；
  全新 CI profile 缺 `pnpm-lock.yaml` / `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 时跳过，不再启动失败。

### 已知限制（0.25.0）

- 自动清理对跨库移动墓碑不生效（`movedTo` 还要用于撤销移动），需要手动彻底删除；撤销移动后墓碑消失，才会进入普通清理范围。
- 跨库批量彻底删除仍逐篇调用 `removeDoc`，不是多库事务；单篇失败保留在 `failed` 里，需要人工重试。
- E2E 胶囊用例在全新 profile（无历史会话/模型凭据）自动 skip，CI 不覆盖胶囊交互。
- Chromium 下载在部分网络/CDN 不可用；E2E 套件优先 WebKit，只装 WebKit 也能跑。

## 0.26.0 资料元数据、摄取规范化与引用溯源

**人工编目与标签筛选**：工作台资料弹窗可直接编辑**标题、摘要与标签**，保存走
`PATCH /kb/api/kbs/:name/docs/:id/metadata`，服务端把 `summarySource` 标为 `manual`；
人工标题写 `titleSource=manual`，重新导入/重解析也不会被自动标题覆盖。人工摘要不会被
重新导入/重解析降级（优先级 manual > model > auto）。资料页新增标签下拉与
行内标签按钮，支持 `GET /docs?tag=` 筛选和 `facets.tags` 计数。

**摄取元数据**：导入时保存 `rawTitle/canonicalTitle/standardNo/Year/Part/Stage`、
`sourceHash`、`textHash`、`contentIntegrity`、`trust` 启发式与 `trustSource`。
标准/书籍允许**正文/封面优先**：文件名写 `GB`、封面写 `GB/T` 时按封面处理；但必须同时比较
正文完整性，封面完好、正文缺失（`cover-only/partial`）不会被当成完整版本。
其他资料（通知、台账、图纸、普通 md/txt/note）只用文件名/标题，不做正文优先。

**去重**：`sourceHash + 标准号+年+部分+阶段 + textHash + 标题 key`；同号不同阶段
（征求意见/报批/发布）不算重复。完整版不会被残缺版挡住，残缺版也不会覆盖完整版。
旧库可用回填脚本补齐身份元数据：

```bash
node scripts/backfill-doc-meta.mjs --root ~/.dsh/knowledge --kb 标准 --dry-run --hash --std --content --text
node scripts/backfill-doc-meta.mjs --root ~/.dsh/knowledge --kb 标准 --apply --hash --std --content --text
node scripts/backfill-doc-meta.mjs --root ~/.dsh/knowledge --kb 标准 --dry-run --retitle
node scripts/backfill-doc-meta.mjs --root ~/.dsh/knowledge --kb 标准 --dry-run --normalize-titles
node scripts/tag-doc-library.mjs --root ~/.dsh/knowledge --kb 标准 --dry-run
```

`--retitle` 只改明显格式噪声；`--normalize-titles` 处理书名号/括注标准号/裸标准号标题，
按「标准号 名称」重排，保留报批稿/征求意见稿并清理“上传版(1)”等后缀。
真实「标准」库（911 篇）已回填：911 篇 ready、904 篇有来源；结构化标准号 850 篇、
正文元数据 860 篇，标题规范化覆盖全部 904 篇来源文档，**裸标准号 0**（本轮从 254 篇补到 0；含 84 篇封面/首屏、47 篇 PDF 字号、40 篇英文 IEC/EN 封面，其余按系列/已知名称补全）；
历史 11 组同号重复未保留项和 1 篇发布通知已由用户彻底删除；当前 0 篇 deleted。

`DL/T 587-2025 继电保护和安全自动装置运行管理规程`；`GB 19963.2-2024` 与
`GB/T 19963.2-2024 …` 已用同族完整标题补全，便于人眼区分。

**标签**：`scripts/tag-doc-library.mjs` 按标准前缀标「国家标准/行业标准/企业标准/团体标准/

  原来的「旧版年份 < 站点年份」条件不成立，草案会继续保持原可信度。现在按 `kind=draft` 一并收敛为 `low`，
  人工标注（`trustSource=manual`）仍不覆盖。
- 实测（真实站点）：DL/T 401-2017、DL/T 1412-2015 入库自动 `high`；旧版 401-2002 与 1412 征求意见稿自动 `low`。

测试 1474 → **1475**（1471 通过、4 跳过）。

## 0.41.3 标准更新：继任多跳与按号重搜（2026-11-06）

- **废止记录不再停在旧版**：命中记录标「废止/作废」时沿「被 X 代替」逐跳追继任版本（最多 3 跳），
  修掉 `GB/T 10228-2008 → 2015 → 2023` 这类链式替代只追一跳、把 2023 漏掉的漏检。
- **按标准号重搜兜底**：大量老标准页只写「代替 DL 401-1991」、完全不提自己被谁取代，
  继任线索为空时用裸标准号重搜，取同号里年份最高的一条（`DL/T 401-2002 → DL/T 401-2017` 由此命中）。
- **自动可信度**：下载并导入的「站点现行版」自动标 `high`（trustSource=heuristic）；
  被它替代的库内同号旧版收敛 `low`（含年份相同的草案/征求意见稿）；继任正文尚未入库时旧版只降 `medium`（待补）；
  人工标注（`trustSource=manual`）不被自动收敛覆盖。
- 真实站点验证：两条历史漏检（GB/T 10228-2023、DL/T 401-2017）均判 `update` 并带 `replacedBy`。

测试 1471 → **1474**（1470 通过、4 跳过）。

## 0.41.2 重复跳过误标与标题重复标准号（2026-11-04）

- **「导入中跳过」误标修复**：工作台把导入结果写到任务记录时丢掉了逐文件 `reason`，同一标准
  已在库内时会显示成「导入中跳过」并提示「可稍后重试」——重试永远失败。现在透传
  `reason/stage/docId`：重复跳过显示「重复跳过」并注明「与库内资料重复」，跳过汇总按原因拆分
  （重合 → 如需以本次文件替换请先移除库内旧文档；导入中 → 等当前导入完成；未知原因 → 可稍后重试）。
- **文件名冒号标准号导致标题双编号**：下载站/文件系统把 `/` 换成 `:` 的写法（`GB:T 47968-2026 …pdf`）
  以前解析不到标准号，解析封面拿到 `GB/T 47968-2026` 后又补了一次前缀，标题会变成
  「GB/T 47968-2026 GB:T 47968-2026 构网型变流器通用技术规范」。现在 `GB:T/GB：T`、`Q:GDW`、
  `T:CEC` 归一为 `GB/T`、`Q/GDW`、`T/CEC`；`withStandardPrefix` 容错剥除 `GB T / GB-T / GB∕T /
  Q GDW / GBT` 等变体并循环去重（幂等，保留 `DL 860.803-202X` 这类「编号+年份」写法）。文件名能
  解析出编号后，导入前的重合预检也一并生效，不再先跑完解析才判重合。
- **改名后分块首行注释同步**：`kb_retitle` 原先只重建合并版 H1，分块里 `<!-- doc: 旧标题 | … -->`
  仍是旧标题（`kb_read` / 导出可见）。`rebuildMerged` 现在同步这一行。
- **弹窗标题不再重复拼库名**：`解析完成 · 标准 · 标准` → `解析完成 · 标准`。
- **同批未发布修复**（0.41.1 之后）：空白页罗马数字识别、重解析摘要不被封面噪声覆盖、
  质量任务轮询容错，详见「0.39.2」段。
- **数据修复（标准库，已执行）**：`GB/T 47968-2026 构网型变流器通用技术规范` 标题去重，另清理
  9 篇同类双编号标题（`T/SZUAVIA 003-2023`、`Q/GDW 515.2-2010`、`GB/T 34129-2017`、
  `GB/T 7252-2001`、`GB/T 24846-2018`、`GB/T 33348-2024` 等），每篇保留历史版本。
- 新增回归：标题归一化与重复编号幂等、跳过文案、`reason` 透传、分块注释同步。
- 测试 **1471**（1467 通过、4 跳过）；`npm run typecheck` 与客户端 bundle 检查通过。

## 0.41.1 旧版 Office 预览修复与导出下载进度（2026-11-04）

- **旧版 .doc/.xls/.ppt 预览修复**：网页下载的旧 Office 文件常见两类「Word 能打开、转换引擎拒绝」：
  下载被截断（OLE 复合文档末尾少几十到几百字节，报 `invalid or truncated compound-file header`）、
  以及把 `.docx` 直接改名成 `.doc`（内容是 zip，却按 OLE 解析）。预览前现在会自动生成一份临时副本：
  尾部补零到扇区边界、按 zip 目录换成正确的 `.docx/.xlsx/.pptx` 扩展名，再交给 LibreOfficeKit；
  **原件不改动**，转换结束删除副本，缓存键仍按原件的 mtime+size。本机 8 份失败文件（公文 2、标准 4、
  电能质量 1、变电试验 1）全部恢复预览。
- **预览失败不再是一片空白**：`preview.pdf` 在 `Accept: text/html`（iframe）下返回可读的错误页，
  带错误码、原因提示与「下载原件」入口；API/JSON 调用方仍收到原来的 `PREVIEW_FAILED`。
  超时单独映射 `PREVIEW_TIMEOUT`，转换引擎失败把错误码与 stderr 尾部写进宿主日志（不回传浏览器）。
- **导出包下载进度条**：导出完成后点「下载文件」不再直接 `<a download>`：
  - 小文件（≤384 MB）用 `fetch` + ReadableStream 边读边报进度，完成后保存；
  - 大文件且宿主支持 File System Access（Chromium/Electron）时先选保存位置，响应流直接写盘，
    不占内存；
  - 大文件且不支持时退回浏览器原生下载，并明确提示「已交给浏览器下载」而不伪造进度。
  下载中显示百分比与已下载/总大小，完成显示「下载完成」，失败可重试。
- **取消上传/导入/导出的残留收敛**：取消包上传会中止 XHR 并删除临时包（新增
  `DELETE /packages/:id`，导入任务运行中时拒绝）；工作台导出改为先写 `exports/.tmp-*`
  再原子改名，导出失败/进程中断不会留下可下载的半截包，下轮导出清理超过 24h 的临时文件。
- 新增回归：`web-preview.test.mjs` 4 个（补零 / 改扩展名 / 真实转换入参 / 错误页）、
  `download-progress.test.mjs` 5 个（进度口径、流式读取、小文件、大文件写盘、原生下载回退）、
  `web-package.test.mjs` 1 个（取消后删除临时包）、`web-export.test.mjs` 原子改名断言、
  `ui-kb-visibility.test.mjs` 4 个（空 default / 范围收敛）与 `update-check.test.mjs` 5 个
  （版本比较 / 兼容范围 / 网络失败 / 报告）。
- 测试 **1465**（1461 通过、4 跳过）；`npm run typecheck` 与客户端 bundle 检查通过。
- **空 default 不再出现在会话范围选择器**：工作台早已隐藏空 `default` 库，但输入框旁的选择器
  仍从 `/kbs` 原样列出。现在两处共用 `ui/kb-visibility.js`：空 `default` 隐藏，其它空库保留，
  `default` 一旦有资料/笔记/回收站内容就恢复显示；范围选择器的「全选/应用」也不会再带入它。
- **新增 `scripts/update-check.mjs`**：检查本机 DSH（macOS 读 App Info.plist，其它平台回退
  `dsh --version`，可用 `--dsh-version` 覆盖）、npm `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 的 latest/next、GitHub `main`
  上插件的版本与 `peerDependencies` 范围；需要动作时退出码 10 并弹 macOS 通知。报告写到
  `docs/reports/update-check-YYYYMMDD.md`，支持 `--json` / `--no-report` / `--no-notify`。
  推荐在 DSH 自动化里每周执行：
  `node scripts/update-check.mjs --reports-dir ~/.dsh/reports`，提示词只要求它在有动作时汇报。
- **两个定时任务放哪里**：调度放 DSH 自动化 / 系统计划任务，插件只提供被调用的工具与脚本，
  不要在插件里 `setInterval`（插件随宿主加载卸载、退出后不跑，多会话还可能重复）。
  - 标准检查：DSH 自动化里定时调用 `kb_std_check`（默认已带 7 天增量缓存、限速与金币保护）；
    需要 DSH 不开也跑时，用系统计划任务执行 `scripts/std-check-daily.mjs`
    （macOS 模板 `scripts/com.dsh.kb-std-check.plist.example`，Windows 用「任务计划程序」）。
  - DSH/插件升级检查：必须放在宿主之外（自动化/脚本），因为要判断的正是宿主版本；
    插件进程无法在宿主升级后继续运行。建议每周执行一次：`dsh --version`、
    `npm view @deepseek-ai/dsh dist-tags --json`，再对照插件 `package.json` 的
    `version` 与 `peerDependencies` 范围；越界时先跑 `npm test` 回归再升级。

## 0.41.0 弹窗支持拖边框调大小（2026-11-03）

- **三处弹窗可调大小**：知识库工作台（宿主内弹窗）、聊天回答里点来源卡片打开的原件预览、
  工作台内「查看原件」预览；上下左右 + 四角共八个方向，拖哪条边只动哪条边。
- **尺寸记忆**：松手把宽高写进 `localStorage`（`dsh-kb:size:workbench` / `dsh-kb:size:preview`），
  下次打开按记忆尺寸居中恢复，并按当前视口重新夹取；最小 640×420（工作台）/ 480×360（预览）。
- **不破坏「点外部关闭」**：把手挂在遮罩上、贴在弹窗**外侧**，`pointerdown` 阻止冒泡并阻止兼容
  `mousedown`；拖拽用 pointer capture，拖动期间暂停 iframe 的 `pointer-events`；松手后吞掉紧随的一次
  `click`（按下在把手、松开在遮罩时 click 会落到两者公共祖先＝遮罩，这样也不会误关）。
  拖拽中按 Esc 只结束拖拽，不关弹窗。
- **预览正文自适应**：调整过尺寸的原件预览改由弹窗高度驱动正文（没调过仍是原来的 70vh），
  iframe / 图片 / 文本不再溢出。
- 实现：新增 `ui/resize-geometry.js`（纯几何、可单测）与 `ui/resizable.js`（DOM 绑定 + 尺寸记忆），
  客户端 bundle 与零构建工作台共用同一份；补 `ui-resize.test.mjs` 与 E2E「弹窗拖拽调大小」。
- 测试 **1444**（1440 通过、4 跳过）；`npm run typecheck` 通过；E2E **18 passed / 1 skipped**
  （skip 为宿主未投影 tool/result meta 的既有用例）。详见 `docs/reports/2026-11-03-modal-resize.md`。

## 0.40.0 引用去重、读取/导入分离与中英跨语言检索（2026-11-03）

- **引用资料按文档去重**：同一篇资料在一条回答里命中多个页/条款时，聊天末尾的「本轮来源」与工具行来源卡片只保留一张；卡片展示合并后的「第 N、M 页 / 条款」，点击跳第一条命中位置。
- **读取 ≠ 导入**：新增只读工具 `kb_read_file`（`readOnly: true`，不建库、不写盘），用于用户只想读取/分析本机文件；`kb_import` 与系统提示明确要求仅在用户明确同意入库时使用，避免读取本地资料时自动建库。
- **中英跨语言检索**：`kb_query` 对中文提问自动用内置中英术语表补充英文检索（英文提问同理补中文），影子检索只落在另一语言的文档上；术语表覆盖电力系统、电能质量、电磁兼容与标准文本常用词，长尾术语由 agent 翻译后补查。
- **工作台知识库包导入**：新增「选择本机文件…」按钮，调用宿主原生文件选择器直接取得本机 `.zip` 绝对路径（macOS `osascript` / Windows PowerShell 文件对话框 / Linux `zenity`→`kdialog` 回退）；大包不经过 HTTP 上传，也不需要手输路径；宿主无法打开对话框时保留手输路径兜底。
- **页数显示**：Word/Excel/EPUB/TXT 等没有固定页码的格式，资料列表与详情显示「—」而不是误导性的 `0`；PDF/OFD 仍显示实际页数。
- 新增回归：`bilingual.test.mjs`、`kb-read-file.test.mjs`、`bilingual-search.test.mjs`、`file-picker.test.mjs`。

## 0.38.0 数据目录可配置（2026-11-02）

- **工作台「数据目录」**：侧栏新增入口，查看当前知识库根目录（kbRoot）、填写新目录或恢复默认；
  支持 `~` 开头路径，保存前校验绝对路径与可写性。只切换目录，**不移动、不删除**旧目录里的资料。
- **持久化**：保存到 `$DSH_HOME/

# @automagik/acp-dsh

Agents other than DSH's own, as DeepSeek Harness models, over the
[Agent Client Protocol](https://agentclientprotocol.com) (ACP). The design is
[RFC 0003](../../docs/rfcs/0003-model-routes-and-acp.md).

- **Agents as DSH models.** Each agent is a provider route (`acp-<agent>`) whose models are the
  agent's own (Claude Code's Opus, Sonnet, Haiku…; Codex's GPT models), each with the reasoning
  efforts the agent offers for it. A chat or a Bot picks one like any model. DSH keeps the
  Session, its history and the sidebar.
- **The agent's own models and efforts.** They are read from the agent over ACP: its session
  config options of category `model` and `thought_level`. A probe starts the adapter, opens a
  session it never prompts (no turn, no tokens), reads the models, then picks each one to read
  its efforts, since an agent rebuilds that list per model. The result is kept in
  `$AUTOMAGIK_HOME/acp/catalog/<route>.json`, so the next start lists it at once while a new probe
  runs; a new adapter release probes again. Before any probe has answered, a short list stands
  in (Claude Code: `default`, `opus`, `sonnet`, `haiku` at low, medium or high effort; Codex:
  `default`). The model `default` is always listed: it is whatever the agent's own settings
  choose. An effort's default is the person's own setting for that model.
- **The Session's model and effort, before each prompt.** The agent's session is put on the
  Session's model, then its effort (the model first: the efforts are that model's). No effort
  leaves the agent's own. A model or effort the agent does not offer fails the turn, naming what
  it offers.
- **DSH tool cards and approvals.** With `dshTools` off (the kill switch), the agent runs its own
  tools. Each tool call it makes ends the model step with a call to `acp_tool`, a tool registered
  in that agent's scope only. DSH writes the `tool/call` and `tool/result` rows and draws the
  card (a terminal for a command, a diff for an edit, the generic card otherwise). When the agent
  asks permission for the call, `acp_tool` asks DSH's approval service
  (`approval/asked`, `approval/decided`) and gives the agent DSH's answer. On DSH's Auto
  review level that answer is the review. A call the reviewer allowed, or that the person
  allowed in the dialog the reviewer raised, gets `allow_once` for the agent's first question
  about it, with no second dialog; this holds in a subagent child too. These still ask as before:
  a later question, a call the agent changed after its review (in its question or after it), an
  agent that offers no `allow_once`, and a level that changed since the call.
- **DSH's own tools over the bridge (`dshTools`).** On, the agent gets the Session's preset tool
  set (standard, or cordis in creator mode) over one stdio MCP server per ACP session, named
  `dsh` and spawned by the adapter with that session's arguments. The bridge has no port; it
  reaches this plugin over a loopback back-channel with a per-session credential
  (`DSH_BRIDGE_CREDENTIAL`), which binds a request to its Session and is revoked with the
  bridge. Every DSH tool call is approved in DSH under the Session's level before it runs,
  whatever the agent's own allow rules or hooks say, and the bridge writes the `tool/call` and
  `tool/result` rows the chat shows. `acp-claude` runs with its built-in tools off
  (`_meta.disableBuiltInTools`); a structured call that is not an MCP name is recorded as
  `plugin:acp-dsh/toolset-drift` and its turn is cancelled — the detector runs at every session
  start, and it detects and cancels because the update arrives after the call began.
  DSH's `read_image` works for Claude Code because acp-dsh declares its models as taking images;
  other ACP agents keep no declaration.
  `acp-codex` has no such switch, so it is bridged only with an explicit `dshTools: true`;
  absent or `false` means no bridge and its built-ins stay its own tool set. Until a structured
  name is proven in its tool calls, it draws no ACP card for an MCP call. The person's
  own MCP servers load beside the bridge with their own tools and sign-ins: DSH hands the session
  only the `dsh` bridge, so any other `mcp__<server>__<tool>` is the CLI's own user-scope config
  (claude-agent-acp merges the person's settings MCP servers into the session), it passes the
  drift allowlist by design, and DSH's Auto review does not gate it: the agent's own rules and
  sign-in govern that call. A tool-list change
  (a preset or level change) is announced on `acp-claude` and arrives through `session/fork`
  plus `session/close` on `acp-codex`; a bridge that never lists its tools fails the turn
  (`acp_bridge_missing`) before the prompt. **Auto:** DSH's Auto preset is full access's sandbox
  with asks answered by auto-review. A bridge call adds one marked, tool-only assistant block:
  the advertisement the Session format requires before its tool/call row, which the reviewer
  reads too, and which is removed from the surface once the call settles and never replayed to
  another provider; the reviewer sees the bridge tool, its redacted arguments and its schema
  before the body runs. A denial is `AUTO_REVIEW_DENIED`, a failed reviewer refuses with
  `AUTO_REVIEW_FAILED`, a review past its deadline is `AUTO_REVIEW_TIMEOUT`, and the call never
  runs. A call that comes between two steps of a turn while the agent's prompt is still running
  (after a `step/end`, before the next `step/start`) waits for the next step, at most 30 s, and is
  recorded and reviewed there; it ends with no rows if the turn ends, its caller goes away, the
  bridge is revoked or the turn is stopped (#969). Otherwise a Manual or Full call with no open
  step is `BRIDGE_NO_STEP` (Auto: `AUTO_REVIEW_NO_STEP`); one whose advertisement or
  call row cannot be written is `BRIDGE_RECORD_FAILED`, and the call does not run. The rows' call
  id is the agent's own `_meta.callId` only when it is 1 to 128 characters of `A-Z a-z 0-9 _ . : -`
  and does not start with `acp_` (the mirror's ids); otherwise the plugin mints `bridge_<16 hex>`
  and logs the replacement. **Codex's MCP approvals.** With `dshTools` on, `acp-codex`'s MCP calls
  get no mirror card (it gives them no structured name), so a `session/request_permission` Codex
  sends for one (codex-acp's MCP tool approval) is answered at once: allow once for the `dsh`
  server (the bridge's own approval is the one dialog), the agent's reject option for any other
  or unnamed server, which is logged (#969). **A call that
  outlives its step (#957).** The agent runs its calls in parallel, and the bridge puts no
  deadline on one (a long wait, a slow command and an open approval dialog are legitimate).
  Before its step ends, an own-tool card waits for bridge calls of that step asking for approval
  or under Auto review to write their results, with no deadline; Full-access calls are unchanged.
  Stop, revoke and the prompt's end release the wait.
  The write guard still closes calls a forced boundary leaves open before `step/end` and drops
  their late results; the agent still gets the real answer.
  Each call has its own abort controller: Stop, the end of its turn and a caller that
  went away (an MCP `notifications/cancelled`, a closed request) stop that call as
  `BRIDGE_CANCELLED` and keep the bridge. A call whose `tool/call` row cannot be written is
  answered with DSH's own not-started row, and a bridge revoked with a call in flight keeps
  the guard until that call is over. The reviewer
  goes to the same non-agent side model as a Session title. Manual asks (one dialog), Full
  access does not. A Session that moves between providers carries its transcript
  redacted at each crossing — the replay out to an agent, and the transcript handed back to a
  native provider — and each crossing writes a provider-boundary row the chat shows,
  "Switching to X": it is written before the reply and claims no answer, since the call can
  still fail after it. An agent whose CLI is signed out (ACP's `auth_required`, when its session
  opens or on a prompt) fails the turn as `MODEL_ACCESS_REQUIRED`, not `ACP_AGENT`. The
  reasoning effort the Session ran on crosses with it, both ways, when the target model offers
  that level (matched by id, else by name), replacing the target default DSH records on a model
  change; an effort DSH itself defaulted is not carried. The agents' levels are their own
  `thought_level` ids: Claude Code lists low, medium, high, xhigh and max, and Codex lists low,
  medium, high, xhigh, max and ultra, per model. A target with no reasoning levels, without
  that one, or whose levels cannot be read writes a notice row saying so and runs on its own.
  A switch back before the agent has answered drops the agent's chosen level; the native
  target's own default applies.
- **Only the chat reaches the agent.** DSH's side requests on an ACP route never become
  prompts. At the `llm/stream` waterfall a Session title (`purpose: session-title`) goes to a
  model that answers on its own, without the agent's effort. That is the first model the team
  can reach: DSH's default model (`agentDefaultModel`) when it is not an agent; else a
  `sideModel` the person chose; else each configured non-agent route in turn (its first model,
  at most eight); and only then the built-in DeepSeek Flash fallback. A credential or
  missing-route failure on one candidate moves to the next, so a team without a DeepSeek key
  reviews and titles on the model it does have; only no answer at all refuses. Auto review
  (`purpose: auto-review`) takes the same route, with its messages redacted first. Every other
  side request on an ACP route, a compaction summary included, is refused (`UNSUPPORTED`): it
  would carry the agent's whole chat to another provider, and the agent manages its own context.
  Sessions on any other route are left alone.
- **A switch onto an agent passes DSH's compaction guard.** `compaction-basic` prices every model
  switch on the destination's context window, which an agent does not declare, so a switch onto
  an agent in a Session with a request header used to fail with `MODEL_SWITCH_COMPACTION_FAILED`.
  This plugin wraps the engine's `compactPressure` (`src/host/pressure.js`, the method's only
  Automagik owner): an agent destination needs no compaction, every other destination goes to the
  engine unchanged. The wrapper is adopted when an agent is created and on its requests (a
  reloaded compaction plugin is a new engine), delegates to whatever is below it at call time, and
  on dispose unwinds only when it is on top. The method is private to `compaction-basic`; a guard
  test pins it, and a DSH flag for it is proposed upstream (RFC 0023). A switch *off* an agent is
  the destination's own business: for a Bot, the Bot team decides before the guard (its README,
  "Long chats").
- **Host only.** No browser half, so the plugin cannot stop the web UI from loading. With no
  agent CLI installed it registers no route. The welcome draws its setup from the `acpAgents`
  service below.
- **The Session's level, as the agent's own mode.** Before each prompt the agent's ACP session
  mode follows the Session: Manual is Claude Code's `default` mode, whatever default mode its
  own settings name; Codex runs in the sandbox that matches DSH's. DSH Auto review is Claude Code's `auto`
  and Codex's `agent`; it is the preset's identity, never just its sandbox and ask, so a custom
  preset with the same knobs keeps Manual (and the bridge's own approval). Full access lets every
  call through, as it does DSH's own tools. An agent that does not offer the strict mode fails
  the turn instead of running in its own default.
  A Workspace Session on unbridged Codex can instead take `agent` when the Bot team's
  `ownMode` answerer returns exactly `true` twice, before the prompt. After that agent session
  has attempted the own mode, any Workspace prompt that does not take it re-sends and confirms
  strict `workspace-write` (or its chat profile below), even if cached; refusal ends the agent
  session and fails the turn.
  Sessions that never attempt the own mode keep the usual mode cache and failure handling.
  Auto never requests `bypassPermissions` or
  `agent-full-access`. Codex's own reviewer decides those steps, based on the
  [Codex 0.167.0 capture](test/fixtures/permission-payloads/README.md); later versions may
  decide differently. Any approval Codex still requests goes to the person.
- **An agent that stops answering never holds the chat.** Its start (`initialize`,
  `session/new`, the bridge's first list) has 60 seconds, and each request after that and
  before a prompt (a model, an effort, a mode, a fork, a close) has 15. Past the deadline, or
  on Stop, the agent's process and its bridge are ended and the turn says what happened. A
  start that hangs is usually a CLI waiting for the person (a first-run question, a keychain
  dialog, an update), so that message says to open it once in a terminal. Stop ends the turn
  at once and gives the agent 5 seconds to end its prompt, because `session/cancel` is only a
  notification. An agent that ignores it is ended, and the next message starts a new agent
  session with the chat replayed to it (with `dshTools: false`, the new-session notice
  instead). A message sent while the agent is still on its last prompt waits those 5 seconds,
  then gets a new session in the same turn. Ending an agent ends what it started too (the
  command behind a stuck tool call): the agent leads its own process group, which is asked to
  end and killed 3 seconds later if any of it is left; on Windows its process tree is killed.
- **Claude Code keeps the person's own settings.** It loads their Claude Code settings (user,
  project and local) and asks DSH only for what those leave as "ask". A call their allow rules,
  saved "always allow" rules or PreToolUse/PermissionRequest hooks approve runs with no DSH
  dialog. This is the owner's decision (RFC 0003, Decided).

## Agents

Unbridged Claude Code receives per-session ask rules for recursive deletion, destructive Git,
infrastructure and database shell commands at every asking level. These explicit rules also
ask in Claude's auto mode. They are never written to a CLI home and are absent at Full access,
where explicit ask rules would otherwise still ask. Crossing Full access restarts the unbridged
Claude session with the chat replayed, adding or removing the rules; staying at a level reuses it.
Bridged Claude has its built-in tools disabled, so DSH checks its calls instead.

Codex's own tools are excluded: prompt rules under Full access (`approval_policy = never`)
refuse rather than ask, its session-flags configuration has no rules folder, and in `agent`
mode prompt rules reach Codex's reviewer rather than the person. Replacing its entire reviewer
policy or changing codex-acp needs a separate owner decision.

| Route | Agent | Runs | Adapter (newest release) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `acp-claude` | Claude Code | managed or existing `claude` (`CLAUDE_CODE_EXECUTABLE`) | `@agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp` |
| `acp-codex` | Codex | managed or existing `codex` (`CODEX_PATH`) | `@agentclientprotocol/codex-acp` |
| `acp-hermes` | Hermes | existing `hermes`, started as `hermes acp` | none: the CLI is the ACP server |
| `acp-antigravity` | Antigravity | existing `agy`, started as `agy acp` | none: the CLI is the ACP server |
| `acp-omp` | omp | existing `omp`, started as `omp acp` | none: the CLI is the ACP server |
| `acp-fake` | `dev/fake-agent.mjs`, set as `fakeAgent` | Node | none; tests only |

An agent is offered when its managed CLI is ready, or an existing CLI is on PATH or where its
installer puts it (`~/.local/bin`, `/opt/homebrew/bin`, …). The settings `claude: false` or `codex: false` take one away;
`hermes`, `antigravity` and `omp` are off until set to `true` (below). They are
live settings: switching one (from the welcome's Connect AI, its Settings page *Claude Code and
Codex*, or the plugin's own settings form) offers or withdraws the agent at once, with no
restart, and a connector that lands puts its model in the picker the same way
(`llm/adapters-updated`).

### Native-ACP agents: Hermes, Antigravity, omp

These three speak ACP themselves, so there is no adapter package and nothing is installed for
them: the plugin starts the CLI it finds with `acp` (`src/host/agents.js`, `launch`). What
differs from Claude Code and Codex:

- **Off until turned on.** `hermes`, `antigravity` and `omp` are live settings that default to
  `false`. Turning one on is the person's word that Automagik may use the sign-in that CLI
  already has on this computer, shared with their terminal. No account is read for them (none
  of the three has a command that names one), so the account record and its confirm step
  (below) stay Claude Code's and Codex's.
- **Never installed by Automagik.** A CLI that is not here is listed as missing with its
  install page (`cli.state: 'missing'`, `connector.state: 'no-cli'`), never hidden and never
  "installing". Once found, the connector reads `ready` with `native: true`.
- **Sign-in in a terminal.** There is no sign-in from a Bot's chat: `loginStart` refuses with
  `acp-login/terminal` and the command (`hermes acp --setup`, `agy acp --login`, `omp login`),
  and a signed-out turn fails as `MODEL_ACCESS_REQUIRED` naming the same command. Whether the
  agent is signed in is what its own ACP session said: `true` when the session the model read
  opens, `false` on ACP's `auth_required`. That read runs when the CLI changes and once a day,
  and again when the person asks (`refresh()`) while it is not signed in; no other check opens
  a session, because each of these agents keeps every session it opens in its own history.
  A session that opens does not prove a provider key works: a turn that then answers
  `auth_required` reads as signed out at once.
- **Models.** Antigravity offers its models and efforts as config options, as the adapters do.
  Hermes offers them only as the session's own list (`models` in the `session/new` answer,
  switched with `session/set_model`); the plugin reads that list when the agent has no model
  option. omp offers no model list over ACP: it is one model, `default`, its own setting.
- **The level.** Each is put in its own `default` mode before every prompt, whatever the
  Session's level, and what it asks is answered by DSH's approval under that level. Its own
  permission settings still decide what it asks about. One that does not offer `default`
  fails the turn. A table agent with no mode for DSH's level would say so once in the chat.
- **No DSH tool bridge.** DSH's tools do not reach them, even with `dshTools: true`: their
  tool naming over ACP is not proven the way Claude Code's was, and an unrecognised bridge
  call would draw two cards and ask twice. They keep their own tools; the transcript replay on
  a model switch reaches them like any agent.

`dshTools` (live, no schema default) is the bridge, its DSH approval, the drift detector and live
switching above. Absent means the per-agent default: `acp-claude` bridges because its adapter can
drop its own built-in tools; `acp-codex` does not, because it cannot. Codex is bridged only with
an explicit `true`; absent or `false` means no bridge, and Codex keeps its own built-in tools as
its only tool set. An explicit `false` is the kill switch for Claude too: the 2026-11-03
behaviour, where each agent keeps its own tools and its own approvals. The key is public and
stays writable through
DSH's settings service or the profile patch, but it is hidden from settings forms (`.hidden()`):
it is a rollback lever, not a preference. Flipping it either way ends the running agent sessions
and revokes their bridges at once; the DSH Session keeps its transcript and the next turn starts
afresh under the new setting. A flip is also announced on the plugin context as
`acp-dsh/dsh-tools-changed` with `{ on }`: DSH delivers `loader/volatile-update` only to the
plugin whose config changed, so another plugin would never see this one. The Bot team watches
that event, so turning the switch off moves its Claude Bots back at once, and turning it on moves
them again. A listener that throws is logged as a warning; the flip itself and its ended sessions
still hold, and the Bot team reverses at its next start (the route reads off or gone). The default
moves Claude Bots once per team to `acp-claude` (the Bot team's README,
"Claude on ACP"); the bridge probe in `bridge()` still gates the move.

The transcript replay is independent of the bridge: only an explicit `false` turns it off.

| `dshTools` | Claude Code: tools | Claude Code: replay | Codex: tools | Codex: replay |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| absent | DSH bridge, its own off | yes | its own only | yes |
| `true` | DSH bridge | yes | DSH bridge and its own | yes |
| `false` | its own only | no | its own only | no |

So with `dshTools` absent Codex sees the chat but not the team's tools; those need an explicit
`true` (two tool sets). A replay reaches an agent in each of these cases, redacted and capped at
120,000 characters, the oldest messages dropped first with a marker: a move from another
provider (with its "Switching to X" row); a new agent session in a chat that already has answers
(after a restart, or a session a crossing or a flip ended), with no row since the chat stayed on
that agent; and a live session resumed after the chat answered elsewhere (a move off Codex keeps
its session), which gets only the turns it missed, from its own last answer on, with the row. A
Bot part's handoff package (a relay marked `handoff`) is carried as the record it is: in the
part's first turn it stays in the prompt beside the person's words, and once the Bot team has
answered that turn itself, the next new session gets it in the replay. Both pass the redactor.
With `false`, an agent sees only its own session, and a new one in a chat with answers writes the
"does not see this chat's earlier messages" row instead.

`sideModel` (`{ provider, model }`, default `deepseek-official/deepseek-flash`, live) is the
model a side request tries after DSH's default model. An explicit value the person chose is tried
before the configured non-agent routes (each in turn, its first model); the default DeepSeek
Flash is tried last, so a team without a DeepSeek key titles and reviews on the model it does
have. An agent route set here is ignored, and a credential or missing-route failure falls
through to the next candidate.

## The `acpAgents` service

A settings page reads the agents through this host service; the plugin stays host only.

| Method | Does |
|---|---|
| `status()` | Each agent: `{ id, key, name, on, cli: { found, installUrl, signInHint?, state, managed, version?, error?, diagnostic?, logPath?, updating? }, connector: { state, native?, version?, error?, diagnostic?, logPath?, updating?, startError?, previous?, rolledBack? }, signedIn?, signInCheck?, consent?, model: { provider, id, name, listed }, restartNeeded }`. CLI state is `missing`, `installing`, `failed` or `ready`; connector state is `off`, `no-cli`, `installing`, `failed` or `ready`. `connector.previous` is the release a failed start goes back to, while it is on disk; `connector.rolledBack` is `{ from, to, at, reason }` while a release that failed to start is held back. `connector.startError` is the short reason an installed connector's last start failed, until a session opens or Retry reinstalls it; a connector being reinstalled reads `installing`. A failed connector install always carries `error`; `diagnostic` (the end of the installer's output) and `logPath` (the file it was written to, shown from the home folder) are optional, as for a failed CLI install. `signedIn` is absent while the sign-in is unknown; `signInCheck` then says why the last check of the CLI's status command could not tell: `timeout` (the CLI was ended after 8 seconds) or `unreadable` (it could not be run, or answered something this does not read). Neither field: nothing is known of a check (none has run yet, or the agent has no status command: a native agent's sign-in comes from its own ACP session). Errors are redacted. Spawns nothing. |
| `inspect(id)` | One agent's `status()` row with a fresh sign-in check, for a Bot about to be put on it. Asks that CLI's sign-in status only; installs, enables and starts nothing. Simultaneous checks share one probe. An answer stands for 3 seconds, and a confirmed sign-in for 5 minutes, since the check starts the whole CLI; `refresh()` clears it, and so does the agent itself saying it is signed out (ACP `auth_required`). Undefined for an id that is no agent here. |
| `refresh()` | Looks for the CLIs again (one installed after DSH started is offered now), then asks each CLI whether it is signed in (`claude auth status --json`, of which only `loggedIn` is read; `codex login status`, by its exit code). No agent turn. |
| `retry(id)` | Retries the required CLI and its connector, and answers at once. A connector whose last start or install failed, or that is missing, is reinstalled at the release in use (below); else the connector is checked for a newer release. Does not turn its model switch on. |
| `loginStart(id, { label? })` | Starts the CLI's own sign-in (`src/host/login.js`), or answers the attempt already at work for that agent. Codex: a device code through `codex app-server`; Claude Code: `claude auth login --claudeai`, whose link must ask for the manual code (`code=true`). Only the official authorization pages are relayed. `label` names the view that opened it (a Bot id), for a cancel confirmation; it is not an access check. An attempt that fails writes one line to the host log: a fixed class (no CLI found, no sign-in link in time, unsupported sign-in link, the CLI exited, the CLI could not be started, the CLI did not confirm the sign-in, device-code login is not enabled, device sign-in did not start, or unknown), where the attempt stood, how the CLI ended, and the version the CLI had when the attempt started. Never what the CLI printed. |
| `loginCurrent(id)` | The attempt at work for that agent, from any view, or undefined. Never starts or cancels one. |
| `loginStatus(id, attemptId)` / `loginAnswer(id, attemptId, value)` / `loginCancel(id, attemptId)` | Reads an attempt (an ended one stays readable for 60 seconds), sends Claude's pasted `code#state` to the CLI (which then has 90 seconds to confirm), or ends it. |
| `loginTextMatches(text)` | Whether a text carries a Claude sign-in state shown in the last 24 hours. Only a boolean: the states are kept as keyed hashes in memory. |
| `loginActive()` | How many attempts are starting or waiting. |
| `account(id, { fresh? })` | For the DSH owner's views only: `{ id, signedIn?, consent?, ref?, account?: { kind: 'account' \| 'key', email?, org?, plan? }, notice? }`. Who the CLI is signed in as, read from the CLI itself (below); never on a `status()` or `inspect()` row, in a log or in an event. `ref` names the account read and goes back with `accountConfirm`. |
| `accountConfirm(id, { ref? })` | The person's word that the app may use the account this CLI is signed in to. Asks the CLI again, records the consent and announces `acp-dsh/login-ready`. Another account than `ref` is refused (`acp-account/changed`); a signed-out CLI too (`acp-account/signed-out`). |
| `accountNoticed(id)` | The one-time notice of a vendor carried through an upgrade was shown. |
| `imageAccess()` | `{ ready, signedIn?, reason?, unsupported? }`: whether Codex can draw an image now, on its own ChatGPT sign-in (Codex on, its CLI found, its connector installed, `codex login status` says signed in; an unknown sign-in is asked once; the person confirmed its account, else `reason: 'account'`; the image run's checks hold for this Codex, else not ready, with `reason`: `unsupported` (and `unsupported: true`), `config` or `unreadable`). Reads no credential and starts no sign-in. |
| `generateImage({ prompt, size?, quality?, background?, signal?, timeoutMs? })` | Draws one image with the Codex CLI (`src/host/image.js`) and resolves `{ base64, mimeType: 'image/png' }`. Refusals carry an `acp/image-*` code (`signed-out`, `usage-limit`, `timeout`, `unavailable`, `failed`, `stopped`, `refused`) and a message to show as it is. |
| `keepImages(keeper)` | Where an image an agent makes in a chat is kept, so the chat can show it (`src/host/agent-image.js`). `keeper` is `{ start?({ callId, sessionId, via }), keep({ callId, sessionId, base64, mimeType, via }) -> Promise<{ file }>, fail?({ callId, sessionId, error }) }`; one at a time, and the call returns its disposer. The Bot team registers its images folder. |
| `ownMode(answer)` | Registers one answerer for an unbridged Workspace Session's own mode. Only exact `true` within two seconds counts, twice per prompt. Returns a disposer for that registration; competing registrations disable own mode permanently. |
| `ownModeOf(provider)` | `{ mode, bridged, answerer }` for a provider offering its own mode, otherwise undefined. |
| `ownModeIn(sessionId)` | Whether that Session is busy on a prompt in its own mode. |
| `holdTurns(gate)` | A veto on agent turns, for a plugin that must keep an agent from acting in a Session (the Bot team: a Session whose permission level could not be set). `gate({ sessionId, agent, provider })` is asked before every model step on an agent's route and again right before a turn's prompt is sent; it answers undefined to let the Session go, or the sentence the step answers with. It can only refuse: a gate that throws, takes longer than ten seconds, or answers anything else holds the Session with a fixed sentence, and a held Session's agent session is ended. Several plugins may register: any refusal wins, and the returned disposer removes only its own gate. With none registered nothing is asked. |

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
Automagik

A team of AI helpers that lives in your chats.

Automagik is superintelligence, in open building blocks: a team of AI agents in your chats,
and each part usable on its own once it ships; Cloud is still in design.

The film: our own GTM team. The team launching Automagik, at work. Music only, no voice-over.
Watch the film on automagik.si

⬇ Download for Mac  ·  ⬇ Download for Linux

Cloud is coming; no date yet. Join the Cloud waitlist on automagik.si

This repository, Genie and Omni are free and open source, Apache-2.0. Cloud is a private, paid service.
Mac with Apple silicon, macOS 13 or newer · Linux on a 64-bit PC · Windows is not supported yet

--- ## Two modes **Team mode** is the desktop app: a team of long-lived Bots, each with its own name, role, model and memory. They talk to you, to each other and in group chats, run scheduled tasks, and each drives a browser of its own. With an [Omni](https://github.com/automagik-si/omni) connected, your WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack and other channels sit in the same window, and the Bot you put on a chat acts when something happens there. The team runs on [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH). **Code mode** is your code agents in the real [Herdr](https://herdr.dev) window, with the Automagik pack: a sidebar of spaces, Bots and workers across coding harnesses. Nothing in Herdr is rebuilt. The app's switch brings the Herdr window forward on the space for the current Bot's folder, and a button in Herdr brings you back. The app download alone does not set Code mode up: it needs Herdr and the pack, and [the pack's installer](herdr/README.md#install) sets up both. Team mode: the app's switch still says Work. ## The seven blocks Each block is usable alone. - **[Team mode (DSH)](apps/bots-dsh/README.md)**: the Bot team on DeepSeek Harness: long-lived Bots with their own name, role, model and memory, group chats, schedules and the Bot browser. - **[Code mode (Herdr)](herdr/README.md)**: your code agents in the real Herdr window with the Automagik pack; nothing in Herdr is rebuilt. - **[Genie](https://github.com/automagik-si/genie)**: a wish becomes a branch, a test run and a report you approve; `genie desktop` opens it on the team. - **[Omni](https://github.com/automagik-si/omni)**: the service that links your chat apps to Automagik, with its channels and canvases in the same window. - **[Pocket](apps/pocket/README.md)**: your coding agents on your Android phone, paired to your own machines. - **[The meter](meter/usagemeter/README.md)**: usagemeter, the Rust token meter that records usage and cost on the machine and answers `usagemeter query`. - **[Cloud](docs/rfcs/0024-automagik-cloud.md)**: one sign-in, organisations and hosted workspaces, with a rail that opens each. Cloud is designed and accepted, and is not live. When it ships it is a private, paid hosted service: not free and not open source. Only its contracts are public (RFC 0024). ## What makes it yours - **Your model.** Connect the AI account you already have, or an API key from a provider you use. Each Bot runs on the model you give it. - **Your files and memory, on your computer.** What the team keeps is in one folder, `.automagik` in your home folder. Each Bot keeps notes across its conversations, each group chat keeps its own, and the team shares one more. Your chats stay in your Omni. What your Bots read and write goes to the AI account you connected, under that company's terms. - **Secrets the Bots never see.** When a Bot needs an API key, a token or a password, it asks with a card in its own chat. You type the value; the Bot never sees it. - **It asks before it acts as you.** Before a Bot sends a message as you to a person, deletes something or disconnects a channel, it shows you exactly what it will do and asks first. The exceptions: your Main Bot and an Omni Bot read your chats and post to a group, a WhatsApp channel or your own chat with yourself without asking. Any other Bot reads and posts only where you allow: the first time it wants a chat it asks, and you answer **Once**, **Always** or **No**; after **Always** it posts to that group without asking again. ## Install The current release is always at [Releases](https://github.com/automagik-si/automagik/releases/latest). **Mac** (Apple silicon, macOS 13 or newer): 1. [Download Automagik for Mac](https://github.com/automagik-si/automagik/releases/latest/download/Automagik-Mac.dmg). 2. Open **Automagik-Mac.dmg** and drag the Automagik icon onto the Applications folder. 3. Open **Automagik** from Applications. **Linux** (64-bit PC): 1. [Download Automagik for Linux (.deb)](https://github.com/automagik-si/automagik/releases/latest/download/Automagik-Linux.deb) for Ubuntu or Debian. 2. Double-click it and choose **Install**, or run `sudo apt install ./Automagik-Linux.deb`. 3. Open **Automagik** from your apps. On another Linux, use the [AppImage](https://github.com/automagik-si/automagik/releases/latest/download/Automagik-Linux.AppImage). Windows is not supported yet. The app has two things to connect when you are ready: an Omni and an AI account. Both can wait. The full guide, updates, your data and uninstall are in [apps/desktop](apps/desktop/README.md). Code mode installs separately: [herdr](herdr/README.md#install). Pocket: [apps/pocket](apps/pocket/README.md#install). **For your code agent**: `npx skills add automagik-si/automagik --skill am` adds the skill that teaches it `am`, Automagik's one command. ## This repository Automagik's plugins for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH), and the Automagik desktop app that runs them, with the Herdr pack (`herdr/`), Pocket (`apps/pocket/`) and the meter (`meter/`). | Folder | Package | What it is | |---|---|---| | [`apps/bots-dsh`](apps/bots-dsh/README.md) | `@automagik/bots-dsh` | The Bot team: long-lived Bots, group chats, memory, settings, scheduled tasks, the Bot browser. Omni's and Genie's plugins build on it. | | [`apps/welcome-dsh`](apps/welcome-dsh/README.md) | `@automagik/welcome-dsh` | The welcome: the octopus, the team step, and Connect AI through DSH's own sign-ins. | | [`apps/acp-dsh`](apps/acp-dsh/README.md) | `@automagik/acp-dsh` | Agents other than DSH's own, over ACP (Agent Client Protocol), as DSH models: the agent's tool calls show as DSH tool cards and ask through DSH's approval dialog (RFC 0003). | | [`apps/locale-pt-br-dsh`](apps/locale-pt-br-dsh/README.md) | `@automagik/locale-pt-br-dsh` | Português: the Bot team's Brazilian Portuguese under DSH's own Portuguese entry. Adds no language of its own, so Settings › General › Language keeps one Portuguese row; a pt-BR choice saved by an older pack moves to DSH's pt. | | [`apps/desktop`](apps/desktop/README.md) | (the app) | The Automagik desktop app: DSH of its own with the Bot team, the welcome and Omni's channels and canvases. `omni desktop` opens it with Omni preloaded, `genie desktop` with Genie. | Omni's own plugins (its channels and canvases) live with Omni, in [automagik-si/omni](https://github.com/automagik-si/omni) (`apps/omni-channels-dsh`, `apps/omni-canvas-dsh`), and carry Omni's version. ### Install into your own DSH - **The desktop app**: download it from [Releases](https://github.com/automagik-si/automagik/releases/latest), or run `omni desktop`. See [apps/desktop](apps/desktop/README.md). - **Into your own DSH**: add the Automagik market to DSH's plugin market and install from there: ``` https://raw.githubusercontent.com/automagik-si/dsh-marketplace/main/index.json ``` Every Omni also serves a market at `https:///api/market/index.json` with the release of these plugins it was tested with. Nothing here is published to npm.
