# dsh-web3

## Quickstart

One-shot get-started (builds latest `02ca906` stack, tests, starts `xmtp-prod`, spits QR + wallet):

```sh
bash quickstart.sh
# or: MUSE_SPARK_API_KEY=<your-key> bash quickstart.sh
```

Spits `Invite URL: https://popup.convos.org/v2?i=...` + ANSI QR (`qrencode -t ANSIUTF8`) and wallet `0xa85dD3FbD8C2c831Ef156036F14638CcFf03b44e` (dynamic `wallet_info`→`ctx.wallet.address`). Also available: `./show-convos-qr.sh` / `./show-xmtp-qr.sh` for QR-only.


Reimplementation of the sovereign web3 agent harness using DeepSeek harness as core, where everything is a plug-in. Replaces https://github.com/Haven-hvn/haven-core and https://github.com/Haven-hvn/haven-adapters

There is deliberately **no aggregate bundle**: people may want one capability
and not another, so each package ships its own `dsh.bundle.patch` →
`cordis.patch.yml` inserting only its own rows, and installs independently:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add /path/to/dsh-haven/<package>
```

## The packages

| Package | Haven concept | dsh seam it lands on |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`dsh-wallet`](./dsh-wallet) | `WalletIdentity` custody ("the key never leaves this boundary") + the `CryptoAdapter` contract | `ctx.wallet` service; credentials resolved through `ctx.credentials` per operation — configuration carries *references*, never keys |
| [`dsh-wallet-ethereum`](./dsh-wallet-ethereum) | `EthereumCryptoAdapter` → OWS migration plan | provider plugin registering a `CryptoAdapter` per chain family, backed by `@open-wallet-standard/core` (sign-only; the standard handles all chain families) |
| [`dsh-treasury`](./dsh-treasury) | `Treasury` machine: balances, expenses, FUNDED/LOW/CRITICAL/DEPLETED survival gradient | storage-domain tables + derived state; a policy plugin short-circuits `agent/request` and `tools/pre-execute`, metered off `llm/token-meter` |
| [`dsh-channel-xmtp`](./dsh-channel-xmtp) | `XmtpChannel` direct agent↔user messaging | one dsh agent per conversation (`ctx.agents`), inbound via `agent.followup`, replies via `sendText`; EOA identity signs through `ctx.wallet` |
| [`dsh-storage-synapse`](./dsh-storage-synapse) | `SynapseStorageAdapter` + `StorageBackend` pinning | `ctx.synapse` + `synapse_pin` / `synapse_pin_status` agent tools; every node request wallet-signed per operation |
| [`dsh-wallet-tools`](./dsh-wallet-tools) | wallet address/balance exposure (replaces hard-coded persona) | `wallet_info` tool via `ctx.tools` + `ctx.wallet.address()` live (no hard-coded `0x...`) |
| [`dsh-persona`](./dsh-persona) | Haven persona / system instructions | `agent/request` composition; generic instruction to call `wallet_info` when address/balance/funding asked |
| [`dsh-tool-prowlarr`](./dsh-tool-prowlarr) | Prowlarr indexer search bridge (use-case agnostic) | `prowlarr_indexers` / `prowlarr_search` read-only tools via `ctx.tools`; no wallet seam |
| [`dsh-tool-acquisition`](./dsh-tool-acquisition) | Download/acquisition arm (Haven `acquisition/` port, torrent clients outsourced) | `acquire_submit` / `acquire_status` tools via `ctx.tools`; qBittorrent → Transmission failover, no wallet seam |

## Composition

`dsh-wallet` is the custody root; the other packages build on it:

```
dsh-wallet  ←  dsh-wallet-ethereum   (registers the evm CryptoAdapter)
    ↑
    ├── dsh-channel-xmtp             (signs XMTP identity per signature)
    ├── dsh-storage-synapse          (signs node requests per request)
    └── dsh-wallet-tools             (exposes wallet_info via ctx.tools → ctx.wallet)
dsh-persona                           (composes agent/request; calls wallet_info, no hard-coded address)
dsh-treasury                          (independent; needs the storage stack)
```

A typical full install:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add \
  /path/to/dsh-haven/dsh-wallet \
  /path/to/dsh-haven/dsh-wallet-ethereum \
  /path/to/dsh-haven/dsh-treasury \
  /path/to/dsh-haven/dsh-channel-xmtp \
  /path/to/dsh-haven/dsh-storage-synapse \
  @open-wallet-standard/core @xmtp/node-sdk
```

The two SDKs are optional peers: every package loads, mounts, and tests
without them (lazy imports with actionable errors; tests substitute
`internals.*` seams).

## Prerequisites

- **Storage stack** (`dsh-treasury` only): the profile must mount `storage`,
  `storage-json`/`storage-sqlite`, and `storage-domain` rows (present in
  `dsh-web-app`; absent in `dsh-base`). The treasury patch does NOT insert
  them — a row id inserted by two layers mounts the plugin twice.
- **Agent stack** (`dsh-channel-xmtp` only): agents/sessions/llm, present in
  any agent-running profile.
- Plugins with unmet `inject` lists stay dormant instead of failing, so
  install order is free.

## Design decision: isolated bundles, coupled seams

Web3 plugins are **isolated as code, coupled at the seam** — a direct consequence of
how the DeepSeek harness composes.

* **Isolated** — every package is a standalone Cordis plugin (`export const name`,
  `export const inject`, `export function apply(ctx, config)`) with its own
  `dsh.bundle.patch` → `cordis.patch.yml`. There is no aggregate bundle; `dsh plugin add`
  installs one capability at a time and `inject` ordering is free (unmet `inject` stays
  dormant). This is why `dsh-wallet`, `dsh-channel-xmtp`, `dsh-storage-synapse`,
  `dsh-treasury`, and `dsh-wallet-tools` each build via `prepare` (tsdown → `lib/`) and test
  without the others (`internals.*` seams).

* **Coupled at the seam** — isolation would break without declared contracts:
  `ctx.wallet` (custody), `ctx.tools` (model-facing tools), `ctx.agents`/`ctx.sessions`
  (per-conversation agents), `ctx.synapse`/`ctx.treasury` (storage). Plugins declare
  this with `inject` — e.g. `inject = ['wallet','tools']` in `dsh-wallet-tools` and
  `dsh-storage-synapse` — so they mount only when the seam exists, and call it
  per-operation (`ctx.wallet.address()`, `ctx.wallet.signMessage()`, `ctx.tools.register(defineTool(...))`).

Harness limitations that force this shape:

1. **Singleton tool runtime.** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` exposes one scheduler (`ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER].prepare`). If two instances are deduped incorrectly the `Symbol` mismatches and every `tool/call` fails with `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')`. Bundles therefore depend on `dsh-tools` as a **peer** (`0.2.1-alpha.1`, exact — dsh also rejects a bundle whose `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peers do not match the running CLI) and `link:` installs must dedupe to one copy.

2. **Wallet custody is per-operation.** Configuration carries only `keyRef`/`wallet` names; `ctx.credentials.resolve` runs inside `signMessage`/`address` and is dropped. Consumers (XMTP identity in `dsh-channel-xmtp`, per-request `x-synapse-*` headers in `dsh-storage-synapse`, `wallet_info` in `dsh-wallet-tools`) see only addresses/signatures. Hard-coding an address in persona (`When asked for address, answer with 0x...`) breaks rotation and wallet-agnostic installs — the correct seam is a tool that resolves `ctx.wallet.address(config.wallet)` live.

3. **Channel is per-conversation, not per-process.** `dsh-channel-xmtp` creates one `ctx.agents` session per XMTP conversation (`SessionId` derived from `conversationId`), handles `conversations.sync()` before `getConversationById`, reconnect/consent sweep, and dedup. The channel owns transport; the agent owns the turn.

Result: add `dsh-wallet` once, then compose any subset. `dsh-wallet-tools` (`wallet_info` tool, `presentCall: {kind:'read'}`) makes the EVM address model-reachable without persona shortcuts; `dsh-channel-xmtp` makes it XMTP-reachable; `dsh-storage-synapse` makes it storage-reachable — all through `ctx.wallet`, none by sharing key material.

## Custody model (the through-line)

Haven's rule — *the private key never leaves its layer; everything else
requests signatures* — maps to one dsh pattern used everywhere here:

1. Configuration carries **names and credential references** (`keyRef`,
   `dbEncryptionKeyRef`). A pasted raw key fails loud at plugin load because
   key material cannot syntactically be a `CredentialRef`.
2. Secrets exist only **inside one operation**: `ctx.credentials.resolve` runs
   per call, the provider signs, every reference is dropped. Rotation reaches
   the very next operation without restart.
3. Consumers (XMTP signer, Synapse requests, future channels) see only
   **addresses and signatures** through `ctx.wallet`.

## Development

```sh
pnpm install       # workspace of five packages
pnpm vitest        # specs live in <package>/tests/**
```

Each package builds self-contained via `prepare` (tsdown → `lib/`), so git or
path installs work without monorepo context. Money figures are integer µUSD
(USD × 1e6) throughout, matching haven-core.

# dsh-royalty-router

mint.club graduation advisor + launcher for DeepSeek Harness: `rr_advise` (model-backed launch params), `rr_venue` (curve-vs-pool quotes), `rr_build` (launch dry-run), `rr_launch` (approve → simulate → send), `rr_sweep` (pending royalties into locked liquidity), `rr_heartbeat` (activity stamp) over [`@royalty-router/sdk`](../../../mint-glue-graduate/sdk) (mint-glue-graduate). Reads are free; execute tools sign per operation through `ctx.wallet` — no signing, no spending, no private key in Node or config.

> Installation note: `@royalty-router/sdk` is not on npm yet, so
> `package.json` uses `file:../../mint-glue-graduate/sdk` (requires that
> checkout present for install/build). After the SDK is published to npm,
> revert to `"=0.1.0"`. Same story as `haven-aol`; do both publishes in
> one pass.

## Tools

| Tool | Kind | Network | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rr_advise` | read | none (offline) | Fills `recommendedIntent` (15% royalty both ways, 0.3% pool fee, smooth 20-step curve, hard seed) from `{name, symbol, reserveToken, feeRecipient, curve}` + optional overrides, or advises an explicit-steps intent. Returns `{intent, advice[], bandBps}`. Empty advice = matches the model. |
| `rr_venue` | read | live RPC | `readVenueState` + `quoteVenues` + `crossoverSize` for `{token, secondary?, fee?, tickSpacing?, side, amountIn}`. Bigints cross as decimal strings (the `rr` CLI convention). |
| `rr_build` | read | live RPC | Full `buildLaunch` dry-run: struct, `msg.value`, approvals, predicted token/poolId. **Requires `factory` in config** — fails actionable without it. Until the live factory is deployed, point at a local fork. Signs nothing. |
| `rr_launch` | execute | live RPC + sends txs | `buildLaunch` then approve (if needed) → simulate → send. Caller funds the reserve/seed in the configured wallet. Signs via `ctx.wallet`. |
| `rr_sweep` | execute | live RPC + sends txs | Sweeps one router's pending royalties into locked liquidity (`{router, minOut?}`). Simulates first. Call when ready (pending clears `MIN_CLAIM`); else `rr_heartbeat`. Signs via `ctx.wallet`. |
| `rr_heartbeat` | execute | live RPC + sends txs | Permissionless activity stamp for a router with nothing worth sweeping (`{router}`). Moves no funds, still sends a tx. Signs via `ctx.wallet`. |

Reads are `presentCall: {kind:'read'}` — free, never gated, never metered. Execute tools are `presentCall: {kind:'execute'}` — metered/gated by treasury policy like any other spend.

## Config

```yaml
- id: royalty-router
  config:
    rpcUrl: https://mainnet.base.org
    chainId: 8453
    # factory: 0x...   # rr_build / rr_launch; until the live factory is deployed
    # wallet: my-wallet # dsh-wallet name signing rr_launch / rr_sweep / rr_heartbeat
```

`inject = ['tools', 'wallet']`, so both must be mounted (same shape as `dsh-storage-synapse` — Cordis forbids touching a service the plugin does not declare). Reads never call the seam, but the plugin stays dormant where `dsh-wallet` is absent; `dsh-wallet-ethereum` is additionally required for signing, and execute tools need a `wallet:` name. The plugin holds no secrets: configuration carries names and credential references, signing happens per operation inside `dsh-wallet`. Bigint args arrive as decimal strings and are validated (`0x`-address shape, decimal-integer shape) with actionable errors.

## Exactly-once (execute tools)

`rr_launch` / `rr_sweep` / `rr_heartbeat` run through one attempt ledger
per mount: concurrent runs for one intent share a single send, settled
runs replay, and a caller that times out (3-minute bound) leaves the send
running so the retry finds the late result instead of double-sending.
Sends serialize per wallet (`withWalletLane`: no shared nonces), and
repeats after ambiguous outcomes read back first — `bond.exists` plus a
token name match for launches, `routerStatus` for sweeps (heartbeats have
no read-back: re-stamping is cheap and moves no funds). The SDK's own
guards stay as backstops: idempotent approvals and the pre-send
symbol-taken check.

## What is deliberately absent (keeper loop)

The keeper loop stays out: surface `routerStatus`-style reads and let Gelato/cron consume them (see `mint-glue-graduate/keeper/sweep.sh` for the condition). No new custody code was needed for the execute tools — they reuse the `dsh-storage-synapse` viem `toAccount` wallet bridge (`ctx.wallet.signTransaction`, works with both `ows` and `raw` providers).

## Trust notes (mirror in tool descriptions)

- `rr_build` output is a dry-run: simulate before sending, and on swapper routes quote a real `minOut` — the reference swapper trusts the caller's floor.
- Venue math is the full-range constant-product case the program position creates; curve math mirrors `MCV2_Bond` exactly (see `@royalty-router/sdk` README).
- mint.club's 20% protocol cut is taken before any router sees funds and is not routable.

## Tests

Offline seam proofs (`tests/router.spec.ts`, no network): model-default fill + empty advice, 3%-royalty and coarse-step warnings (vectors from `sdk/example.intent.json` shape), input validation, bigint/JSON safety, factory guard, execute arg validation, stubbed-client venue quote. Exactly-once proofs (`tests/exactly-once.spec.ts`, no network): attempt keys, ledger attach/replay/timeout-late-settle/retry, wallet-lane branching, stubbed read-back verdicts, hook verdicts. Fork suites (need `FORK_RPC` + `FORK_FACTORY`): `tests/fork-e2e.spec.ts` (wiring, live bond/factory reads, dry-run, funded simulation), `tests/fork-venue.spec.ts` (live venue quotes, router status, recommended-model pass), `tests/fork-execute.spec.ts` (real launch → sweep → heartbeat on a local fork). `scripts/fork-launch.mjs` launches a token out-of-band via the SDK path for local fork testing.

# dsh-storage-synapse

Synapse pinning for DeepSeek Harness: a `ctx.synapse` seam (store / retrieve /
pin / pin-status over a Synapse/IPFS node) plus two model-facing tools —
`synapse_pin` and `synapse_pin_status` — so the harness itself can natively
choose to pin a file.

Ported from Haven's `SynapseStorageAdapter` + `StorageBackend`
(haven-adapters). Haven's adapter was explicitly a scaffold over the standard
Kubo/IPFS HTTP API (`add`, `cat`, `pin/ls`, `pin/add`); this package keeps
exactly that operation surface.

## Concept transfer

| Haven | Here |
| --- | --- |
| `StorageBackend` machine (`eStoreData` / `ePinRenew` events, op queue) | `ctx.synapse` methods; dsh owns dispatch |
| `StoragePinManager` renewal loop | the agent decides via the `synapse_pin` tool (`pin/add` on a pinned CID renews it) |
| `storageKey: "env:VAR" \| "0x…"` → bearer header | **wallet-signed requests**: each request signs a per-request challenge through `ctx.wallet` |
| `store(bytes) → cid`, `retrieve(cid)`, `checkPin`, `renewPin` | same surface, same `PinStatus` shape (`expiresAt` 0 = permanent, −1 = unpinned) |

## Signing (builds on dsh-wallet)

There is deliberately no key or credential field in this package's
configuration. `config.wallet` names a `dsh-wallet` entry; every node request
mints a canonical challenge (`synapse:<path>:<timestamp>`) and signs it via
`ctx.wallet.signMessage`, which runs dsh-wallet's resolve → load → sign → drop
pipeline. The node verifies signature-over-challenge against the presented
address (`x-synapse-address` / `x-synapse-challenge` / `x-synapse-signature`
headers). No storage secret exists in configuration, in this package, or in
the process between requests.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add /path/to/dsh-wallet /path/to/dsh-wallet-ethereum /path/to/dsh-storage-synapse
```

All three are independent bundles; each inserts only its own row. This plugin
stays dormant until the wallet seam is present (`inject: [wallet, tools]`).

## Configuration

```yaml
- id: storage-synapse
  name: 'dsh-storage-synapse'
  config:
    url: 'http://127.0.0.1:5001'   # Synapse/IPFS node HTTP API (Haven's default, standard Kubo address)
    wallet: agent                  # dsh-wallet entry that signs every request (required)
```

## Model experience

- `synapse_pin` — give a local file `path` to upload + pin (returns the CID),
  or an existing `cid` to pin/renew. For anything that must outlive the
  session.
- `synapse_pin_status` — check whether a CID is currently pinned.

## Events

- `synapse/pinned` `{ cid }` — emitted at the commit point of every pin.

## Piece shape (readers only play single-block)

Every store packs the bytes as a single-raw-block CARv1 (whole file = one
`0x55` block under a tag-42 header root) at every size — a port of
haven-cli's single-block builder without its 32 MiB ceiling. Chunked UnixFS
is never emitted: readers reject multi-block pieces whose dag-pb root they
cannot verify ("Nested CAR container"), and no real chunker emits the bare
header encoding their check expects. Root CIDs are therefore raw-codec
(`bafkrei…`), never dag-pb; gated records address the CommP piece anyway.

## Limitations

- Sign-only authentication headers follow the scheme documented above; a
  plain Kubo node ignores unknown headers, so against unauthenticated local
  nodes the signature is simply extra metadata (matching Haven's scaffold
  behavior, which sent no auth when no key was configured).
- No archival/compression pipeline and no background pin reconciliation — by
  scope, pinning is an agent decision.

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-tool-acquisition

Download/acquisition tools for DeepSeek Harness: the missing arm between
`prowlarr_search` and `synapse_pin`. Turns one submit call — a magnet
link, a direct http(s) URL, or a Prowlarr release reference — into local
files, then lets the agent poll the handle to completion.

Ported from the reference `acquisition/` package plus the Prowlarr plugin's
fetch strategy (`_acquire`/`_submit`/`_wait`), with the clients outsourced:
torrents download in qBittorrent/Transmission (daemons beside Prowlarr),
while the agent stays a thin poller. There is deliberately no in-process
torrent engine and no Usenet backend.

## Tools

| Tool | Kind | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `<prefix>_submit` | execute | Download one source; returns an opaque handle + first state |
| `<prefix>_status` | read | Poll a handle; finalizes (select + import) on completion |

Submit takes exactly one source: `magnet`, `url`, or Prowlarr
`downloadUrl`/`magnetUrl` (the redacted form from `prowlarr_search` is
fine — the API key is re-attached server-side and never shown to the
model). `waitMs` bounds the inline wait (default 30s); past the budget
the call returns `queued`/`downloading` and the agent polls
`<prefix>_status`. Handles persist in
`<downloadDir>/acquisition-handles.json`, so a poll after a restart
still resolves, and terminal states replay their stored result.

Resolution order per submit:

1. magnets and `.torrent` bodies → torrent clients in `torrentClients`
   order, failing over unless the error is permanent
2. direct URLs and Prowlarr bodies sniffing as content → guarded fetch,
   type check, import
3. `.nzb` bodies → refused (`ACQUIRE_UNSUPPORTED`; no Usenet backend)

Exactly-once: every record carries a content key (torrent infohash, hashed
URL, hashed release ref), so resubmitting the same source resolves to its
handle — refreshed from the backend — instead of queueing twice. Failover
verifies before trying the next backend: an ambiguous submit error
(timeout, reset, 5xx) probes the first backend by infohash, adopting the
torrent when it queued and failing over only when it provably did not (a
backend that cannot answer either yields an uncertain record plus an
ambiguous error — poll `<prefix>_status`, never resubmit elsewhere).
Failed/missing records stay retryable under a new handle.

## Configuration

```yaml
- id: tool-acquisition
  name: 'dsh-tool-acquisition'
  config:
    prowlarrUrl: http://localhost:9696   # $PROWLARR_URL fallback
    # prowlarrApiKey: ...                # or $PROWLARR_API_KEY (server-side only)
    qbittorrentUrl: http://localhost:8080
    # qbittorrentPassword: ...           # or $QBITTORRENT_PASSWORD
    transmissionUrl: http://localhost:9091
    downloadDir: ./downloads-acquisition # spool + imports + handle store
    allowPrivateHosts: false             # true for LAN indexers / tests
    accept: ['*']                        # kinds, '*', or MIME globs; empty = all
    selectMode: all                      # or 'largest'
    importMode: hardlink                 # copy | move | inplace
```

`inject = ['tools']` only. No wallet (downloads are free), no treasury.
Client passwords fall back to `$QBITTORRENT_PASSWORD` /
`$TRANSMISSION_PASSWORD`; every error message is redacted.

## Guardrails (Haven parity)

- Every fetch hop — including each redirect — is SSRF-checked (scheme,
  `allowedHosts`, public-address resolution); redirects never carry
  credentials off-origin, and the Prowlarr key is sent as an

## Custody model (the through-line)

Haven's rule — *the private key never leaves its layer; everything else
requests signatures* — maps to one dsh pattern used everywhere here:

1. Configuration carries **names and credential references** (`keyRef`,
   `dbEncryptionKeyRef`). A pasted raw key fails loud at plugin load because
   key material cannot syntactically be a `CredentialRef`.
2. Secrets exist only **inside one operation**: `ctx.credentials.resolve` runs
   per call, the provider signs, every reference is dropped. Rotation reaches
   the very next operation without restart.
3. Consumers (XMTP signer, Synapse requests, future channels) see only
   **addresses and signatures** through `ctx.wallet`.

```sh

```

Each package builds self-contained via `prepare` (tsdown → `lib/`), so git or
path installs work without monorepo context. Money figures are integer µUSD
(USD × 1e6) throughout, matching haven-core.

# dsh-tool-prowlarr

Read-only [Prowlarr](https://prowlarr.com) tools for DeepSeek Harness. The agent can
discover the indexers configured in a Prowlarr instance and search them through the
Prowlarr v1 API. The package is use-case agnostic: which indexers, categories, and
result sizes a deployment uses is configuration (see `examples/arxiv.patch.yml`).

## Tools

| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `<prefix>_indexers` | List indexers: id, name, protocol, enabled, privacy, supported search types, top-level Newznab categories. Args: `nameContains?`, `includeDisabled?` |
| `<prefix>_search` | `GET /api/v1/search`. Args: `query` (required), `indexerIds?`, `categories?`, `type?` (`search`/`tvsearch`/`movie`/`music`/`book`), `limit?`, `offset?` |

`<prefix>` defaults to `prowlarr`. Both tools return a typed canonical value (usable
from PTC mode as `await tools.prowlarr_search({...})`) and render a compact text list
for the model. Nothing is grabbed or downloaded.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add /path/to/dsh-tool-prowlarr
export PROWLARR_API_KEY=...        # Prowlarr → Settings → General → Security
```

## Configuration

```yaml
- id: tool-prowlarr
  config:
    baseUrl: http://localhost:9696   # or $PROWLARR_URL; include any URL base
    # apiKey: !!js process.env.PROWLARR_API_KEY   # defaults to $PROWLARR_API_KEY
    toolPrefix: prowlarr
    defaultIndexerIds: []            # used when a call names none; empty = all enabled
    defaultCategories: []            # used when a call names none
    defaultSearchType: search
    defaultLimit: 25
    maxLimit: 100                    # hard cap on results returned per call
    timeoutMs: 60000                 # per request; searches fan out to indexers
    allowedIndexerIds: []            # non-empty = the only indexers listable/searchable
```

A patch replaces a row's whole `config`, so restate every key you rely on.
Mount the plugin twice with different `id`s and `toolPrefix`es to expose two
Prowlarr instances or two scoped views of one.

## Behavior notes

- Prowlarr applies `limit` per indexer; the plugin enforces the final bound and
  reports `total` and `truncated`.
- An `allowedIndexerIds` list with no explicit selection searches exactly the
  allowlist, never "all indexers"; requesting an id outside it is a tool error.
- Hits carry `downloadUrl` and `magnetUrl` independently: indexers disagree
  about which holds the proxy link, and some return a real DHT magnet
  alongside an http link. Both are key-stripped; try one, then the other.
- Errors are `ProwlarrError` with a `code`: `PROWLARR_NOT_CONFIGURED`,
  `PROWLARR_INVALID_REQUEST`, `PROWLARR_UNAUTHORIZED`, `PROWLARR_HTTP_ERROR`,
  `PROWLARR_NETWORK_ERROR`, `PROWLARR_BAD_RESPONSE`, `PROWLARR_TIMEOUT`, `PROWLARR_ABORTED`.

## Security

- The key is sent only in the `X-Api-Key` header; redirects are refused.
- Prowlarr rewrites `downloadUrl`/`magnetUrl` into proxy links containing
  `apikey=<key>`. The plugin strips that parameter and any literal key from every
  returned URL, guid, and error message before the model sees it.
- Indexer content is third-party data; the rendered output tells the model to treat
  it as untrusted.

## Development

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
```

Tests run the tools through the real `dsh-tools` registry against a local fake
Prowlarr HTTP server.

# dsh-treasury

Economic survival engine for DeepSeek Harness — haven-core's `Treasury`
machine re-homed onto dsh seams. The agent exists only as long as it can pay
for resources; this package tracks that, and stops the loop when it no longer
can.

Concept transfer (haven-core → dsh):

| haven-core | here |
|---|---|
| Treasury machine state (`Funded ↔ Low ↔ Critical ↔ Depleted`) | *derived* state: recomputed from ledger rows after every durable write, never stored, so it cannot drift |
| balances / expense ledger in machine memory | schema-validated storage-domain records (`treasury` domain, `balances` + `expenses` tables) |
| `eCostAuthorize` request/response | `ctx.treasury.authorize(category, µUSD)` — the same per-state matrix as a pure function |
| InferencePipeline middleware | `agent/request` waterfall middleware (throw = request fails, no recovery) |
| ToolExecutor cost gate | `tools/pre-execute` waterfall (`{ kind: 'deny' }` short-circuit, enforced in the executor) |
| token accounting | `ctx.tokenMeter.measure(session)` — request pressure × configured price |

All USD figures are integers in µUSD (USD × 1e6), haven-core's precision.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add /path/to/dsh-treasury
```

Two rows activate: `treasury` (the ledger, `ctx.treasury`) and
`treasury-policy` (enforcement). The ledger needs the non-session storage
stack (`storage`, `storage-json`, `storage-domain` rows) — the `dsh-web-app`
bundle mounts it already; on other profiles add the three rows to your
profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (see this package's `cordis.patch.yml` for the
exact snippet). Set `inferenceUsdPerMillionTokens` to your model's price.

## The ledger (`ctx.treasury`)

- `updateBalances(balances)` — replace the balance sheet (haven
  `eBalanceUpdate`); rows are `{ chain, token, amount, usdEstimate }`.
- `recordExpense({ category, amount, token?, description? })` — append to the
  ledger (haven `eExpenseRecord`); retention-bounded by `maxExpenses`.
- `report()` — haven `TreasuryReport`: state, balances, `totalValueUsd`,
  `dailyBurnUsd`, `runwayDays`, budget, recent expenses.
- `state()` — `funded | low | critical | depleted`, from
  `computeTreasuryState(computeRunway(totalValue, dailyBurn))`: > 30 days
  funded, > 7 low, > 0 critical, else depleted.
- `authorize(category, estimatedCostUsd)` — the per-state matrix: funded =
  budget check; low = reserve locked; critical = infrastructure/storage always
  approved, inference only under $0.10, rest denied; depleted = all denied.

Daily burn = `fixedDailyBurnUsd` + expenses in the trailing `burnWindowMs`
scaled to a day. Budget defaults to haven's allocation (inference 38, tools
14, infrastructure 28, storage 5, messaging 10, reserve 5; must total 100).

Events (both emitted strictly after the durable write — the commit point):
`treasury/state-changed` `{ previous, current, report }` and
`treasury/expense`.

## The policy (`dsh-treasury/policy`)

- **`agent/request`** — prices the pending request
  (`tokenMeter.measure(session).totalTokens × inferenceUsdPerMillionTokens`),
  asks `authorize('inference', cost)`, and **throws `TreasuryDeniedError`
  without calling `next()`** on denial: a request-middleware throw fails the
  request with no recovery offered. Approved requests record the estimated
  spend before dispatch (fail-closed: a ledger write failure fails the
  request — a survival engine never runs unmetered).
- **`tools/pre-execute`** — resolves a call's declared cost (`toolCosts`
  patterns, else `defaultToolCostUsd`) and category (`toolCategories`
  patterns, else `tools`), asks the matrix, and **returns
  `{ kind: 'deny', reason }` without `next()`** on denial — the registry
  materializes the error result, so denial holds for every caller that
  reaches the executor. Zero-cost calls pass ungated: a free read is not a
  spend, and the inference gate owns survival halting.
- **`tools/post-execute`** — records an admitted call's declared cost when
  the call settles (observe-and-record; always delegates).

Enforcement activates once the treasury is funded (any balance row). A
never-funded ledger meters but denies nothing — haven's zero-value rule
("empty treasury = 100% spent") would otherwise brick a fresh install.

## Extension points

- `treasury/state-changed` for degraded-mode UX (e.g. prompt sections,
  notifications) and `treasury/expense` for audit sinks.
- Balance feeds: schedule `ctx.treasury.updateBalances(...)` from `schedule/`
  or `jobs/` with your chain data source; this package deliberately fetches
  nothing on-chain.
- The pure matrix (`authorizeCost`, `computeRunway`, `computeTreasuryState`)
  is exported for bespoke policies.

## Model Experience

No tools and no prompt sections ship here. The model experiences the
treasury only through enforcement: a denied tool call surfaces as that call's
error result (`Error: treasury denied <tool>: …` — a normal tool error the
model can read and react to), and a denied request ends the turn with an
error. Token cost: zero added request content; the deny text replaces a
result that would have existed anyway. KV-cache: no request-prefix impact.

## Known Limitations and Deferred Work

- Inference metering prices *request pressure* (the token-meter's measure of
  what the next call carries) rather than provider-billed usage; it
  over-approximates output-heavy turns and is documented as an estimate.
- Tool costs are config-declared estimates recorded at settlement, whether
  the call succeeded or failed; a call admitted by this policy but denied by
  a later pre-execute listener still records its declared cost.
- No model-visible treasury report tool or prompt section yet; state changes
  are observable by plugins, not the model, until a consumer justifies one.
- Category spend percentages compare lifetime retained expenses against
  *current* treasury value (haven-core's exact rule); long-lived agents that
  re-fund repeatedly may want a windowed variant.

## Design decision: isolated bundles, coupled seams

Web3 plugins are **isolated as code, coupled at the seam** — a direct consequence of
how the DeepSeek harness composes.

* **Isolated** — every package is a standalone Cordis plugin (`export const name`,
  `export const inject`, `export function apply(ctx, config)`) with its own
  `dsh.bundle.patch` → `cordis.patch.yml`. There is no aggregate bundle; `dsh plugin add`

  `dsh-treasury`, and `dsh-wallet-tools` each build via `prepare` (tsdown → `lib/`) and test
  without the others (`internals.*` seams).

* **Coupled at the seam** — isolation would break without declared contracts:
  `ctx.wallet` (custody), `ctx.tools` (model-facing tools), `ctx.agents`/`ctx.sessions`
  (per-conversation agents), `ctx.synapse`/`ctx.treasury` (storage). Plugins declare
  this with `inject` — e.g. `inject = ['wallet','tools']` in `dsh-wallet-tools` and
  `dsh-storage-synapse` — so they mount only when the seam exists, and call it
  per-operation (`ctx.wallet.address()`, `ctx.wallet.signMessage()`, `ctx.tools.register(defineTool(...))`).

Harness limitations that force this shape:

1. **Singleton tool runtime.** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` exposes one scheduler (`ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER].prepare`). 2. **Wallet custody is per-operation.** Configuration carries only `keyRef`/`wallet` names; `ctx.credentials.resolve` runs inside `signMessage`/`address` and is dropped. Consumers (XMTP identity in `dsh-channel-xmtp`, per-request `x-synapse-*` headers in `dsh-storage-synapse`, `wallet_info` in `dsh-wallet-tools`) see only addresses/signatures. Hard-coding an address in persona (`When asked for address, answer with 0x...`) breaks rotation and wallet-agnostic installs — the correct seam is a tool that resolves `ctx.wallet.address(config.wallet)` live.

3. **Channel is per-conversation, not per-process.** `dsh-channel-xmtp` creates one `ctx.agents` session per XMTP conversation (`SessionId` derived from `conversationId`), handles `conversations.sync()` before `getConversationById`, reconnect/consent sweep, and dedup. ## Custody model (the through-line)

Haven's rule — *the private key never leaves its layer; everything else
requests signatures* — maps to one dsh pattern used everywhere here:

1. Configuration carries **names and credential references** (`keyRef`,
   `dbEncryptionKeyRef`). A pasted raw key fails loud at plugin load because
   key material cannot syntactically be a `CredentialRef`.
2. Secrets exist only **inside one operation**: `ctx.credentials.resolve` runs
   per call, the provider signs, every reference is dropped. Rotation reaches
   the very next operation without restart.
3. Consumers (XMTP signer, Synapse requests, future channels) see only
   **addresses and signatures** through `ctx.wallet`.

## Development

```sh
pnpm install       # workspace of five packages
pnpm vitest        # specs live in <package>/tests/**
```

Each package builds self-contained via `prepare` (tsdown → `lib/`), so git or
path installs work without monorepo context. Money figures are integer µUSD
(USD × 1e6) throughout, matching haven-core.

# dsh-wallet-ethereum

Ethereum signing provider for the [`dsh-wallet`](../dsh-wallet/README.md)
seam. Implements the `CryptoAdapter` contract (Haven's adapter shape) in two
custody modes, selected by `provider`:

- **`ows`** (default) — delegates every operation to
  [`@open-wallet-standard/core`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@open-wallet-standard/core)
  — the Rust core running in-process via NAPI. Keys live in the OWS vault,
  are decrypted per call behind OWS's policy engine, and are zeroized after
  each operation — they never enter this process. **EIP-191 only**: there is
  no raw-digest signing on this path.
- **`raw`** — signs directly from a 0x private key held in the credential
  store (resolved per operation through the wallet's `keyRef`, never in
  config). Supports `signDigest`: raw secp256k1 over a 32-byte digest with no
  EIP-191 prefix — exactly what EIP-712 gates (the Haven-AOL canister, which
  verifies `ecrecover` over the raw gate digest) require. OWS signatures are
  rejected there with `#InvalidSignature`.

This is the haven-adapters OWS migration plan
(`haven-adapters/docs/01-ows-crypto-adapter-migration-plan.md`) realized as a
dsh plugin, with the plan's open decisions settled the dsh way:

- **Key source.** Haven's `loadKey("env:VAR" | "0x…")` is gone. The wallet
  seam resolves a `CredentialRef` per operation and hands the adapter a
  structured `WalletKeySource`; the secret is the OWS *credential* (vault
  passphrase or `ows_key_…` API token), not a private key. Keys live in the
  OWS vault, are decrypted per call behind OWS's policy engine, and are
  zeroized after each operation — they never enter this process.
- **`keyMaterial`.** A typed `OwsKeyContext` session descriptor (wallet id,
  chain, credential, account index) — no `any`, no key bytes, operation-scoped.
- **Sign-only.** `signTransaction` maps to OWS `signTransaction`, never
  `signAndSend`; broadcasting belongs to whoever holds the signed payload.
- **Multi-chain by standard.** OWS derives all chain families from one vault
  wallet, so one adapter class serves any family (`evm`, `solana`, `bitcoin`,
  `cosmos`, `tron`, `ton`, `sui`, `xrpl`, `filecoin`) rather than
  implementing each chain by hand; `evm` is this package's default. Errors
  (`WALLET_NOT_FOUND`, `POLICY_DENIED`, `INVALID_PASSPHRASE`,
  `API_KEY_EXPIRED`, …) translate to actionable adapter-level messages.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add /path/to/dsh-wallet /path/to/dsh-wallet-ethereum
dsh plugin --profile <name> add @open-wallet-standard/core
```

`@open-wallet-standard/core` is an optional peer: composition and tests load
without it (the import is lazy with an actionable failure), real signing needs
it. Prebuilt binaries ship for macOS (arm64, x64) and Linux (x64, arm64).

Configure a wallet against your OWS vault in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: wallet
  config:
    wallets:
      treasury:
        chain: evm
        wallet: agent-treasury           # OWS vault wallet name (ows wallet create agent-treasury)
        keyRef: HAVEN_WALLET_PASSPHRASE  # credential REFERENCE to the passphrase or ows_key_… token
```

Raw-key mode (EIP-712 gates) needs no vault and no
`@open-wallet-standard/core` — the key lives in the process environment under
the `keyRef` name, and the address derives from the key (the `wallet`
selector is ignored beyond diagnostics):

```yaml
- id: wallet
  config:
    wallets:
      agent:
        chain: evm
        wallet: agent
        keyRef: PRIVATE_KEY              # credential REFERENCE — never the key
- id: wallet-ethereum
  config:
    chains: [evm]
    provider: raw
```

## Config

| key | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `provider` | `ows` | `ows` (vault, EIP-191 only) or `raw` (private key from credential store, adds `signDigest`) |
| `chains` | `[evm]` | chain families to register this adapter for |
| `vaultPath` | OWS default (`~/.ows`) | vault directory root (`ows` only) |
| `accountIndex` | `0` | account index within each wallet's derivation path (`ows` only) |

## Extension points

- `internals.signer` — test seam replacing the native bindings with a fake
  `OwsSigner` (set before the plugin mounts; the native import never runs).
- `OwsEthereumCryptoAdapter` is exported for direct construction in bespoke
  compositions.
- `RawEthereumCryptoAdapter` (`./raw`) — the raw-key adapter behind
  `provider: raw`, exported for direct construction and unit testing.

## Model Experience

None: no tools, no prompt sections, no model-visible surface, token cost, or
KV-cache effect.

## Known Limitations and Deferred Work

- No per-wallet nonce management or same-wallet request serialization —
  matching the OWS concurrency stance; callers coordinate above the seam.
- EIP-7702 authorization signing (OWS `signAuthorization`) is not surfaced
  because the seam contract carries only Haven's message/transaction pair
  plus raw digests; extend the seam first when a consumer exists.
- EIP-712 typed-data signing on the `ows` path is unavailable (EIP-191 only);
  use `provider: raw` (`signDigest`) for EIP-712 gates such as Haven-AOL.
- The optional-peer range for `@open-wallet-standard/core` is `*` because the
  package tracks a young standard; pin a tested version in your profile.

# dsh-wallet

Wallet capability seam for DeepSeek Harness: `ctx.wallet` runs named wallets
over pluggable chain adapters. Configuration carries a credential *reference*
(`keyRef`, resolved through `ctx.credentials`), never a key — the secret value
exists only inside one operation, between resolution and the adapter call.

Concept lineage: haven-core's `WalletIdentity` machine ("the private key NEVER
leaves this machine boundary — other machines request signatures, they don't
access keys") and its `CryptoAdapter` port, translated to dsh seams. Haven's
`loadKey("env:VAR" | "0x…")` string is replaced by the dsh credential seam:
references in config, values at the operation boundary. There is no raw-key
config path at all — a pasted key fails the `CredentialRef` pattern at plugin
load with an actionable error.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add /path/to/dsh-wallet
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle`, so installing it activates its
`cordis.patch.yml` layer (one `wallet` row over `dsh-base`, whose
`credentials` row supplies the provider). Configure wallets in your profile's
`cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: wallet
  config:
    wallets:
      treasury:
        chain: evm
        wallet: agent-treasury           # provider-scoped selector (e.g. OWS vault wallet name)
        keyRef: HAVEN_WALLET_PASSPHRASE  # credential REFERENCE — never a key
```

Install one adapter bundle per chain family you sign on (e.g.
[`dsh-wallet-ethereum`](../dsh-wallet-ethereum/README.md) for `evm`).

## API

Service `ctx.wallet` (`WalletRuntime`, injects `credentials`):

- `register(chain, adapter): () => void` — provider registration with a
  stale-safe disposer. `adapter` implements the `CryptoAdapter` contract
  (`loadKey(source)` / `signMessage(keyMaterial, payload)` /
  `signTransaction(keyMaterial, payload)`; see `src/types.ts`).
- `list(): WalletInfo[]` — configured wallets with configuration facts only
  (`keyRefConfigured`, `adapterRegistered`); never secrets.
- `address(name): Promise<WalletAddress>` — derive the public address.
- `signMessage(name, payload)` / `signTransaction(name, payload)` —
  `Promise<{ address, signature }>`. Sign-only: broadcasting belongs to
  whoever holds the signed payload.
- `withLock(name, task)` — run `task` in the wallet's exclusive lane.
  Same-wallet tasks run strictly in call order, so a fetch-nonce →
  sign → send sequence wrapped here cannot share a nonce with a
  concurrent sender; different wallets proceed independently.

Every operation runs resolve → `loadKey` → sign → drop: `ctx.credentials
.resolve(keyRef)` is called inside the operation (never cached, per the
credentials-seam contract), the resolved value rides the operation-scoped
`WalletKeySource`, and no reference to it or to adapter `keyMaterial` survives
the call. A rotated credential reaches the very next signature without a
restart.

Errors are `WalletError` with stable codes: `wallet-not-found`,
`chain-unsupported`, `credential-unconfigured`, `invalid-key-ref`,
`duplicate-adapter`.

Event `wallet/signed` (emit) fires after each completed signing operation with
`{ wallet, chain, operation, address }` — identity facts for audit, never
material.

## Extension points

- Implement `CryptoAdapter` and `ctx.effect(() => ctx.wallet.register(chain,
  adapter))` from a provider plugin. What `WalletKeySource.secret` *means* is
  the adapter's custody model: OWS adapters treat it as the vault passphrase /
  `ows_key_…` token (the private key stays in the OWS vault); a raw-key
  adapter would treat it as key material.
- `wallet/signed` for audit trails.

## Model Experience

None directly: this package registers no tools and contributes no prompt
sections, so it has no model-visible surface, token cost, or KV-cache effect.
A separate tool plugin may expose signing to the model; gate it with policy
(e.g. `dsh-treasury`'s `tools/pre-execute` gate) before doing so.

## Known Limitations and Deferred Work

- No implicit nonce manager: signing calls stay unordered (matching the
  OWS concurrency stance) and callers needing strict transaction ordering
  wrap the whole fetch-nonce → sign → send sequence in `withLock(name,
  task)` — the seam orders, it never assigns nonces itself.
- No model-facing signing tool ships here by design — exposing signatures to
  the model is a deployment decision that belongs with an explicit policy
  gate.
- `address()` establishes a full signing context in adapters whose custody
  model requires authorization even for address derivation; a cheaper
  read-only path is deferred until an adapter needs it.

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-weather-badge · 天气预报插件

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）自定义插件：**Agent 工具 + 账号旁时钟天气徽章**。

- **时钟 + 天气表盘（打开界面直接显示，无需任何点击）**：侧栏底部**账号右侧**并排两枚表盘——衬线数字时钟（走秒）与天气表盘（天气图标 / 当前温度 / 湿度环）；账号下方一条横排信息条显示 `日期 · 星期`。点任一表盘在主区域展开完整天气面板，面板左上角「← 返回对话」回到对话。
- **左侧栏天气面板**：左侧栏图标列有天气图标，点一下天气卡片直接显示在主界面（与「插件」「定时任务」面板同一机制）。
- **右侧栏天气标签页**：右侧 Sidebar 引导页也有「天气预报」入口，可停靠/浮窗查看。
- **`weather` 工具（模型可调用）**：对话里问"明天上海穿什么"，模型会调用本工具查询实时天气与逐日预报，再组织回答。

数据来自三级自动切换的免费源：先 [Open-Meteo](https://open-meteo.com/)（无需 API Key，字段最全），失败退到 [MET Norway](https://api.met.no/)（CC-BY 4.0，10 天逐小时），再退到 [wttr.in](https://wttr.in/)（3 天、3 小时一档）；失败的源冷却 10 分钟不再重试，三家全挂时显示上次成功的缓存并标注「离线缓存」。城市搜索走 Open-Meteo geocoding，失败退 [Photon](https://photon.komoot.io/)，支持直接搜镇名（如「塘厦」/「塘厦镇」）；自动定位按公网 IP 取座标后，再用 [BigDataCloud](https://www.bigdatacloud.com/) 反向地理编码细化到乡镇/街道级（如「南城街道」「塘厦镇」），IP 服务依次回落 ipwho.is → geojs.io → ipinfo.io → ipapi.co；面板标题栏的「精确定位」按钮优先用系统 GPS 拿更准的座标；显示时间可切换为网络时间（timeapi.io，备用 Cloudflare trace）。

## 界面预览

侧栏底部账号右侧的常驻表盘（时钟 + 天气），账号下方是日期条：

![账号旁徽章](docs/badge.png)

完整天气面板（右上角「设置」可展开表盘主题、字体、时间源、日期条与两个表盘的形状）：

![天气面板](docs/panel.png)

## 使用

### 对话中（Agent 工具）

直接问天气即可，例如：

- 「今天天气怎么样？」→ 自动按网络位置细化到乡镇 / 街道
- 「查一下东京未来 5 天的天气」

工具参数：

| 参数 | 类型 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `city` | string | 城市或乡镇名（中文/英文/拼音均可，如 上海 / 塘厦镇）。省略时按网络位置细化定位 |
| `days` | integer | 预报天数 1–7，默认 3 |

### 界面显示

- **账号旁表盘（默认开启）**：侧栏底部账号右侧常驻两枚 64px 表盘，无需点击即可看到时间与当天天气；点任一表盘展开完整天气面板。
  - **时钟表盘**：12 个方位为阿拉伯衬线数字（等宽对齐，字体随「字体」设置切换：楷体 / 宋体 / Times / 黑体 / 等宽），12 / 3 / 6 / 9 用暖金强调；时针、分针、秒针分层粗细递增，针尖不接触数字。
  - **天气表盘**：上排天气图标、中间温度（单字符 ℃）、底部湿度进度条与百分比；底色按天气种类取三段浅→深同色系渐变（晴暖黄、夜蓝紫、雨蓝、雪青白、雷紫等）。
  - 账号下方是**日期条**：一条横排的「日期 · 星期」（如 2026年11月13日 · 星期五），可整条关闭。
  - 整体扁平化融入 Harness 界面：透明底、无发光 / 毛玻璃 / 投影，仅 hover 时淡灰底；徽章容器固定宽度，不会随每秒走秒重排。
  - **可切换的表盘主题**：天气面板「设置」里的「表盘主题」一行可选 6 款——白金 / 雾蓝 / 暖米 / 薄紫 / 石墨 / 青瓷。每款是完整的圆盘画面：白色到同色系浅彩的多段径向渐变面料 + 顶部高光 + 一道外圈细边 + 60 格刻度（每 5 格加粗）+ 12/3/6/9 暖金衬线数字 + 锥形指针（时针深墨、分针同色系、秒针红），浅色五款白底深字清晰可读，石墨款为深色底盘配浅字。全部为内联矢量，不依赖图片资源。选择写入 localStorage（dsh-weather-badge.dial.v3），账号旁徽章与面板预览即时同步，默认「白金」；
  - **字体可切换**：面板「字体」一行可选楷体 / 宋体 / Times / 黑体 / 等宽，徽章文字与表盘数字同步生效（localStorage `dsh-weather-badge.font.v1`）；
  - **数据源**：天气与预报按 Open-Meteo → MET Norway → wttr.in 三级自动切换（met.no 的 symbol_code 与 wttr 的 WWO 码都统一映射成 WMO 码，界面与徽章不分数据源一致显示）；失败源冷却 10 分钟，避免每次卡在超时上；三家全挂时回退到 localStorage 里最近一次成功的数据，页脚标注「离线缓存」。城市搜索 Open-Meteo geocoding → Photon（可搜镇名）；IP 定位依次回落 ipwho.is → geojs.io → ipinfo.io → ipapi.co，座标再经 BigDataCloud 反向编码细化到乡镇/街道，并支持「精确定位」按钮走系统 GPS；时间校准来自 timeapi.io（备用 Cloudflare trace），任何一家不可用都会自动换下一家；面板页脚会显示本次数据来自哪一家（MET Norway 按其 CC-BY 4.0 要求署名）；
- **设置收纳**：面板里的表盘主题、字体、时间源、日期条、两个表盘形状全部收进「设置」抽屉，点一下标题展开、再点收起，默认收起，展开状态记在 localStorage `dsh-weather-badge.settings-open.v1`；
- **时间源可切换**：面板「时间源」一行可选本机 / 网络——选网络时向授时接口取 UTC 与本机时钟的偏差并叠加到显示时间上，本机时钟不准也不会走偏，每 10 分钟重新校准一次；取不到网络时间时自动回退本机时钟。开关写入 localStorage `dsh-weather-badge.nettime.v1`，默认开启；
  - **时钟表盘形状可切换**：面板「时钟表盘」一行可选圆形 / 方形——方形是同一套渐变、外框、内衬与高光的圆角卡片版本，指针与数字位置不变，选择写入 localStorage `dsh-weather-badge.clockshape.v1`，默认圆形（主题缩略图同步跟随）；
  - **天气表盘形状可切换**：面板「天气表盘」一行可选圆形 / 方形——圆形与时钟表盘同规格（投影、外圈、内衬环、高光），方形为圆角卡片。两种布局内容一致（图标 / 温度 / 湿度进度条），选择写入 localStorage `dsh-weather-badge.wxshape.v1`，默认圆形；
  - **日期条可开关**：面板「日期条」一行选显示 / 隐藏。隐藏后账号下方那条「日期 · 星期」整条不渲染，不占高度（localStorage `dsh-weather-badge.info.v1`）；
- **左侧栏面板**：左侧栏图标列点**天气图标**，同样在主界面显示完整面板。
- **右侧栏标签页**：打开右侧 Sidebar → 引导页点「天气预报」；可停靠分栏或拖出浮窗。
- 首次打开自动按网络位置细化到乡镇 / 街道；点面板标题栏「精确定位」按钮可用系统 GPS 拿到更准的座标；也可直接在搜索框输入城市或乡镇名切换（如「塘厦镇」，选择会记住，存在浏览器 localStorage）；
- 徽章与卡片共享一份 5 分钟预报缓存；打开期间每 30 分钟自动刷新。

## 配置

在 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml` 中覆盖本插件条目的 `config`（注意：patch 层是整体替换 `config`，未写的字段回到代码默认值）：

```yaml
- id: dsh-weather-badge
  config:
    toolName: weather      # 工具名，默认 weather
    defaultCity: 上海       # 固定默认城市；设置后工具不再按 IP 定位（卡片仍可搜索切换）
    days: 3                # 工具默认预报天数 1-7
```

## 开发与测试

仓库自带无头单测：用 `node:vm` 装载整份 `lib/client.js`，以最小 DOM / React 替身跑组件，校验表盘主题、指针与数字、圆/方轮廓、时间解析、三级预报源切换与冷却、离线缓存、反向地理编码细化到乡镇/街道与镇名搜索回落，不需要打开 GUI。

```bash
node --test "tests/*.test.mjs"
```

## 安装

### 从 Git 安装（最新代码）

在 DSH 的**插件 → 已安装 → 添加插件**里选择「从链接安装」，填入：

```
git+https://github.com/henry1996-yl/dsh-weather-badge
```

要固定到某个提交（推荐，避免跟到未测试的改动）：

```
git+https://github.com/henry1996-yl/dsh-weather-badge#<40 位提交 SHA>
```

也可以在终端里安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add git+https://github.com/henry1996-yl/dsh-weather-badge
```

### 通过插件市场索引安装

本仓库自带一份符合插件市场索引格式 1 的索引文件 [`market/index.json`](market/index.json)。在**插件 → 发现 → 添加索引源**里填入它的地址：

```
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/henry1996-yl/dsh-weather-badge@main/market/index.json
```

如果 jsDelivr 不可用，可以改用 GitHub 直连地址：

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/henry1996-yl/dsh-weather-badge/main/market/index.json
```

添加后「发现」页即可搜到「天气徽章与时钟表盘」并直接安装；索引里固定了提交 SHA，安装的就是这份 README 对应的版本。

### 本地开发挂载

在 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.yml` 或 `package.json` 的 `bundles` 里把本目录作为 `link:` 依赖加入，然后重启 DSH 或禁用→启用本插件。

安装/更新后在**插件**页把本插件禁用再一次启用即可生效（无需重启应用）。
## 卸载

在插件管理里移除 `dsh-weather-badge` 即可；工具与侧栏卡片随插件停用一起消失。

## 实现说明

- **零依赖**：宿主端（`lib/index.js`）只用 Node 内置能力，注册原生 JSON-Schema 工具定义；客户端（`lib/client.js`）按 DSH 的 lazy-CJS bundle 协议手写，无需构建步骤。
- **宿主端**：`inject: ['tools']`，`ctx.tools.register(...)` 注册 `weather` 工具；与客户端共用同一套三级源（Open-Meteo → MET Norway → wttr.in）与冷却逻辑，城市搜索 Open-Meteo → Photon，IP 定位后同样用 BigDataCloud 反向编码细化到乡镇/街道并输出 admin2。
- **客户端**：`inject: ['slots', 'locale', 'sidebarRightTabs', 'sidebarRight']`，向右侧栏注册 `weather` 页类型 + 引导页入口，正文组件直接从浏览器请求上面三家源（都带 `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`，无需宿主代理）；另用 `ctx.inject(['layout'])` 拿布局句柄，实现徽章 ↔ 主面板切换。
- **账号旁徽章**：`settings.launcher` 席位只容纳账号菜单、没有并列扩展位，因此徽章按社区插件的 DOM 注入方式实现——找到 `div[class*="triggerRow"]` 里的账号按钮，在其后插入 `div.dshw-chip-host`（React 18 `createRoot` 渲染）；容器可收缩（`flex:0 1 auto` + `min-width:0`），窄栏时压缩自身而不是溢出盖住账号；侧栏折叠成图标栏（宽度 < 150px）时整枚徽章隐藏；`MutationObserver` 跟随重渲染重新落位，插件停用时 `unmount` + 移除节点。
- 中英文文案随界面语言切换（`zh` / `en` 词典内置于客户端 bundle）。

## 已知限制

- 公网 IP 定位只能拿到市级座标，乡镇/街道名依赖 BigDataCloud 反向地理编码（CORS 开放、无需 API Key）；IP 出口常与实际所在地不同（例如出口在「南城街道」而人在「塘厦镇」），要精确到某个镇请直接搜索镇名（如「塘厦镇」）或点「精确定位」用系统 GPS。反向服务不可用时自动退回市级名，卡片提示改用城市搜索，工具提示传 `city` 参数。
- 三家源都是第三方公共服务，极端情况下可能限流；任一限流会自动切换，全部不可用则显示缓存。
- MET Norway 数据许可为 [CC-BY 4.0](https://www.met.no/en/About-us/service-and-data-policy)，按许可要求在面板页脚与 `weather` 工具输出里署名。

decision.reason: Static evidence chain reviewed. Reviewed via the documented fixed-SHA Git source: MIT repository/package, same-commit manifest/patch and both entry files match, no lifecycle hooks. engines.dsh declares 0.2.2-rc.2 to below 0.3.0-0. Native weather tool bounds days to 1-7, propagates abort signals and uses fixed weather/geocoding providers. Client and host disclose IP geolocation, coordinate disclosure, provider fallbacks and MET Norway attribution; caches and DOM clock UI are not runtime-tested. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# User Prompt Markdown（`@local/dsh-enhanced-prompt`） 最后实质性修改于Harness版本：0.2.2-rc.3 让 **DeepSeek Harness 的用户 prompt 气泡**走与模型回复完全相同的 Markdown 渲染管线。 用户 prompt 中的 GFM 表格、代码高亮、TeX 公式与块级结构都按与模型回复相同的规则渲染；`@文件` / `/技能` / `@会话` 引用渲染为 chip，其中当前仅 `@文件` 已接线可点击打开；在已发送的 prompt 中选中文本时，官方「引用文本」按钮照常出现，引用发送后显示为紧凑预览。 ## 效果 | 特性 | 效果 | | --- | --- | | 文本渲染 | `MarkdownText`（与模型回复同一个组件） | | `# 标题`、`- 列表`、`**粗体**` | 正常渲染 | | 围栏代码块 | 语法高亮 + 复制按钮 | | `@文件` / `/技能` / `@会话` 引用 chip | 已渲染为 chip；当前仅 `@文件` 可点击打开 | | 选中 prompt 文本 | 官方「引用文本」按钮照常出现，可把选区插入 composer | | `> 引用` 行 | 渲染为官方 `QuotePreview` 紧凑预览；悬停显示全文 | | 气泡宽度 | 与模型输出区等宽 | | 复制按钮 | 复制**原始 Markdown 源文本**（同一份内容） | ## 工作原理 用户 prompt 的渲染由可组合的 Factory 与 keyed 槽位组成： ``` conversation.chat.node[user] → UserMessageNodeView → renderFactorySlot("conversation.chat.user.content", …) → UserContent → renderFactorySlot("conversation.user.text", …) → UserText → renderSlot("conversation.user.text.node", { node, raw, interactive }) key "text" → PlainUserText → UserTextRun key "file" / "folder" / "session" / … → 引用 chip key "quote" → QuotedUserText → QuotePreview（0.2.2 起） ``` **内置解析器在 Markdown 解析前就按引用切开文本**，因此逐段渲染会破坏跨 chip 的块结构：列表项里出现 `@a.ts` 时，前半段自成一篇 `
    `、后半段自成一篇 `

    `，chip 夹在两个块之间，前后各换行。这不是 CSS 能修的。 本插件采用**整条消息一篇文档**的渲染方式： 1. 接管 `conversation.chat.node` 的 `user` / `steering`； 2. 用 `uiConversation.userText.createEvaluator()`（与内置同一套规则）求出 `{id,start,end}` 节点； 3. 把每个非文本区间替换成私用区哨兵，拼成**一篇** Markdown 源； 4. `MarkdownText` 渲染一次； 5. 在渲染结果里把哨兵换回真正的 `ReferenceChip` 或 `QuotePreview`。 chip 于是落在 `

  • ` 内部，列表、有序编号、代码围栏、`text-indent` 全部由**一次**解析决定；`> ` 行则由 0.2.2 的 `quote` 规则单独接管，见下。 0.2.2 的 `dsh-message-quotes` 会向同一个求值器注册 `quote` 规则：显式 `> ` 行变成带解码文本的 `quote` 节点。它也走同一条哨兵管线，最终渲染为官方 `QuotePreview`；引用前后的 `\n\n` 保留在 Markdown 源里，因此预览保持自己的块位置，不会合并两侧的块。 气泡本身带有 `data-text-interaction-source`，这是官方 Chat 选区层用来接纳「引用文本」操作的标记；原生 `UserContent` / `UserMessageBubble` 用的是同一个标记。插件只提供这个接入面，按钮、选区交互与 composer 插入仍由官方 `dsh-message-quotes` 负责。 附件仍由内置 `conversation.chat.user.content` Factory 绘制（传空文本时它只输出附件栏，图片走内置 `conversation.chat.user.images`），额外内容块与引用摘要由本插件补齐。 ### 关键约束 1. **priority 必须低于内置的 0。** keyed cell 渲染 **priority 最小**的存活条目；同 key 同 priority 会**直接抛错**而不是覆盖。本插件用 `-1`，测试里有显式断言。 2. **哨兵替换是命令式的。** `MarkdownText` 的 props 只有 `{text, streaming, labels, fileMentions, pathImages, variant}`，**没有 children 插槽**，无法在 React 树里注入 chip。因此 Markdown 输出挂在一个由本插件独占的 `react-dom` root 里（宿主 `

    ` 从不交给 React 管 children），在**该 root 提交之后**的 `useLayoutEffect` 里替换哨兵，再用 `createPortal` 把每个 chip 或 quote preview 渲染进占位 `span`。 3. **样式用本插件自己的 `dep-` 类名**；唯一按 CSS Module **稳定局部名**匹配的是附件栏的「加宽」规则（`[class*="_userStack"]`，不是每次构建都会变的哈希）。官方消息气泡改用其显式标记 `[data-message-bubble]`，不再用 `_bubble` 类名子串——primitives 的 Tooltip 气泡同样是 `_bubble_*`，且是 `position:fixed`，被加宽规则误中会撑到 `max-width`。即使失配，也只是宽度退回原样，不影响渲染。 ## 没有开关 按设计，本插件**不提供设置项**，也不在「设置 → 通用」里增加任何行： - **启用即生效**，一经运行就始终重写 prompt 样式； - **停用方式**＝在插件页禁用（或卸载）本插件。Client 半的注册与样式都挂在自己的 fiber 上，卸载时一并释放，内置渲染器立刻接管回来。 ## 安装 插件需要接入 profile 才能在应用内生效（两步，均为既有机制）： 1. `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json`： - `dependencies` 增加 `"@local/dsh-enhanced-prompt": "link:/Users/hanluica/Documents/deepseek-harness/local-plugins/dsh-enhanced-prompt"` - `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组加入 `"@local/dsh-enhanced-prompt"` 2. 在 profile 目录执行 `pnpm install`。 装载条目由本插件自带的 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `insert` 提供，bundle 机制会自动叠加，无需手工编辑 profile patch。 > **必须重启 Host**：profile 的 bundle 列表在 Host 启动时合成，无法在进程内重试。重启后再刷新 GUI。 ## 依赖与构建 插件当前面向 DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` 及以后（本次审查与合并验证于 `0.2.2-rc.3`）：`package.json` 的 `peerDependencies["@deepseek-ai/dsh"]` 为 `^0.2.2-rc.1`，`dsh.client.inject` 同时声明 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation` 与 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`。 Host 半**零导入**：`index.js` 只导出 `ENTRY_ID` 和一个空的 `apply()`，存在的意义是给 Loader 条目一个可挂载的模块。这是刻意的设计——Host 半一旦 import 了 profile 不提供的包，插件就会变成「已启用但未运行」（`fiberPhase: null`），而且 Node 会**永久缓存**这次导入失败，只能重启重试。 所以本插件**不携带 `node_modules/`，也没有依赖锁**：没有依赖就没有可锁的东西，而一棵不存在的树不可能藏着断链、过期版本或没人声明的包。`npm run build` 在依赖声明为空时会**删除**任何出现的 `node_modules/`，`verify` 也会把它判为失败。 ### 命令 | 命令 | 作用 | | ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | `npm run verify` | 一个命令回答「这插件现在健康吗」：真实文件不变量、清单契约、`node --check`、**Host 半零导入 + `ENTRY_ID`**，以及下面的 `npm test` | | `npm test` | `test/lifecycle.test.mjs`：Client 半的生命周期与渲染回归（64 项检查，不需要应用在场） | | `npm run build` | 清掉 macOS 边角文件与任何 `node_modules/`，然后跑 `verify`——本插件没有可物化的依赖 | | `npm run clean` | 删除 `node_modules/`（若存在）与 `.cache/` | `verify` 把 `npm test` 当作「行为测试」一并跑掉：它不重复实现测试，只跑 `package.json` 里声明的那条命令。 ### `verify` 检查什么 - 整个插件目录**没有符号连接、没有 Finder 替身（按 `book` 魔术字识别）、没有 `.DS_Store`/`._*`**。 - 清单契约：`exports` 的每个目标、`dsh.bundle.patch`、`dsh.client`、`locale/en.json` 锚点、图标大小（≤256 KiB）、`files[]`；patch 里的 `id` 必须等于 Host 半导出的 `ENTRY_ID`（改名会让 profile 挂载不到，也等于换了身份）。 - `index.js` 与 `client.js` 能被 `node --check` 解析。 - **Host 半在一个全新进程里真的能导入**，而且 `index.js` 源码里**没有任何 `import`**——这一条用源码断言，不靠「导入成功」去推断，因为后者在依赖缺失时可能只是因为恰好没走到那条语句。 - 没有依赖声明时：`node_modules/` 必须不存在、也不该出现锁文件。 ### 构建系统与它的参考副本 本插件的 `scripts/` 是一套完整构建系统（依赖物化 + 不变量检查），它跟着插件走，所以这个目录单独复制出去仍能构建与自检；整体说明见工作区根目录的 [`BUILD-SYSTEM.md`](../BUILD-SYSTEM.md)。 其中除 `host-contract.mjs` 之外的 5 个文件（`build.mjs`、`verify.mjs`、`lib/fsx.mjs`、`lib/tar.mjs`、`lib/probe-runner.mjs`）是根目录 [`build-system/scripts/`](../build-system/scripts) 这份**参考副本**的逐字节副本：改构建系统要改参考副本，再 `node build-system/sync.mjs` 同步下来。`verify` 每次都核对这件事，不一致会指名并给出那句命令。 `scripts/host-contract.mjs` 是**本插件自己的**（`sync` 永不覆盖）：它断言 `ENTRY_ID`、`apply()` 可被调用，以及——本插件最要紧的一条——**`index.js` 源码里没有任何 `import`**。最后这条刻意用源码断言而非「导入成功」反推：依赖缺失时的导入失败会被 Node 永久缓存，只有源码层面的「零导入」才是这个插件真正承诺的东西。`verify` 会把它们的每一条连同通用不变量一起打印。 ## 已知行为与限制 这些都是设计取舍或平台现状，不是缺陷： - **单个换行会被合并。** 这是标准 Markdown 语义（软换行 = 空格），与模型回复的表现一致——因为按约定使用了 `body` 变体，与回复"同权"。需要强制换行时用空行分段，或行尾加两个空格。 - **只对落定消息生效。** 提交瞬间的乐观回显气泡不经过 chat node，仍由内置组件绘制，因此到落定那一刻才切换为 Markdown。 - **队列预览与 `/goal` 命令气泡不生效。** 它们走共享的 `conversation.user.text`，本插件不接管那条路径。 - **引用预览按块位置显示。** 原生纯文本流会把引用前后的 `\n\n` 显示成空格；本插件保留 Markdown 块边界，因此 `QuotePreview` 独占一个段落，不会合并引用两侧的块。这是为了不让引用破坏列表、表格与代码围栏等结构。 - **代码围栏内的 `> …` 仍降级为原文。** 引用规则在 Markdown 之前运行，可能把围栏里的 `>` 行识别成引用；哨兵落在 `pre`/`code` 内时会放回原始 token，因此预览不出现但文本不丢，与 chip 的围栏降级同源。 - **「引用文本」按钮由官方插件拥有。** 本插件只把增强气泡标记为 `data-text-interaction-source`；选区判断、按钮文案、Session 可写限制与 composer 插入都由 `dsh-message-quotes` 负责，插件没有自己的引用实现。 - **chip 在代码围栏内降级为原文。** 解析器不知道围栏边界，可能把围栏里的 `@x` 当成引用；替换时若哨兵落在 `pre`/`code` 内，会放回原始 token 而不是插入一个块级 chip。唯一例外是 `secret`：它回落的是 `data.masked`，因此密钥原文不会因围栏降级而回到气泡里。 - **`/skill` chip 目前不可点击。** chat node owner props 不提供 `openSkill`，因此 skill chip 渲染为不可交互的样式。文件 chip 仍可点击打开。 - **`@session` / `folder` / `command` chip 保持非交互**——与内置渲染器一致。 - **升级风险。** 本插件接管整个 chat node 渲染，`MarkdownText` 的 props、`conversation.user.text` 的节点形状、或 `uiConversation` 服务一旦变动都会影响它。`uiConversation` 未出现在公开服务目录里，属于未编目 API。渲染抛错时槽位错误边界会**静默 abdicate**（只在浏览器控制台留一行 `slot entry crashed in ...`），界面回落到内置纯文本——遇到"插件已启用但 prompt 没变化"，先看控制台。 - **与「用户 CSS」插件叠加是预期行为。** 若那边写了 `div[class*="markdown"] > p { … }` 之类的规则，会命中用户气泡内的 Markdown 容器——这正是 `text-indent` 能生效的前提。需要区分时可改用本插件的 `.dep-bubble` 类名。 ## 文件 ``` dsh-enhanced-prompt/ ├── package.json # exports["./client"] + dsh.bundle + dsh.client + 构建脚本 ├── cordis.patch.yml # 装载条目 ├── index.js # Host 半：无状态、无设置、零导入 ├── client.js # Client 半：全部功能 ├── icon.svg ├── locale/{zh,en}.json # 插件页显示名 ├── scripts/ # 构建与不变量检查（共享文件是根目录 build-system/ 参考副本的逐字节副本） ├── test/lifecycle.test.mjs # 无需应用的逻辑回归 ├── README.md └── FEASIBILITY@*.md # 按 DSH 版本归档的可行性记录 ``` **没有 `node_modules/`，也没有 `deps.lock.json`**——见「[依赖与构建](#依赖与构建)」：Host 半零导入，所以这里不该有依赖树。 ## 静态验证状态 一条命令跑完全部检查（真实文件不变量 + 清单契约 + Host 半导入 + 行为测试）： ```bash npm run verify ``` 其中行为测试是 `npm test`（也就是 `node test/lifecycle.test.mjs`），在 React / DOM / Cordis 桩下跑真实 `client.js`，**64 项检查全部通过**，覆盖： - 工厂契约与 `inject` 列表、样式标签归属、`user` / `steering` 两个 cell 以 `priority: -1` 注册； - **组合逻辑**：列表项里的 chip 不切断文档（`- 检查 @a.ts 的实现` 组成单一 Markdown 源）、引用节点保留 `\n\n` 块边界、无引用时原样、多个 chip、求值器抛错时回落、重叠匹配跳过； - **chip 映射**：file/folder/session/skill/command/secret 各自的外观与激活，`quote` 映射到 `QuotePreview` 且传入解码文本、未知类型回落原文，缺少 opener 时不加交互（`secret` 由 `dsh-client-ui-secret-mask` 的凭据扫描规则产生，节点数据为 `{ masked }`；Host 鉴权提示的 `{ message, placeholder }` 是另一套 `AuthorizationPrompt` 类型，不进入这里的用户文本节点）； - **哨兵替换**：文本/chip/文本三段、用户原文里的字面哨兵被转义、`pre`/`code` 内普通 chip 回落原文（`secret` 回落 `data.masked`，不显示密钥原文）、未知哨兵保留、纯文本直通； - 样式表关键规则（含气泡加宽只匹配 `data-message-bubble`、不再使用 `_bubble` 类名子串），以及当前 API 契约的回归守卫（包括气泡的 `data-text-interaction-source` 与 `QuotePreview` 来源）。 `mountMarkdown` 依赖真实浏览器（`createRoot` / `TreeWalker`），不在 Node 桩里执行。 已接入 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`（link 依赖 + bundles 条目），`@local/dsh-enhanced-prompt`、`/client`、`/locale/*.json` 均已验证可解析。 `verify` 覆盖不到的那几项只能靠眼睛：重启应用后发一条**列表项内含文件引用**的 prompt，确认 chip 前后不换行、缩进只出现一次、chip 可点击打开文件；再在一条已发送的 prompt 中选中文本，确认「引用文本」按钮出现，点击后引用进入 composer，发送后显示为紧凑预览且悬停可见全文。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# DeepSeek-memory-partner（DSMP）

把「记忆引擎 + 桌面聊天面板」合并成一个 DSH 插件的单包实现。包名 `@local/dsmp`，显示名 **DeepSeek-memory-partner**。

> 当前进度：**M0 骨架 + M1/M1b 本地聊天与记忆注入 + M2 QQ 通道 + M3 媒体 + M4 历史/设置/工作台 + M5 迁移/记忆包/打包 + M6 单写者租约 + M7 搬家归位 + M8 记忆目录自包含设计 + M9 记忆写操作并入 + P1 听 QQ 语音 + B1 一键换机 + B2 面板备份/恢复 + B3 她说过的语音 + D 健壮性 + 情境索引显示修复（1.8.1）+ C 发布准备（1.9.0）+ A3 面板体检/命名统一（1.9.2）+ QQ 语音转写（1.10.0）+ QQ bridge 并入 / components 归位（2.0.0）**。侧边栏「记忆面板」+ 四页签（聊天 / 历史记录 / 记忆速览 / 设置）。
>
> **M9（1.2.0）新增**：「记忆」页签不只读，还能改——长期事实逐条「编辑 / 作废 / 恢复 / 历史（修订链）」、待确认候选「确认 / 驳回」、激活开关（enabled / emit / rankInInject / recordRetrieved / toneResidue / toneSummary / matchTokens）。所有写操作走 `POST /api/dsmp/workbench/write`，统一守卫：迁移中 409、租约非本机 409、只写 `memory.dir`、写前备份到 `backup/*.bak-dsmp-*`、写后审计到 `logs/dsmp-workbench-audit.jsonl`。
>
> **测试期规矩（主人 2026-11-06 定，2026-11-08 P2 已收口）**：M1–M6 开发期只测试、不实际接入，那时默认 `test.enabled = true`。P2 收口后 `test.enabled = false`，账本、注入与媒体都落生产目录 `<DSMP_MEMORY_DIR>`；面板直连驱动同一条 QQ 会话（`session.via = auto`），QQ 侧仍由 bridge 传输。
>
> **安装位置**：插件实体在 `<DSMP_PLUGIN_ROOT>`。旧开发路径 `<DSMP_WORKSPACE>\plugins\dsmp` 已于 2026-11-08 随旧目录一起退役，现位于 `<DSMP_WORKSPACE>\_retired\`（观察 7 天后删除）。

## English summary

**DeepSeek-memory-partner (DSMP)** is a single DeepSeek Harness plugin that bundles a long-term memory engine with a desktop chat panel. It keeps what the owner said (facts, preferences, plans, dates), injects a compact memory card into every agent step, and lets you read or edit that memory inside the Harness UI.

- **What it installs** — one host plugin (`@local/dsmp`) with a web client: a sidebar item **Chat** with four tabs (Chat / History / Memory / Settings), plus seven native `dsmp_memory_*` tools: `search`, `recall`, `window`, `write`, `edit`, `photo`, `todo`.
- **What it needs** — DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.2.1-rc.2`, Node `>= 22.13`, and no npm runtime dependencies; the memory engine ships as a vendored copy under `vendor/memory/`.
- **Three commands** (Windows, run inside the plugin folder):

  ```cmd
  :: 1) link the plugin into the desktop profile (plus bundles entry, see 安装)
  mklink /J "%DSH_HOME%\profiles\desktop\node_modules\@local\dsmp" "%CD%"
  :: 2) run the test suite
  node --test test/*.test.mjs
  :: 3) build the installable tarball
  node scripts/pack.mjs
  ```

- **Boundary** — memory lives only under the data directory you configure (`settings.memory.dir`); the panel reads and writes nothing else. QQ delivery stays with qq-bridge: DSMP queues and records, it does not send to QQ on its own. No telemetry, no outbound network calls except the local Harness and the optional local QQ bridge.

## 5 分钟上手

1. **装插件**（三种落点见下面「安装」）：`dependencies` 写 `link:`、`dsh.profile.bundles` 追加 `@local/dsmp`、在 profile 的 `node_modules\@local\dsmp` 建 junction。刷新页面，侧边栏出现「聊天」。
2. **打开面板**：点侧边栏「聊天」→「设置」→ 确认「记忆目录」指向你要用的数据目录（第一次装建议先指向一个空目录试）；「模型」选默认 provider/model。
3. **发一条本地消息**：回到「聊天」，输入「你好，记住我喜欢喝美式」并回车。回复下方应出现「记忆已注入：事实 N 条 · 卡 X 字 · 规则 Y 字」。
4. **看到记忆注入**：切到「记忆」页签 →「长期事实」应能看到这条事实（或候选）；「窗口回放」里应有刚才这一轮。用 `curl "http://127.0.0.1:<端口>/api/dsmp/memory/preview?text=我喜欢喝什么"` 可看到完整注入文本。
5. **确认工具**：在会话里让她调用 `dsmp_memory_recall`（问「我上次说的咖啡是什么」），返回应带 `⟵ 窗口…轮…` 锚点；点开「历史记录」能看到同一轮。

> 没有装 QQ bridge 也能跑完这五步——面板直连 DSH 会话，QQ 只影响「QQ 通道」卡片。

## 安装

DSH 的 profile 在 `<DSH_HOME>\profiles\desktop`（`DSH_HOME` 由启动器决定，不要假设是用户主目录下的 `.dsh`）。三个落点都要有：

1. `profiles/desktop/package.json` 的 `dependencies` 增加：
   ```json
   "@local/dsmp": "link:<DSMP_PLUGIN_ROOT>"
   ```
2. 同一个文件的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组追加 `"@local/dsmp"`。
3. 建立 junction：
   ```cmd
   mklink /J "<DSH_HOME>\profiles\desktop\node_modules\@local\dsmp" "<DSMP_PLUGIN_ROOT>"
   ```

也可以让 CLI 代劳（会跑 pnpm，需要能写 profile 目录）：

```cmd
"<DSH_HOME>\app\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add "<DSMP_PLUGIN_ROOT>"
```

装完刷新页面即可（实测 `bundles` 变更会被宿主热加载：约 2 秒卸载、4 秒重载；客户端 UI 需要刷新页面重新拉插件清单）。**用 CLI 升级/重装后仍需完全退出并重开 DSH**，热加载只对 bundle 清单的增删有效。

### 验证

```cmd
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:<当前端口>/api/dsmp/status
curl -s "http://127.0.0.1:<当前端口>/api/dsmp/memory/preview?text=hello"
```

`status` 应返回 `ok: true`、`packageName: "@local/dsmp"`、`version`（与 `package.json` 一致）、`mode`（`local` / `degraded` / `qq`）、`test.enabled` 与 `test.memoryDir`。`memory/preview` 返回即将注入的完整 prompt、各段长度与事实条数。

## 记忆排序：重要度分（1.14.0）

- **一个分数**：`score = 100 × W × R`。`W = 0.55×I + 0.45×档位基值 + 作者/类别/提及次数的小加成`（hard 1.0 / long 0.85 / general 0.6 / temp 0.35），`R` 仍是时间衰减；hard 不衰减。分数读取时计算，不写回 `longterm.jsonl`。
- **分档**：核心 ≥80 / 重要 60–79 / 一般 40–59 / 边缘 <40，只用于展示与筛选。
- **面板「长期事实」**：默认按分数排，`正常 → 旧事 → 已作废` 分组；每行显示分数、档位、档位名、提及次数、最近几天；顶部有「全部 / 核心 / 重要 / 一般 / 旧事 / 已作废」筛选与 50 条一页的「显示更多」。
- **检索**：`memory.scoring.ranking.applyToSearch` 默认 `false`（保留旧公式，只多回一个 `importance` 字段）。改成 `true` 后档位不再单独 ×1000，改为「结构命中 6000–8000 + 命中 500 + score×4 + 提及次数×10」——先保证问什么有什么，同一类命中里再按重要度排。打开前先用 `route-preview` 对比真实问法。
- **卡面**：注入事实卡维持 `I×1000 + 档位×100 + 提及次数` 的稳定排序，不受当天衰减影响。

## 面板直发（2026-11-07）

聊天页的「当前对话」就是 QQ 正在用的那条 DSH 会话。面板里打字不会另起一个 agent，而是经 bridge 投进去：

```
面板输入 → POST /api/dsmp/chat/send
        → 命中 bridge 会话 → POST <bridge>/api/socialV2/panel-message（控制台令牌）
        → bridge 组 prompt（【来自桌面面板 · 不发 QQ】+【面板消息】<text>）→ 同一会话
        → 回复是普通 assistant 文本，不会调用任何 QQ 发送工具
```

- 开关：`settings.panel.liveSend`（默认 `true`），关掉后对当前对话发送返回 `403 面板直发未开启`。
- 当前对话不支持从面板发图（返回 400，明确提示改用测试会话），避免把图片塞进 QQ 侧流程。
- `GET /api/dsmp/history/sessions` 会向 bridge 查当前会话映射并标 `bridgeLive`，所以 `closed-agent`/`reserved2` 切模式后「当前对话」仍指向真正在用的那条。
- 会话日志解析：`【面板消息】` 之后才是主人原话；QQ 入站的整段提示按 `【管理员】…` 这类发送者行截断，气泡只显示对方说的话。

## 本地服务控制（2026-11-07）

设置页「本地服务」卡片可以手动开关三样东西，只调用已有脚本、不修改任何服务配置：

| 服务 | 端口 | 启动 | 关闭 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| QQ 机器人（SnowLuma + bridge） | 3100 | `start-bot.cmd` | `stop-bot.cmd` |
| ComfyUI（ComfyUI API） | 8188 | `scripts\start-comfy-api.cmd` | `scripts\stop-comfy-api.cmd` |
| GPT-SoVITS（语音合成） | 9880 | `scripts\start-tts-api.cmd` | `scripts\stop-tts-api.cmd` |

- 按钮只对「未运行 / 运行中」做启动或关闭，启动是 `%SystemRoot%\System32\cmd.exe /c <脚本>` 分离进程（`detached`），**stdout/stderr 写到 `<DSH_HOME>\dsmp\logs\service-<name>.log`**，不再吞掉错误。
- 2026-11-07 修复：宿主（Electron）进程的环境块可能早于用户终端，`PATH` 里未必有 `WindowsPowerShell\v1.0`，脚本里的 `powershell` 会直接报「不是内部或外部命令」。现在 spawn 时显式构造 `PATH`（`C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7` → `%SystemRoot%\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0` → `System32` → `%SystemRoot%` → 原 PATH 去重），并用绝对路径的 `cmd.exe`，所以面板不再依赖宿主 `PATH`。卡片上每个服务多一个「日志」按钮，失败时也会把日志末尾直接显示出来。
- 本机 PowerShell 现状（2026-11-07）：系统自带 `powershell.exe` 仍是 **5.1.26100.9444**；另装了 **PowerShell 7.6.9**（`C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe`，MSI 静默安装）。注意以后台方式跑 `winget install Microsoft.PowerShell` 会失败（`0x80070422`，本机 `wuauserv` 被禁用），MSI 安装不依赖该服务。脚本内的 `powershell` 仍解析到 5.1；要用 7 就把脚本里的 `powershell` 换成 `pwsh`（两版语法在本项目用到的命令上兼容）。
- **10 分钟空闲自动关闭**由 bridge 自己维持（`imageGen.idleStopProcessMs`、`socialV2.tts.idleStopMs` 都是 600000）；面板额外兜底：bridge 不在线时，面板启动的引擎满 10 分钟会被 `services.startIdleWatch` 关掉，避免留下没人用的进程。
- QQ 机器人已在运行时点「启动」不会重复拉起，返回 `already:true`。
- 脚本目录取自 `settings.bridge.dir`（默认 `<DSMP_BRIDGE_DIR>`），换机时改这一项即可。
- **2026-11-07 二次修复：按钮结果以前只看「脚本启动成功」，不看端口**。现在启动会等端口真正监听（bridge 最长 90s、ComfyUI 120s、其它引擎 60s），关闭会等脚本退出（`stop-bot.cmd` 约 10s）再等端口真正关闭，返回里带 `running`；没到位就回 `ok:false` + 日志末尾，不再出现「点了关闭、看着像成功、其实还在跑」。
- 关闭失败的根因在 `stop-bridge.cmd`：它原来只杀「命令行里带 `DSH-QQ-bridge` 路径」的 `cmd.exe`，但监督进程是 `cmd.exe /c start-bridge.cmd`（相对名），匹配不到 → 桥接被杀后 5 秒内被监督进程重新拉起。该脚本已改为「按脚本名匹配 + 连 `start-bot.cmd` 一起杀 + 杀监听 3100 的 pid + 三轮复查」。
- 另一个坑：`state\bridge.lock` 里记的 pid 活着但 3100 没监听（半死桥接）时，新启动会判「已有实例在运行」直接退出。`services.startService` 现在会先 `clearStaleLock()`（杀该 pid 再删锁）。
- **改完 `lib/*.js` 必须完整重启 DSH**：bundle 开关只会重新执行 `apply()`，不会重新 import 模块（ESM 缓存），面板里跑的还是旧代码。改 `lib/client.js` 只需刷新页面。
- **2026-11-07 三次修复：不再刷一屏 PowerShell 窗口**。`start-bot.cmd` 原来分六次调 `powershell`、`stop-bot.cmd` 分四次 `call` 子脚本，每次都会闪一个控制台。现在两个入口各自只起**一个** PowerShell 进程（`scripts\dsmp-boot.ps1` / `scripts\dsmp-halt.ps1`，带 `-WindowStyle Hidden`），子步骤（SnowLuma、bridge）用 `Start-Process -WindowStyle Hidden` 拉起；面板侧的 spawn 也改成非 detached（`CREATE_NO_WINDOW`），整棵进程树共用一个不可见控制台。交互运行 `start-bot.cmd` 仍会打开 SnowLuma WebUI，面板触发时（`DSMP_HEADLESS=1`）不打开浏览器。

| 路由 | 方法 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/api/dsmp/services` | GET | 三个服务的端口探测、脚本存在性、空闲阈值 |
| `/api/dsmp/services?log=qq` | GET | 读该服务脚本日志末尾（最多 20000 字） |
| `/api/dsmp/services` | POST | `{action:'start'|'stop',name:'qq'|'draw'|'tts'}`，失败时回 `error`/`code`/`tail` |

注意：**生成/合成能力本身没有接进面板**。ComfyUI 的出图与 GPT-SoVITS 的合成都走 bridge 的 `send-image` / `tts` 端点，而这些端点在 reserved2 模式下要求 `x-agent-token` 且会把结果直接发到 QQ；面板只做到「开/关引擎 + 状态」，不越权调用。要真正在面板里生成图片/试听语音，需要另开一个不发送、只返回文件的本机端点（属 bridge 侧改动，需主人点头）。

## 历史与工作台（M4）

历史页签不另存聊天记录，每次都从 DSH 的会话日志读：

| 路由 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /api/dsmp/history/sessions?limit=` | 列出 `<DSH_HOME>/sessions/**` 下的会话（首帧取 cwd/预设，按 mtime 倒序） |
| `GET /api/dsmp/history?sessionId=&limit=&before=&q=` | 逐帧解压会话日志还原气泡；`before` 是游标，`q` 是关键字 |

解析要点：日志是**多帧 zstd、每帧一行 JSON**（`zlib.zstdDecompressSync` 只解首帧，所以自己走帧头）；她真正发出去的话在 `mcp__snowluma__qq_send_message` 的 `tool/call` 参数里，同一 turn 里这段一旦出现，就丢掉她没发出去的工作笔记；用户气泡优先取 `【本次消息快照】` 里的原文。

记忆页签：

| 路由 | 视图 |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /api/dsmp/workbench?view=facts` | 长期事实（现存/旧事、槽位、作者、I） |
| `view=topics` | 主题簇与事实数 |
| `view=window&sessionId=&from=&to=&limit=` | 窗口回放（主人原话 / 她说的 / 当时的想法）；`from`/`to` 限定轮次 |
| `view=episodes` | 情境索引（标题 + 场景 + 主题 + 轮次；按 `atTo` 新→旧；每段可「展开原文」跳到窗口回放） |
| `view=usage` | 消费（只统计 `k=turn`，不含 `base` 基线） |
| `view=recall&q=` | 真跑 smart 检索，含空结果诊断 |
| `view=claims` | 待确认纠正（当前为 0） |

情境段在磁盘上是 `episodes/<年-月>.jsonl`，真实行用 `title` / `scene` / `topics` / `atFrom` / `atTo` / `summarized` 描述，没有单独的 `summary` 字段。`episodesView()` 会把 `title：scene` 合成展示摘要、用 `atTo` 排序，并保留对旧 `summary` 行的兼容；只有 `summarized:false` 且没有叙事时面板才显示「（未摘要）」。

**从摘要回到原文**有三条路：① 事实行的 `⟵ 窗口 … 轮 a–b（8 位）` 可以直接交给 `dsmp_memory_window`，会话 id 给 8 位前缀即可；② 注入里的情境段行尾带 `（#ep-xxxxxxxx-nn）`，把它作为 `episodeId` 传给 `dsmp_memory_window`，轮次范围会自动带上；③ 面板「情境索引」每段有「展开原文」，跳到「窗口回放」并只显示那段轮次。月摘要、七天交接、事实卡本身不带锚点，仍需先经 ① / ② 或按日期检索。

| `POST /api/dsmp/models` | 写 `settings.chat.{provider,model}`，下一轮生效 |
| `GET /api/dsmp/roles?name=` | 列角色卡 + 读某张卡全文（附带 `mirror` 镜像摘要） |
| `POST /api/dsmp/roles` | 保存人设卡（≤30000 字，写前自动备份 `.bak-dsmp-*`），保存后自动同步镜像 |
| `DELETE /api/dsmp/roles?name=` | 删除人设卡（先留 `.bak-dsmp-*` 备份；不能删当前正在用的那张），删除后镜像同步清理 |
| `GET /api/dsmp/roles/sync` | 只看镜像状态（目录、张数、当前角色、上次同步时间） |
| `POST /api/dsmp/roles/sync` | 立即把人设卡同步到 `<记忆目录>\roles\` |

### 人设卡镜像（2026-11-07）

人设卡的原件在 bridge 的 `roles\`，插件会把它们复制一份到**记忆目录**里：

```
<DSMP_MEMORY_DIR>\roles\
  ├─ <PERSONA>.md
  ├─ 傲娇助手.md
  ├─ <PERSONA_ALT2>.md
  └─ active.json        { role, source, syncedAt }
```

- 复制规则：只同步 `*.md`，跳过 `README.md`、`.bak-*`、`.tmp-*`；内容相同不重写（幂等）。
- 触发点：插件启动时、面板保存人设卡后、面板删除人设卡后、手动 `POST /api/dsmp/roles/sync`。
- 删除：`DELETE /api/dsmp/roles?name=` 先把原文件复制成 `.bak-dsmp-*`，再删源卡并同步镜像；**当前正在使用的那张不能删**（要先切换）。镜像里对应的副本会在同一次同步中被清掉，返回的 `removed[]` 会列出清了哪些。
- 目的是「记忆目录搬走 = 人设一起搬走」，导出记忆包时 `roles/` 也会跟着进包。
- 只复制、不反向覆盖；源目录被外部（不经面板）删掉的卡，下一次同步时镜像里也会一并清掉。
- 镜像目标固定是 `settings.memoryDir`（生产记忆目录），不受测试期隔离影响——测试隔离只管记忆记录与媒体，人设卡属于配置。

## QQ 通道（M2，只读 + 只入队）

bridge 通过 `x-console-token` 头鉴权（令牌在 `<bridge>\state\console-token`），DSMP 的 `BridgeClient` 只读它的状态与历史：

| 路由 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /api/dsmp/bridge/status` | 令牌是否就绪、当前模式、是否允许真发、outbox 条数 |
| `GET /api/dsmp/bridge/recent?key=&limit=` | 真实会话最近消息（只读） |
| `POST /api/dsmp/bridge/send` | 测试期只把消息写 `outbox.jsonl` 并返回 `dryRun:true`，不发请求 |
| `POST /api/dsmp/inbound` | 入站落盘（`bridge-inbox.jsonl`），供 M2 链路自检 |
| `GET /api/dsmp/inbox` / `GET /api/dsmp/outbox` | 读回入站/出站记录 |

**为什么出站只能是 dry-run**：reserved2 模式下 bridge 的 `/api/socialV2/send-message` 要求 `x-agent-token`（每个会话的 `state/social-v2.json.agentToken`），DSMP 拿不到；真发要等接入阶段，或改成由 bridge 转发。测试期 `test.allowLiveSend = false` 是硬闸门，即使改代码也不会静默发出去。


## 媒体库（M3）

图片与语音共用一个内容寻址仓库，只是分目录：图片进 `<记忆根>\media\YYYY-MM\<sha1>.<ext>` + `state\media.jsonl`，语音进 `<记忆根>\voice\YYYY-MM\<sha1>.<ext>` + `state\voice.jsonl`。同一个文件只存一份（按 sha1 去重），索引每 sha1 只追加一行。

| 路由 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `POST /api/dsmp/media/upload?kind=image\|voice&name=&alt=` | 原始字节上传（≤16MB），按魔数嗅探类型，返回 `sha1` |
| `GET /api/dsmp/media/file?sha1=&kind=` | 取文件；强 ETag（sha1），支持 `If-None-Match`→304 与单区间 `Range`→206（语音拖动播放靠它） |
| `GET /api/dsmp/media/list?kind=&limit=` | 列出最近条目 |
| `POST /api/dsmp/media/attachment` | 把会话里的 `ImageAttachmentRef` 读成字节（面板渲染镜像消息的图，不必把字节塞进事件缓冲） |
| `POST /api/dsmp/voice/send` | 测试期写入 `voice-outbox.jsonl` 并返回 `dryRun:true` |
| `GET /api/dsmp/voice/outbox?limit=` | 读回语音队列 |

要点：
- 服务端不解码图片、不生成缩略图（零依赖）；面板按原图缩到 132px 显示，浏览器缓存靠 `immutable`。
- 语音行保留 `transcript` 字段：1.10.0 起入站语音会先转写再落库（见「听 QQ 语音转文字」）。
- QQ 侧入站语音已接（P1，见下节）：bridge 取字节后转给 `POST /api/dsmp/voice/inbound`，面板语音库直接可播。

## 听 QQ 语音（P1，2026-11-08）

主人在 QQ 发语音 → SnowLuma 给 `record` 段 → bridge 调 `get_record` 拿音频地址（或 `base64://`）→ `safeFetchBuffer` 限 16MB 取字节、校验魔数 → `POST /api/dsmp/voice/inbound` → 语音库 → 面板「语音库」里 `<audio controls>` 播放。

- **面板**：聊天页顶部「语音库」按钮展开，显示最近 5 条（来源、大小、时长、时间），带条数 chip 与「刷新」；QQ 来的标 `QQ`，面板自己生成/上传的标 `本地上传`。
- **接口**：`POST /api/dsmp/voice/inbound`，body `{key,msgId,name,from,duration,data(base64)}`；只接音频（OGG/Opus、WAV、MP3、M4A），超过 `media.maxVoiceBytes`（默认 16MB）或不是音频返回 400 且不落盘；同 sha1 只存一份。
- **桥接侧**：每条消息最多转 2 条语音，20s 超时；取字节/转发失败只写日志，绝不影响她回复文字。
- **语音转写**：1.10.0 起入站语音会先转成文字（见下节）；转写失败仍按 `[语音]` 处理。
- **自检**：`node dev/verify-voice.mjs --base http://127.0.0.1:<GUI 端口>`（生成 0.25s 测试音，验证入库 / 列表 / 取回逐字节一致）。
- **回滚**：删 `voice/inbound` 路由与 `lib/voice-inbound.js`，并去掉 `bridge.js` 里的 `forwardInboundVoice` 调用；已入库语音留着无害。
- **限制**：`get_record` 不可用（账号不支持 / 消息过期 / 网络失败）时面板不会出现这条，只在桥接日志留一行 `[voice] 入站语音取字节失败`。

## 听 QQ 语音转文字（1.10.0，2026-11-10）

QQ 语音是 SILK，本地 ffmpeg 直接解不了；落库前先让 SnowLuma 解码，再交给 DSH 自带的 SenseVoice。模型这一轮看到的是文字，不再是 `[语音]`。

链路：

```
QQ record 段 → bridge 取字节（get_record out_format:'wav'，SnowLuma 内置 SILK 解码）
  → 本机 ffmpeg 归一化 16k/单声道/PCM16 并削掉 LIST 块
  → POST /api/dsmp/voice/transcribe（x-dsmp-internal: bridge）
  → ctx.get('speechToText').transcribe()
  → 语音库存 WAV + transcript，本轮文本变成 "[语音转写] …"
```

- **依赖**：profile 里的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle`（DSH 自带，不是插件依赖）；模型缓存在 `<DSH_HOME>\speech-to-text\sensevoice\`（int8 约 239 MB），`prepare()` 跑过一次后常驻 `standby`。
- **接口**：`POST /api/dsmp/voice/transcribe`，body `{key,msgId,name,from,duration,data(base64 wav)}`；只接受 16k/单声道/PCM16、44 字节标准头、≤4 MB/110 s；同 sha1 已有 transcript 时直接返回（`cached:true`）。
- **配置**（`settings.json` 的 `media.voice.stt`）：`enabled`（默认 true）、`provider`（空=用服务默认）、`language`（`zh`）、`timeoutMs`（20000）、`maxSeconds`（110）、`maxBytes`（4 MB）、`prepareTimeoutMs`（30000）。面板设置页不暴露这些键，改文件后 bundle off/on 或重启 DSH 生效。
- **状态**：`GET /api/dsmp/status` 的 `stt` 字段给出 `{enabled,available,provider,phase,language,error}`；`phase` 为 `standby/ready` 才可立即转写。
- **边界**：转写只进 `voice.jsonl` 的 `transcript` 和本轮 prompt，**不进事实卡、不进抽取**；超时/失败/未加载 provider 时 bridge 回退 `[语音]`，回复不受影响。
- **排障**：桥接日志看 `[voice] 语音转写 …`；失败会打印 `DSMP_STT_*` 码（`TOO_LONG`/`WAVE`/`NOT_READY`/`TIMEOUT`/`UNAVAILABLE`）。`phase=failed` 时删掉 `<DSH_HOME>\speech-to-text\sensevoice\models` 让 bundle 重新下载。
- **回滚**：删 `lib/voice-stt.js`、`voice/transcribe` 路由与 `media.voice.stt` 配置；bridge 侧还原 `segmentsToText`/`handleIncoming`/`toCanonicalWav` 三处。




## 记忆去重与过期降权（1.13.0，2026-11-10）

- **近同义只留一条**：同一主题+槽位下，值归一化全等、长串包含短串（≥8 字）、共享 ≥2 个型号/编号（如 A7R3 + 2470GM）、或字符二元组 Dice ≥ 0.85 的，视为同一件事。她自己写时命中就合并（`ev:'revise'`，保留更完整那句）；抽取器命中记 `skippedDup` 不再叠版本。
- **边界**：不按「共享中文二元组」合并——「电子学基础 周二」与「周五」是两门课，「不喜欢被叫<PERSONA_NICK>」与「README 不许出现<PERSONA_NICK>」是两条规则，都不能并。
- **过期默认不出**：检索跳过 `expired` 事实；问「以前/过去/作废/取消/过期」或显式要历史版本时才放回（旧课表「英语课作废」不再压在新课表前面）。卡面仍保留「旧事」行。
- **存量归并**：一次性脚本按 topic+slot 分组，保留 self / 高 I / 较新的一条，其余 `invalidate`（备份在 `<BACKUP_ROOT>\dsmp-memory\backup\`）。本次清理 5 对。
- **热重载**：`lib/tools.js`、`lib/workbench/state.js`、`lib/memory-engine.js` 的 vendor 导入带 mtime，bundle 开关即可加载新引擎模块（新路由/入口仍需重启 DSH）。
- **配置**：无需新配置；`memory.selfWrite`、`memory.scoring` 原样生效。

## 记忆自主化与月摘要（1.11.0，2026-11-10）

- **她为主，模型只补**：<PERSONA>在聊天里用 `dsmp_memory_write` 直接记（20 条/天、总 600）；抽取器遇到「她写过同一主题+槽位、值不同」时不覆盖，写 `state/disputes.jsonl` 等人工裁决。
- **待裁决视图**：记忆速览 →「待裁决」，每条显示她的值、抽取器的值、引文；`保留她的 / 采用补充 / 合并 / 忽略` 四个动作，采用或合并会写 `supersede`（`author:'correction'`）。接口 `GET /api/dsmp/workbench?view=disputes`、`POST /api/dsmp/workbench/write`（`action:'dispute'`）。
- **月摘要视图**：记忆速览 →「月摘要」，显示当前 `rolling.md` 的正文、字数、条数与更新时间；`GET /api/dsmp/workbench?view=monthly`。它只在轮转时注入，平时不影响上下文。
- **轮转四层**：`【最近一天原话】→【七天摘要】→【月摘要】`；月摘要 ≤700 字，只留身份/关系/约定、在进行的计划、重要事件，写 `state/monthly/rolling.md` 与 `YYYY-MM.md`，7 天内复用缓存。
- **配置**：`memory.monthly{enabled,maxChars,days}`、`memory.conflicts{maxPending}`、`memory.selfWrite{maxPerDay,maxTotal}`、`handoverMaxChars`（默认 5200）。bridge `config.json` 与插件 `settings.json` 两处都读。
- **回滚**：还原 `_retired\_memauto-20261110-131709` 的 `vendor/memory/src` 与 `lib`，或把 `memory.monthly.enabled` 设为 false（月摘要立即消失，其余不变）。

## 迁移 / 记忆包 / 打包（M5）

三个能力都只依赖 Node 内置模块（`zlib`、`fs`、`crypto`），不装外部依赖。

### 1. 迁移向导（记忆目录 + agent 工作区）

`POST /api/dsmp/migrate` 由 Journal 驱动，阶段固定为 `copy → verify → switch → cleanup → done`：

| 请求 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /api/dsmp/migrate` | 读取 `<DSH_HOME>\dsmp\migration\journal.json` |
| `POST {"action":"preflight","sourceDir":…,"targetDir":…}` | 只检查：源存在、目标为空/不存在、互不嵌套、空间 ≥ 源×1.2，并报告 `agent\` 工作区是否存在 |
| `POST {"action":"run",…}` | 逐阶段执行：复制 →（若存在）复制 `agent\` 工作区 → 逐文件 sha256 对账 → 记录 switch → 把源目录改名 `<源>.migrated-<时间戳>` → done |
| `POST {"action":"rollback"}` | 用改名记录把源目录搬回；`deleteTarget:true` 可清掉新目录 |

硬规则：
- **从不删除源目录**，cleanup 只改名，保留 7 天后由人决定是否删。
- 任何阶段失败都停在原地，journal 里留现场；`rollback` 只回滚改名，不动已复制的目标文件。
- 测试期（`test.enabled=true`）拒绝把 `sourceDir` 指到生产记忆目录，直接 403 `DSMP_TEST_ONLY`。

### 2. 记忆包导出 / 校验 / 导入

| 路由 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `POST /api/dsmp/memory/export` `{memoryDir?,name?,includeWorkspace?}` | 生成 `deepseek-memory-<日期>.dsmp.zip` 到 `<DSH_HOME>\dsmp\exports\` |
| `POST /api/dsmp/memory/verify` `{file}` | 校验每个条目的 sha256、缺件与 manifest 之外的额外文件 |
| `POST /api/dsmp/memory/import` `{file,targetDir,overwrite?}` | 先校验再写；只写记忆树（`memory/**`→目标根、`workspace/agent/**`→`agent/`），`sessions|roles|dsmp` 由调用方另行处理 |

包内布局：`manifest.json`（kind、版本、创建时间、来源机器、文件数、字节数、全量 sha256）+ `memory/**` + `workspace/agent/**` + `sessions/<转义目录>/<sessionId>/**` + `roles/*.md` + `dsmp/settings.json`。
跳过 `backup/`、`node_modules/`、`scratch/`、`shadow/`、`.git/`——备份目录不进包。

### 3. 单 tgz 打包

```bash
node scripts/pack.mjs            # → dist/deepseek-memory-partner-<version>.tgz
node scripts/pack.mjs --out <输出目录>\dsmp.tgz
```

- 自写 ustar + gzip，不依赖 npm；包含 `package.json / README.md / CHANGELOG.md / lib / vendor/memory(src) / docs`。
- 不含 `dev/ test/ dist/ backup/ node_modules/`，也不含 `vendor/memory` 的开发文档与脚本。
- **本机绝对路径在打包时替换成占位符**：`<DSMP_MEMORY_DIR>`、`<DSMP_BRIDGE_DIR>`、`<DSH_HOME>`。运行时由 `lib/settings.js` 从同名环境变量展开：

```powershell
$env:DSMP_MEMORY_DIR   = '<DSMP_MEMORY_DIR>'
$env:DSMP_BRIDGE_DIR   = '<DSMP_BRIDGE_DIR>'
$env:DSH_HOME          = '<DSH_HOME>'
```

未设置的占位符会原样保留，面板的状态卡会显示「记忆目录未配置」而不是猜一个路径。

导出：489 条目（memory 482 / sessions 1 / roles 4 / dsmp 1），4,253,424 B
