## 一键换机（B1，2026-11-08）

把「记忆目录 + QQ 工作区 + DSH 会话树 + 人设卡 + 插件设置」打成一个 `dsmp-machine-pack` zip，在新机器导入后所有绝对路径自动改写，会话能接着聊。

| 请求 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /api/dsmp/machine` | 本机身份（`machine.json`）、心跳、单机锁、历史 |
| `POST /api/dsmp/machine/export` | 导出：`{name?, memoryDir?, sessionIds?}` → `<DSH_HOME>\dsmp\exports\<name>`；不是记忆写者时 409 |
| `POST /api/dsmp/machine/upload?name=…` | 浏览器上传换机包（原始 zip body，落 `<DSH_HOME>\dsmp\imports\`） |
| `POST /api/dsmp/machine/import` | 导入：`{file, targetDir, machineName?, dryRun?, overwrite?, force?}` |

包内结构（`manifest.json` 记录 `cwd`、`sessionIds`、逐文件 sha256）：

```
memory/**            记忆目录（排除 backup / sessions / node_modules / scratch / shadow）
machine.json         来源机器身份
sessions/<sid>/**    选中的 DSH 会话日志（逐帧 zstd，导入时改 header.cwd）
roles/*.md           人设卡
dsmp/settings.json   插件设置（导入后 memoryDir / liveCwd 改新路径）
```

导入做的事：校验整包 sha256 → 目标非空先备份改名 → 记忆写 `target.importing-<pid>` 再整体 rename → 会话按 `escapeCwd(newCwd)` 落到 `<DSH_HOME>\sessions\…\<sid>\` 并逐帧改写 cwd → `storages/workspace.json` 里指向旧工作区的条目改新路径（`updatedAt` 用 ISO）→ bridge `config.json` 的 `sessionCwd`（若配了 bridge 目录）→ DSMP settings 的 `memoryDir` / `session.liveCwd` → 新 `machine.json` 并把旧 machineId 记进 `state/machine-history.jsonl`；任一步失败删新建目录、把备份改回。

单机锁：每 5 分钟写一次 `state/machine-heartbeat.json`；导入时目标目录 10 分钟内有别的 machineId 心跳 → 409 `DSMP_MACHINE_BUSY`（确认覆盖传 `force:true`）。

面板「设置」页签里的「一键换机」卡片就是这套接口的 UI：导出换机包 → 新机器选包 → 预检（显示旧/新工作区、文件数、目标是否已存在）→ 确认导入。

离线验收：`node dev\verify-b1.mjs --pack <zip>` 在 `%TEMP%` 里做一次完整导入（不碰真实 sessions / workspace.json / bridge），12 项对账。

## 备份与恢复（B2，2026-11-08）

面板「设置」页签里的「备份与恢复」卡片：点「立即备份」生成一份记忆包，列表里每份都能「恢复…」（先预检，再确认）。备份是本地文件，不依赖 QQ / bridge，也不需要停 DSH。

| 请求 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /api/dsmp/backup` | 备份根目录、保留份数、已有备份列表（按时间新→旧） |
| `POST /api/dsmp/backup/now` | `{name?}` → 生成 `<root>\<YYYYMMDD-HHmmss>-<name>.zip`；不是记忆写者时 409 |
| `POST /api/dsmp/backup/restore` | `{file, dryRun?, overwrite?}`；`dryRun` 只校验并回报包内文件数，`overwrite:true` 才替换 |

备份根目录默认 `<DSH_HOME>\dsmp\backups`，可在设置里改 `backup.dir`；`backup.keep`（默认 10）控制只保留最近几份，清理只删最旧的、失败跳过。

一份备份就是一个 `dsmp-memory-pack`：`manifest.json`（来源目录、文件数、逐文件 sha256）+ `memory/**` + 可选 `workspace/agent/**` + `roles/*.md` + `dsmp/settings.json`；`backup/sessions/node_modules/scratch/shadow/.git` 不进包。写盘前先 `verifyArchive` 自检，自检不过直接报错、不留半截文件。

恢复做的事：校验 manifest 与哈希 → 目标非空且没 `overwrite` 就停在预检 → 解到临时目录（只取 `memory/`、`roles/`、`workspace/agent/`，**跳过 `sessions/` 与 `dsmp/settings.json`**）→ 当前记忆目录整体改名 `<memoryDir>.before-restore-<stamp>` → 临时目录 rename 就位；任一步失败删临时、把旧目录改回。旧目录永不删除，回滚就是把它改回来。

> 恢复会改动生产记忆；面板默认先预检，确认按钮上写明「会先把当前记忆目录改名备份」。不是记忆写者（另一个进程持租约）时两条写路由都返回 409 `DSMP_NOT_WRITER`。

离线验收：`node dev\verify-b2.mjs --file <备份.zip> [--base http://127.0.0.1:<GUI 端口>]` 在 `%TEMP%` 里做一次真实恢复与二次拒绝，14 项对账。


## 她说过的语音（B3，2026-11-08）

她发出去的语音会自动进语音库，**TTS 的原文直接记下来，不跑语音识别**：

- `/api/socialV2/tts` 成功发送后，bridge 用回读的 `msgId` 把「音频 + 原文」回报给 `POST /api/dsmp/voice/sent`，原文标 `textSource:'tts-input'`。
- `/api/socialV2/send-voice`（语音库文件）只回报音频，没有原文就留空；面板那条显示灰字「（没有原文）」，以后可补。
- 主人发来的语音仍走 `/api/dsmp/voice/inbound`，标 `direction:'in'`、`speaker:'owner'`，只听、不转写。

`state/voice.jsonl` 每行新增 `direction`（`in`/`out`）、`speaker`（`owner`/`shenming`）、`text`、`textSource`（`tts-input`/`stt`/`library-meta`/`manual`）。旧行没有这些字段，按 `direction:'in'` 兼容。同一段音频按 sha1 只存一份；后到的空文本不会冲掉已有原文，只有 `manual` 能人工覆盖。

面板「记忆 → 语音库」分两组：「她说过的」（原文 / 「（识别）」 / 「（没有原文）」+「发这条」）和「主人发来的」（只听）。

| 请求 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `POST /api/dsmp/voice/sent` | `{data(base64), text, textSource, name, key, msgId, duration}`；落 `direction:'out'` |
| `GET /api/dsmp/media/list?kind=voice` | 每行带 `direction/speaker/text/textSource` |

> 出口原文只进语音库，**不自动写长期事实卡**；她的话要进记忆仍须调用 `dsmp_memory_write`。TTS 原文与真实发音语义一致即可，允许有语气差异。

离线验收：`node dev\verify-b3.mjs --base http://127.0.0.1:<GUI 端口>`（写入一段 0.25s 测试音，断言原文落库、重报不冲掉原文、文件逐字节一致）。


## 健壮性：写令牌 / 诊断 / 乐观锁 / 启动自检（D，2026-11-08）

四项都在插件里，不依赖外部服务：

- **写令牌**：启动时生成 `<DSH_HOME>\dsmp\api-token`（32 hex，仅当前用户可读）。所有写路由要求 `x-dsmp-token`，或浏览器同源（`Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin`），bridge 的内部转发用 `x-dsmp-internal: bridge`；其余一律 `403 DSMP_WRITE_FORBIDDEN`。`/api/dsmp/status` 只在同源时回 `writeToken`，所以面板不用自己存令牌。它防的是跨站伪造和误调用，不防同一用户下的本机进程。
- **诊断**：设置页「诊断与自检」折叠卡，数据来自 `GET /api/dsmp/diagnostics`——3100/7351/8188/9880 端口、租约、残留锁、`.exporting`/未完成迁移、6 个日志的尾部 20 行、6 项自检。
- **乐观锁**：`?view=facts|claims|activation|history` 回 `etag`；写请求带 `ifMatch`，对不上回 `409 DSMP_STALE`，面板自动刷新并提示「数据已更新，已刷新」。四类写（claims / fact-edit / fact / activation）都覆盖。
- **启动自检**：`status.selfCheck[]` 六项——记忆目录可写、租约是否本机、bridge 是否在线、残留 panel-lock（超过 5 分钟且进程已死会清）、运行模式（生产模式 / 开发热重载，两种都算通过，只作信息展示）、写令牌就绪。有失败项时面板顶部出黄条，点「重新检查」会调用 `POST /api/dsmp/selfcheck` 真正重跑（`status` 只回启动时那份缓存）。

离线验收：`node dev\verify-d.mjs --base http://127.0.0.1:<GUI 端口>`（15 项，含跨站 403、同源 200、带令牌 200、过期 ifMatch 409）。


## 单写者租约（M6）

默认 `settings.memory.owner = "bridge"`：DSMP **不抢租约**，QQ 侧记忆仍由 bridge 自己写，生产行为与 M5 完全一致。

把 owner 改成 `"dsmp"` 之后：

1. DSMP 在 `<记忆目录>/state/engine-lease.json` 抢租约：`{owner:"dsmp", pid, startedAt, heartbeatAt, ttlMs:60000}`，每 15s 心跳；抢不到就降级只读（不会双写）。
2. bridge 侧（`cfg.memory.owner = "dsmp"` 且租约有效、owner 为 dsmp）不再自己写账本，改为把 `begin-turn` / `note-spoken` / `finish-turn` 转发到 `POST /api/dsmp/memory/*`；转发失败只记日志、**不回落本地写入**（宁可少记一轮，也不允许双写）。
3. 切回 `"bridge"` 或删除租约文件即回滚；DSMP 的写入口在租约失效时一律返回 `409 DSMP_NOT_WRITER`。

路由：

| 方法 | 路径 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/api/dsmp/memory/lease` | 租约摘要（owner / live / mine / 心跳时间） |
| POST | `/api/dsmp/memory/lease` | `{action:"acquire"\|"release"\|"heartbeat"\|"status"}` |
| POST | `/api/dsmp/memory/begin-turn` | bridge 转发：开一轮（key/sessionId/userRaw/windowText/blocks/media/model/mode） |
| POST | `/api/dsmp/memory/note-spoken` | bridge 转发：她真正发出去的一句（tool/text/feels） |
| POST | `/api/dsmp/memory/finish-turn` | bridge 转发：收尾（reply/reason/pressureTokens/contextWindow/incomplete） |
| GET | `/api/dsmp/memory/writer` | 当前写者状态与计数（begun/finished/spoken/skipped/errors） |

> M6 阶段仍按「只测试」执行：默认 owner=bridge，租约只会在测试记忆目录里演练；真实 QQ 回合不会被转发。切到生产需要主人点头后再改 `settings.json` 与 bridge `config.json` 两处 owner。

## 记忆单写者已切到 DSMP（P2，2026-11-07）

本机现状：`memory.owner = "dsmp"` 已生效，生产记忆账本（`window/*/turns.jsonl`）由 DSMP 写，bridge 只转发。

切过去要改三处（缺一不可）：

1. `settings.json`：`memory = { "owner": "dsmp", "leaseTtlMs": 60000, "dir": "<DSMP_MEMORY_DIR>" }` —— `dir` 必须显式写生产记忆目录，否则测试期会落到 `test/memory` 副本。
2. bridge `config.json`：`memory.owner = "dsmp"`，然后重启 bridge。日志出现 `记忆单写者：owner=dsmp，租约=dsmp（有效）` 即生效；若仍是 `owner=bridge`，说明租约文件没被 DSMP 抢到或 owner 没读到。
3. 确认 `/api/dsmp/status` 的 `memory.lease` 是 `{owner:"dsmp", live:true, mine:true}`、`memory.writer.writer === true`。

切换后一轮的完整链路：面板/QQ 消息 → bridge `deliverPrompt` → bridge 调 `POST /api/dsmp/memory/begin-turn` → DSMP 写 `<记忆目录>/window/<sessionId>/turns.jsonl` → `finish-turn` 收尾。账本里的 `userRaw` 只保留主人原话（面板消息的「【来自桌面面板 · 不发 QQ】…」包装会在写入前剥掉）。

回滚（任一步都立刻恢复 bridge 独占）：

```powershell
# 1) DSMP 让出：owner 改回 bridge（下一次心跳会把租约文件删掉）
# 2) bridge 恢复自写：config.json 的 memory.owner 改回 bridge 或直接删掉该键
# 3) 重启 bridge，日志应变回「记忆单写者：owner=bridge，租约=无」
```

边界：切到 DSMP 后，日终派生（情境段 / 事实抽取 / 归档 / 轮转 / 到期提醒）也由 DSMP 跑（A2，见下节），bridge 不再启动自己的维护定时器；两边共用同一个记忆目录，靠租约互斥。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# DeepSeek-memory-partner（DSMP）

把「记忆引擎 + 桌面聊天面板」合并成一个 DSH 插件的单包实现。包名 `@local/dsmp`，显示名 **DeepSeek-memory-partner**。

> 当前进度：**M0 骨架 + M1/M1b 本地聊天与记忆注入 + M2 QQ 通道 + M3 媒体 + M4 历史/设置/工作台 + M5 迁移/记忆包/打包 + M6 单写者租约 + M7 搬家归位 + M8 记忆目录自包含设计 + M9 记忆写操作并入 + P1 听 QQ 语音 + B1 一键换机 + B2 面板备份/恢复 + B3 她说过的语音 + D 健壮性 + 情境索引显示修复（1.8.1）+ C 发布准备（1.9.0）+ A3 面板体检/命名统一（1.9.2）+ QQ 语音转写（1.10.0）+ QQ bridge 并入 / components 归位（2.0.0）**。侧边栏「记忆面板」+ 四页签（聊天 / 历史记录 / 记忆速览 / 设置）。
>
> **M9（1.2.0）新增**：「记忆」页签不只读，还能改——长期事实逐条「编辑 / 作废 / 恢复 / 历史（修订链）」、待确认候选「确认 / 驳回」、激活开关（enabled / emit / rankInInject / recordRetrieved / toneResidue / toneSummary / matchTokens）。所有写操作走 `POST /api/dsmp/workbench/write`，统一守卫：迁移中 409、租约非本机 409、只写 `memory.dir`、写前备份到 `backup/*.bak-dsmp-*`、写后审计到 `logs/dsmp-workbench-audit.jsonl`。
>
> **测试期规矩（主人 2026-11-06 定，2026-11-08 P2 已收口）**：M1–M6 开发期只测试、不实际接入，那时默认 `test.enabled = true`。P2 收口后 `test.enabled = false`，账本、注入与媒体都落生产目录 `<DSMP_MEMORY_DIR>`；面板直连驱动同一条 QQ 会话（`session.via = auto`），QQ 侧仍由 bridge 传输。
>
> **安装位置**：插件实体在 `<DSMP_PLUGIN_ROOT>`。旧开发路径 `<DSMP_WORKSPACE>\plugins\dsmp` 已于 2026-11-08 随旧目录一起退役，现位于 `<DSMP_WORKSPACE>\_retired\`（观察 7 天后删除）。

## English summary

**DeepSeek-memory-partner (DSMP)** is a single DeepSeek Harness plugin that bundles a long-term memory engine with a desktop chat panel. It keeps what the owner said (facts, preferences, plans, dates), injects a compact memory card into every agent step, and lets you read or edit that memory inside the Harness UI.

- **What it installs** — one host plugin (`@local/dsmp`) with a web client: a sidebar item **Chat** with four tabs (Chat / History / Memory / Settings), plus seven native `dsmp_memory_*` tools: `search`, `recall`, `window`, `write`, `edit`, `photo`, `todo`.
- **What it needs** — DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.2.1-rc.2`, Node `>= 22.13`, and no npm runtime dependencies; the memory engine ships as a vendored copy under `vendor/memory/`.
- **Three commands** (Windows, run inside the plugin folder):

  ```cmd
  :: 1) link the plugin into the desktop profile (plus bundles entry, see 安装)
  mklink /J "%DSH_HOME%\profiles\desktop\node_modules\@local\dsmp" "%CD%"
  :: 2) run the test suite
  node --test test/*.test.mjs
  :: 3) build the installable tarball
  node scripts/pack.mjs
  ```

- **Boundary** — memory lives only under the data directory you configure (`settings.memory.dir`); the panel reads and writes nothing else. QQ delivery stays with qq-bridge: DSMP queues and records, it does not send to QQ on its own. No telemetry, no outbound network calls except the local Harness and the optional local QQ bridge.

## 5 分钟上手

1. **装插件**（三种落点见下面「安装」）：`dependencies` 写 `link:`、`dsh.profile.bundles` 追加 `@local/dsmp`、在 profile 的 `node_modules\@local\dsmp` 建 junction。刷新页面，侧边栏出现「聊天」。
2. **打开面板**：点侧边栏「聊天」→「设置」→ 确认「记忆目录」指向你要用的数据目录（第一次装建议先指向一个空目录试）；「模型」选默认 provider/model。
3. **发一条本地消息**：回到「聊天」，输入「你好，记住我喜欢喝美式」并回车。回复下方应出现「记忆已注入：事实 N 条 · 卡 X 字 · 规则 Y 字」。
4. **看到记忆注入**：切到「记忆」页签 →「长期事实」应能看到这条事实（或候选）；「窗口回放」里应有刚才这一轮。用 `curl "http://127.0.0.1:<端口>/api/dsmp/memory/preview?text=我喜欢喝什么"` 可看到完整注入文本。
5. **确认工具**：在会话里让她调用 `dsmp_memory_recall`（问「我上次说的咖啡是什么」），返回应带 `⟵ 窗口…轮…` 锚点；点开「历史记录」能看到同一轮。

> 没有装 QQ bridge 也能跑完这五步——面板直连 DSH 会话，QQ 只影响「QQ 通道」卡片。

## 目录

```
plugins/dsmp
├─ package.json          # dsh.bundle.patch / dsh.client 声明
├─ cordis.patch.yml      # bundle 插入 @local/dsmp
├─ lib/index.js          # host：status / settings / roles / models / chat / memory-preview / bridge 通道
├─ lib/client.js         # web 客户端：侧栏图标 + 整页三页签
├─ lib/session-bridge.js # 会话桥：建/接管会话、followup、事件投影、测试期护栏
├─ lib/memory-context.js # 只读记忆投影：规则 + 事实卡 → 注入文本
├─ lib/bridge-client.js  # QQ 通道：x-console-token 只读、入站落盘、出站 dry-run
├─ lib/models.js         # provider / model 目录 + agentOptions
├─ lib/load.js           # 开发期 data: URL 热重载（生产不启用）
├─ lib/paths.js          # PLUGIN_ROOT / DSH_HOME
├─ lib/settings.js       # <DSH_HOME>/dsmp/settings.json
├─ lib/role.js           # 角色卡跟随（current-role.json → 面板名）
├─ lib/probe.js          # 纯 Node 端口/HTTP 探测（避开沙箱 pipe 限制）
├─ lib/lease.js          # M6 单写者租约（state/engine-lease.json）
├─ lib/memory-writer.js  # M6 记账转发落点（begin / note-spoken / finish）
├─ lib/http.js           # sendJson / readJsonBody
├─ vendor/memory/        # 记忆引擎固定副本（src/test/scripts，无 node_modules）
├─ scripts/              # check-memory-layout：记忆目录自检（只读）
├─ dev/                  # 开发辅助：toggle-bundle / verify-m1b / repair-test-encoding / normalize-layout
└─ test/dsmp.test.mjs    # 26 条用例
```

## 记忆数据布局（2026-11-07 规范化）

文本、图片、语音三个库分开，引擎要读的路径一个都不改名（详情见 `docs\记忆数据布局-20261107.md`）：

| 库 | 位置 |
| --- | --- |
| 文本 | `state\`（longterm/topics/memory/calendar…）、`raw\hot|archive\`、`window\`、`episodes\`、`digests\`、`profile.md`、`rules.md` |
| 图片 | `media\YYYY-MM\<sha1>.<ext>` + 索引 `state\media.jsonl` |
| 语音 | `voice\YYYY-MM\<sha1>.<ext>` + 索引 `state\voice.jsonl` |

自检：

```cmd
node scripts\check-memory-layout.mjs
```

检查必需目录/文件、`*.bak-*` 是否回潮、图片/语音文件数与索引是否一致。只读。

## 安装

DSH 的 profile 在 `<DSH_HOME>\profiles\desktop`（`DSH_HOME` 由启动器决定，不要假设是用户主目录下的 `.dsh`）。三个落点都要有：

1. `profiles/desktop/package.json` 的 `dependencies` 增加：
   ```json
   "@local/dsmp": "link:<DSMP_PLUGIN_ROOT>"
   ```
2. 同一个文件的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组追加 `"@local/dsmp"`。
3. 建立 junction：
   ```cmd
   mklink /J "<DSH_HOME>\profiles\desktop\node_modules\@local\dsmp" "<DSMP_PLUGIN_ROOT>"
   ```

也可以让 CLI 代劳（会跑 pnpm，需要能写 profile 目录）：

```cmd
"<DSH_HOME>\app\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add "<DSMP_PLUGIN_ROOT>"
```

装完刷新页面即可（实测 `bundles` 变更会被宿主热加载：约 2 秒卸载、4 秒重载；客户端 UI 需要刷新页面重新拉插件清单）。**用 CLI 升级/重装后仍需完全退出并重开 DSH**，热加载只对 bundle 清单的增删有效。

### 验证

```cmd
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:<当前端口>/api/dsmp/status
curl -s "http://127.0.0.1:<当前端口>/api/dsmp/memory/preview?text=hello"
```

`status` 应返回 `ok: true`、`packageName: "@local/dsmp"`、`version`（与 `package.json` 一致）、`mode`（`local` / `degraded` / `qq`）、`test.enabled` 与 `test.memoryDir`。`memory/preview` 返回即将注入的完整 prompt、各段长度与事实条数。

## 面板

## 记忆排序：重要度分（1.14.0）

- **一个分数**：`score = 100 × W × R`。`W = 0.55×I + 0.45×档位基值 + 作者/类别/提及次数的小加成`（hard 1.0 / long 0.85 / general 0.6 / temp 0.35），`R` 仍是时间衰减；hard 不衰减。分数读取时计算，不写回 `longterm.jsonl`。
- **分档**：核心 ≥80 / 重要 60–79 / 一般 40–59 / 边缘 <40，只用于展示与筛选。
- **面板「长期事实」**：默认按分数排，`正常 → 旧事 → 已作废` 分组；每行显示分数、档位、档位名、提及次数、最近几天；顶部有「全部 / 核心 / 重要 / 一般 / 旧事 / 已作废」筛选与 50 条一页的「显示更多」。
- **检索**：`memory.scoring.ranking.applyToSearch` 默认 `false`（保留旧公式，只多回一个 `importance` 字段）。改成 `true` 后档位不再单独 ×1000，改为「结构命中 6000–8000 + 命中 500 + score×4 + 提及次数×10」——先保证问什么有什么，同一类命中里再按重要度排。打开前先用 `route-preview` 对比真实问法。
- **卡面**：注入事实卡维持 `I×1000 + 档位×100 + 提及次数` 的稳定排序，不受当天衰减影响。

## 面板直发（2026-11-07）

聊天页的「当前对话」就是 QQ 正在用的那条 DSH 会话。面板里打字不会另起一个 agent，而是经 bridge 投进去：

```
面板输入 → POST /api/dsmp/chat/send
        → 命中 bridge 会话 → POST <bridge>/api/socialV2/panel-message（控制台令牌）
        → bridge 组 prompt（【来自桌面面板 · 不发 QQ】+【面板消息】<text>）→ 同一会话
        → 回复是普通 assistant 文本，不会调用任何 QQ 发送工具
```

- 开关：`settings.panel.liveSend`（默认 `true`），关掉后对当前对话发送返回 `403 面板直发未开启`。
- 当前对话不支持从面板发图（返回 400，明确提示改用测试会话），避免把图片塞进 QQ 侧流程。
- `GET /api/dsmp/history/sessions` 会向 bridge 查当前会话映射并标 `bridgeLive`，所以 `closed-agent`/`reserved2` 切模式后「当前对话」仍指向真正在用的那条。
- 会话日志解析：`【面板消息】` 之后才是主人原话；QQ 入站的整段提示按 `【管理员】…` 这类发送者行截断，气泡只显示对方说的话。

## 本地服务控制（2026-11-07）

设置页「本地服务」卡片可以手动开关三样东西，只调用已有脚本、不修改任何服务配置：

| 服务 | 端口 | 启动 | 关闭 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| QQ 机器人（SnowLuma + bridge） | 3100 | `start-bot.cmd` | `stop-bot.cmd` |
| ComfyUI（ComfyUI API） | 8188 | `scripts\start-comfy-api.cmd` | `scripts\stop-comfy-api.cmd` |
| GPT-SoVITS（语音合成） | 9880 | `scripts\start-tts-api.cmd` | `scripts\stop-tts-api.cmd` |

- 按钮只对「未运行 / 运行中」做启动或关闭，启动是 `%SystemRoot%\System32\cmd.exe /c <脚本>` 分离进程（`detached`），**stdout/stderr 写到 `<DSH_HOME>\dsmp\logs\service-<name>.log`**，不再吞掉错误。
- 2026-11-07 修复：宿主（Electron）进程的环境块可能早于用户终端，`PATH` 里未必有 `WindowsPowerShell\v1.0`，脚本里的 `powershell` 会直接报「不是内部或外部命令」。现在 spawn 时显式构造 `PATH`（`C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7` → `%SystemRoot%\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0` → `System32` → `%SystemRoot%` → 原 PATH 去重），并用绝对路径的 `cmd.exe`，所以面板不再依赖宿主 `PATH`。卡片上每个服务多一个「日志」按钮，失败时也会把日志末尾直接显示出来。
- 本机 PowerShell 现状（2026-11-07）：系统自带 `powershell.exe` 仍是 **5.1.26100.9444**；另装了 **PowerShell 7.6.9**（`C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe`，MSI 静默安装）。注意以后台方式跑 `winget install Microsoft.PowerShell` 会失败（`0x80070422`，本机 `wuauserv` 被禁用），MSI 安装不依赖该服务。脚本内的 `powershell` 仍解析到 5.1；要用 7 就把脚本里的 `powershell` 换成 `pwsh`（两版语法在本项目用到的命令上兼容）。
- **10 分钟空闲自动关闭**由 bridge 自己维持（`imageGen.idleStopProcessMs`、`socialV2.tts.idleStopMs` 都是 600000）；面板额外兜底：bridge 不在线时，面板启动的引擎满 10 分钟会被 `services.startIdleWatch` 关掉，避免留下没人用的进程。
- QQ 机器人已在运行时点「启动」不会重复拉起，返回 `already:true`。
- 脚本目录取自 `settings.bridge.dir`（默认 `<DSMP_BRIDGE_DIR>`），换机时改这一项即可。
- **2026-11-07 二次修复：按钮结果以前只看「脚本启动成功」，不看端口**。现在启动会等端口真正监听（bridge 最长 90s、ComfyUI 120s、其它引擎 60s），关闭会等脚本退出（`stop-bot.cmd` 约 10s）再等端口真正关闭，返回里带 `running`；没到位就回 `ok:false` + 日志末尾，不再出现「点了关闭、看着像成功、其实还在跑」。
- 关闭失败的根因在 `stop-bridge.cmd`：它原来只杀「命令行里带 `DSH-QQ-bridge` 路径」的 `cmd.exe`，但监督进程是 `cmd.exe /c start-bridge.cmd`（相对名），匹配不到 → 桥接被杀后 5 秒内被监督进程重新拉起。该脚本已改为「按脚本名匹配 + 连 `start-bot.cmd` 一起杀 + 杀监听 3100 的 pid + 三轮复查」。
- 另一个坑：`state\bridge.lock` 里记的 pid 活着但 3100 没监听（半死桥接）时，新启动会判「已有实例在运行」直接退出。`services.startService` 现在会先 `clearStaleLock()`（杀该 pid 再删锁）。
- **改完 `lib/*.js` 必须完整重启 DSH**：bundle 开关只会重新执行 `apply()`，不会重新 import 模块（ESM 缓存），面板里跑的还是旧代码。改 `lib/client.js` 只需刷新页面。
- **2026-11-07 三次修复：不再刷一屏 PowerShell 窗口**。`start-bot.cmd` 原来分六次调 `powershell`、`stop-bot.cmd` 分四次 `call` 子脚本，每次都会闪一个控制台。现在两个入口各自只起**一个** PowerShell 进程（`scripts\dsmp-boot.ps1` / `scripts\dsmp-halt.ps1`，带 `-WindowStyle Hidden`），子步骤（SnowLuma、bridge）用 `Start-Process -WindowStyle Hidden` 拉起；面板侧的 spawn 也改成非 detached（`CREATE_NO_WINDOW`），整棵进程树共用一个不可见控制台。交互运行 `start-bot.cmd` 仍会打开 SnowLuma WebUI，面板触发时（`DSMP_HEADLESS=1`）不打开浏览器。

| 路由 | 方法 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/api/dsmp/services` | GET | 三个服务的端口探测、脚本存在性、空闲阈值 |
| `/api/dsmp/services?log=qq` | GET | 读该服务脚本日志末尾（最多 20000 字） |
| `/api/dsmp/services` | POST | `{action:'start'|'stop',name:'qq'|'draw'|'tts'}`，失败时回 `error`/`code`/`tail` |

注意：**生成/合成能力本身没有接进面板**。ComfyUI 的出图与 GPT-SoVITS 的合成都走 bridge 的 `send-image` / `tts` 端点，而这些端点在 reserved2 模式下要求 `x-agent-token` 且会把结果直接发到 QQ；面板只做到「开/关引擎 + 状态」，不越权调用。要真正在面板里生成图片/试听语音，需要另开一个不发送、只返回文件的本机端点（属 bridge 侧改动，需主人点头）。

## 历史与工作台（M4）

历史页签不另存聊天记录，每次都从 DSH 的会话日志读：

| 路由 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /api/dsmp/history/sessions?limit=` | 列出 `<DSH_HOME>/sessions/**` 下的会话（首帧取 cwd/预设，按 mtime 倒序） |
| `GET /api/dsmp/history?sessionId=&limit=&before=&q=` | 逐帧解压会话日志还原气泡；`before` 是游标，`q` 是关键字 |

解析要点：日志是**多帧 zstd、每帧一行 JSON**（`zlib.zstdDecompressSync` 只解首帧，所以自己走帧头）；她真正发出去的话在 `mcp__snowluma__qq_send_message` 的 `tool/call` 参数里，同一 turn 里这段一旦出现，就丢掉她没发出去的工作笔记；用户气泡优先取 `【本次消息快照】` 里的原文。

记忆页签：

| 路由 | 视图 |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /api/dsmp/workbench?view=facts` | 长期事实（现存/旧事、槽位、作者、I） |
| `view=topics` | 主题簇与事实数 |
| `view=window&sessionId=&from=&to=&limit=` | 窗口回放（主人原话 / 她说的 / 当时的想法）；`from`/`to` 限定轮次 |
| `view=episodes` | 情境索引（标题 + 场景 + 主题 + 轮次；按 `atTo` 新→旧；每段可「展开原文」跳到窗口回放） |
| `view=usage` | 消费（只统计 `k=turn`，不含 `base` 基线） |
| `view=recall&q=` | 真跑 smart 检索，含空结果诊断 |
| `view=claims` | 待确认纠正（当前为 0） |

情境段在磁盘上是 `episodes/<年-月>.jsonl`，真实行用 `title` / `scene` / `topics` / `atFrom` / `atTo` / `summarized` 描述，没有单独的 `summary` 字段。`episodesView()` 会把 `title：scene` 合成展示摘要、用 `atTo` 排序，并保留对旧 `summary` 行的兼容；只有 `summarized:false` 且没有叙事时面板才显示「（未摘要）」。

**从摘要回到原文**有三条路：① 事实行的 `⟵ 窗口 … 轮 a–b（8 位）` 可以直接交给 `dsmp_memory_window`，会话 id 给 8 位前缀即可；② 注入里的情境段行尾带 `（#ep-xxxxxxxx-nn）`，把它作为 `episodeId` 传给 `dsmp_memory_window`，轮次范围会自动带上；③ 面板「情境索引」每段有「展开原文」，跳到「窗口回放」并只显示那段轮次。月摘要、七天交接、事实卡本身不带锚点，仍需先经 ① / ② 或按日期检索。

| 路由 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /api/dsmp/models` | 列 provider 与模型、当前选择、本插件覆盖值 |
| `POST /api/dsmp/models` | 写 `settings.chat.{provider,model}`，下一轮生效 |
| `GET /api/dsmp/roles?name=` | 列角色卡 + 读某张卡全文（附带 `mirror` 镜像摘要） |
| `POST /api/dsmp/roles` | 保存人设卡（≤30000 字，写前自动备份 `.bak-dsmp-*`），保存后自动同步镜像 |
| `DELETE /api/dsmp/roles?name=` | 删除人设卡（先留 `.bak-dsmp-*` 备份；不能删当前正在用的那张），删除后镜像同步清理 |

### 人设卡镜像（2026-11-07）

人设卡的原件在 bridge 的 `roles\`，插件会把它们复制一份到**记忆目录**里：

```
<DSMP_MEMORY_DIR>\roles\
  ├─ <PERSONA>.md
  ├─ 傲娇助手.md
  ├─ <PERSONA_ALT2>.md
  └─ active.json        { role, source, syncedAt }
```

- 复制规则：只同步 `*.md`，跳过 `README.md`、`.bak-*`、`.tmp-*`；内容相同不重写（幂等）。
- 触发点：插件启动时、面板保存人设卡后、面板删除人设卡后、手动 `POST /api/dsmp/roles/sync`。
- 删除：`DELETE /api/dsmp/roles?name=` 先把原文件复制成 `.bak-dsmp-*`，再删源卡并同步镜像；**当前正在使用的那张不能删**（要先切换）。镜像里对应的副本会在同一次同步中被清掉，返回的 `removed[]` 会列出清了哪些。
- 目的是「记忆目录搬走 = 人设一起搬走」，导出记忆包时 `roles/` 也会跟着进包。
- 只复制、不反向覆盖；源目录被外部（不经面板）删掉的卡，下一次同步时镜像里也会一并清掉。
- 镜像目标固定是 `settings.memoryDir`（生产记忆目录），不受测试期隔离影响——测试隔离只管记忆记录与媒体，人设卡属于配置。

## QQ 通道（M2，只读 + 只入队）

bridge 通过 `x-console-token` 头鉴权（令牌在 `<bridge>\state\console-token`），DSMP 的 `BridgeClient` 只读它的状态与历史：

| 路由 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /api/dsmp/bridge/status` | 令牌是否就绪、当前模式、是否允许真发、outbox 条数 |
| `GET /api/dsmp/bridge/recent?key=&limit=` | 真实会话最近消息（只读） |
| `POST /api/dsmp/bridge/send` | 测试期只把消息写 `outbox.jsonl` 并返回 `dryRun:true`，不发请求 |
| `POST /api/dsmp/inbound` | 入站落盘（`bridge-inbox.jsonl`），供 M2 链路自检 |
| `GET /api/dsmp/inbox` / `GET /api/dsmp/outbox` | 读回入站/出站记录 |

**为什么出站只能是 dry-run**：reserved2 模式下 bridge 的 `/api/socialV2/send-message` 要求 `x-agent-token`（每个会话的 `state/social-v2.json.agentToken`），DSMP 拿不到；真发要等接入阶段，或改成由 bridge 转发。测试期 `test.allowLiveSend = false` 是硬闸门，即使改代码也不会静默发出去。


## 媒体库（M3）

图片与语音共用一个内容寻址仓库，只是分目录：图片进 `<记忆根>\media\YYYY-MM\<sha1>.<ext>` + `state\media.jsonl`，语音进 `<记忆根>\voice\YYYY-MM\<sha1>.<ext>` + `state\voice.jsonl`。同一个文件只存一份（按 sha1 去重），索引每 sha1 只追加一行。

| 路由 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `POST /api/dsmp/media/upload?kind=image\|voice&name=&alt=` | 原始字节上传（≤16MB），按魔数嗅探类型，返回 `sha1` |
| `GET /api/dsmp/media/file?sha1=&kind=` | 取文件；强 ETag（sha1），支持 `If-None-Match`→304 与单区间 `Range`→206（语音拖动播放靠它） |
| `GET /api/dsmp/media/list?kind=&limit=` | 列出最近条目 |
| `POST /api/dsmp/media/attachment` | 把会话里的 `ImageAttachmentRef` 读成字节（面板渲染镜像消息的图，不必把字节塞进事件缓冲） |
| `POST /api/dsmp/voice/send` | 测试期写入 `voice-outbox.jsonl` 并返回 `dryRun:true` |
| `GET /api/dsmp/voice/outbox?limit=` | 读回语音队列 |

要点：
- 服务端不解码图片、不生成缩略图（零依赖）；面板按原图缩到 132px 显示，浏览器缓存靠 `immutable`。
- 语音行保留 `transcript` 字段：1.10.0 起入站语音会先转写再落库（见「听 QQ 语音转文字」）。
- QQ 侧入站语音已接（P1，见下节）：bridge 取字节后转给 `POST /api/dsmp/voice/inbound`，面板语音库直接可播。

## 听 QQ 语音（P1，2026-11-08）

主人在 QQ 发语音 → SnowLuma 给 `record` 段 → bridge 调 `get_record` 拿音频地址（或 `base64://`）→ `safeFetchBuffer` 限 16MB 取字节、校验魔数 → `POST /api/dsmp/voice/inbound` → 语音库 → 面板「语音库」里 `<audio controls>` 播放。

- **面板**：聊天页顶部「语音库」按钮展开，显示最近 5 条（来源、大小、时长、时间），带条数 chip 与「刷新」；QQ 来的标 `QQ`，面板自己生成/上传的标 `本地上传`。
- **接口**：`POST /api/dsmp/voice/inbound`，body `{key,msgId,name,from,duration,data(base64)}`；只接音频（OGG/Opus、WAV、MP3、M4A），超过 `media.maxVoiceBytes`（默认 16MB）或不是音频返回 400 且不落盘；同 sha1 只存一份。
- **桥接侧**：每条消息最多转 2 条语音，20s 超时；取字节/转发失败只写日志，绝不影响她回复文字。
- **语音转写**：1.10.0 起入站语音会先转成文字（见下节）；转写失败仍按 `[语音]` 处理。
- **自检**：`node dev/verify-voice.mjs --base http://127.0.0.1:<GUI 端口>`（生成 0.25s 测试音，验证入库 / 列表 / 取回逐字节一致）。
- **回滚**：删 `voice/inbound` 路由与 `lib/voice-inbound.js`，并去掉 `bridge.js` 里的 `forwardInboundVoice` 调用；已入库语音留着无害。
- **限制**：`get_record` 不可用（账号不支持 / 消息过期 / 网络失败）时面板不会出现这条，只在桥接日志留一行 `[voice] 入站语音取字节失败`。

## 听 QQ 语音转文字（1.10.0，2026-11-10）

QQ 语音是 SILK，本地 ffmpeg 直接解不了；落库前先让 SnowLuma 解码，再交给 DSH 自带的 SenseVoice。模型这一轮看到的是文字，不再是 `[语音]`。

链路：

```
QQ record 段 → bridge 取字节（get_record out_format:'wav'，SnowLuma 内置 SILK 解码）
  → 本机 ffmpeg 归一化 16k/单声道/PCM16 并削掉 LIST 块
  → POST /api/dsmp/voice/transcribe（x-dsmp-internal: bridge）
  → ctx.get('speechToText').transcribe()
  → 语音库存 WAV + transcript，本轮文本变成 "[语音转写] …"
```

- **依赖**：profile 里的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle`（DSH 自带，不是插件依赖）；模型缓存在 `<DSH_HOME>\speech-to-text\sensevoice\`（int8 约 239 MB），`prepare()` 跑过一次后常驻 `standby`。
- **接口**：`POST /api/dsmp/voice/transcribe`，body `{key,msgId,name,from,duration,data(base64 wav)}`；只接受 16k/单声道/PCM16、44 字节标准头、≤4 MB/110 s；同 sha1 已有 transcript 时直接返回（`cached:true`）。
- **配置**（`settings.json` 的 `media.voice.stt`）：`enabled`（默认 true）、`provider`（空=用服务默认）、`language`（`zh`）、`timeoutMs`（20000）、`maxSeconds`（110）、`maxBytes`（4 MB）、`prepareTimeoutMs`（30000）。面板设置页不暴露这些键，改文件后 bundle off/on 或重启 DSH 生效。
- **状态**：`GET /api/dsmp/status` 的 `stt` 字段给出 `{enabled,available,provider,phase,language,error}`；`phase` 为 `standby/ready` 才可立即转写。
- **边界**：转写只进 `voice.jsonl` 的 `transcript` 和本轮 prompt，**不进事实卡、不进抽取**；超时/失败/未加载 provider 时 bridge 回退 `[语音]`，回复不受影响。
- **排障**：桥接日志看 `[voice] 语音转写 …`；失败会打印 `DSMP_STT_*` 码（`TOO_LONG`/`WAVE`/`NOT_READY`/`TIMEOUT`/`UNAVAILABLE`）。`phase=failed` 时删掉 `<DSH_HOME>\speech-to-text\sensevoice\models` 让 bundle 重新下载。
- **回滚**：删 `lib/voice-stt.js`、`voice/transcribe` 路由与 `media.voice.stt` 配置；bridge 侧还原 `segmentsToText`/`handleIncoming`/`toCanonicalWav` 三处。




## 记忆去重与过期降权（1.13.0，2026-11-10）

- **近同义只留一条**：同一主题+槽位下，值归一化全等、长串包含短串（≥8 字）、共享 ≥2 个型号/编号（如 A7R3 + 2470GM）、或字符二元组 Dice ≥ 0.85 的，视为同一件事。她自己写时命中就合并（`ev:'revise'`，保留更完整那句）；抽取器命中记 `skippedDup` 不再叠版本。

- **热重载**：`lib/tools.js`、`lib/workbench/state.js`、`lib/memory-engine.js` 的 vendor 导入带 mtime，bundle 开关即可加载新引擎模块（新路由/入口仍需重启 DSH）。
- **配置**：无需新配置；`memory.selfWrite`、`memory.scoring` 原样生效。

## 迁移 / 记忆包 / 打包（M5）

三个能力都只依赖 Node 内置模块（`zlib`、`fs`、`crypto`），不装外部依赖。

### 1. 迁移向导（记忆目录 + agent 工作区）

`POST /api/dsmp/migrate` 由 Journal 驱动，阶段固定为 `copy → verify → switch → cleanup → done`：

| 请求 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /api/dsmp/migrate` | 读取 `<DSH_HOME>\dsmp\migration\journal.json` |
| `POST {"action":"preflight","sourceDir":…,"targetDir":…}` | 只检查：源存在、目标为空/不存在、互不嵌套、空间 ≥ 源×1.2，并报告 `agent\` 工作区是否存在 |
| `POST {"action":"run",…}` | 逐阶段执行：复制 →（若存在）复制 `agent\` 工作区 → 逐文件 sha256 对账 → 记录 switch → 把源目录改名 `<源>.migrated-<时间戳>` → done |
| `POST {"action":"rollback"}` | 用改名记录把源目录搬回；`deleteTarget:true` 可清掉新目录 |

硬规则：
- **从不删除源目录**，cleanup 只改名，保留 7 天后由人决定是否删。
- 任何阶段失败都停在原地，journal 里留现场；`rollback` 只回滚改名，不动已复制的目标文件。
- 测试期（`test.enabled=true`）拒绝把 `sourceDir` 指到生产记忆目录，直接 403 `DSMP_TEST_ONLY`。

### 2. 记忆包导出 / 校验 / 导入

| 路由 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `POST /api/dsmp/memory/export` `{memoryDir?,name?,includeWorkspace?}` | 生成 `deepseek-memory-<日期>.dsmp.zip` 到 `<DSH_HOME>\dsmp\exports\` |
| `POST /api/dsmp/memory/verify` `{file}` | 校验每个条目的 sha256、缺件与 manifest 之外的额外文件 |
| `POST /api/dsmp/memory/import` `{file,targetDir,overwrite?}` | 先校验再写；只写记忆树（`memory/**`→目标根、`workspace/agent/**`→`agent/`），`sessions|roles|dsmp` 由调用方另行处理 |

包内布局：`manifest.json`（kind、版本、创建时间、来源机器、文件数、字节数、全量 sha256）+ `memory/**` + `workspace/agent/**` + `sessions/<转义目录>/<sessionId>/**` + `roles/*.md` + `dsmp/settings.json`。
跳过 `backup/`、`node_modules/`、`scratch/`、`shadow/`、`.git/`——备份目录不进包。

### 3. 单 tgz 打包

```bash
node scripts/pack.mjs            # → dist/deepseek-memory-partner-<version>.tgz
node scripts/pack.mjs --out <输出目录>\dsmp.tgz
```

- 自写 ustar + gzip，不依赖 npm；包含 `package.json / README.md / CHANGELOG.md / lib / vendor/memory(src) / docs`。
- 不含 `dev/ test/ dist/ backup/ node_modules/`，也不含 `vendor/memory` 的开发文档与脚本。
- **本机绝对路径在打包时替换成占位符**：`<DSMP_MEMORY_DIR>`、`<DSMP_BRIDGE_DIR>`、`<DSH_HOME>`。运行时由 `lib/settings.js` 从同名环境变量展开：

```powershell
$env:DSMP_MEMORY_DIR   = '<DSMP_MEMORY_DIR>'
$env:DSMP_BRIDGE_DIR   = '<DSMP_BRIDGE_DIR>'
$env:DSH_HOME          = '<DSH_HOME>'
```

未设置的占位符会原样保留，面板的状态卡会显示「记忆目录未配置」而不是猜一个路径。

导出：489 条目（memory 482 / sessions 1 / roles 4 / dsmp 1），4,253,424 B

## 一键换机（B1，2026-11-08）

把「记忆目录 + QQ 工作区 + DSH 会话树 + 人设卡 + 插件设置」打成一个 `dsmp-machine-pack` zip，在新机器导入后所有绝对路径自动改写，会话能接着聊。

| 请求 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /api/dsmp/machine` | 本机身份（`machine.json`）、心跳、单机锁、历史 |
| `POST /api/dsmp/machine/export` | 导出：`{name?, memoryDir?, sessionIds?}` → `<DSH_HOME>\dsmp\exports\<name>`；不是记忆写者时 409 |
| `POST /api/dsmp/machine/upload?name=…` | 浏览器上传换机包（原始 zip body，落 `<DSH_HOME>\dsmp\imports\`） |
| `POST /api/dsmp/machine/import` | 导入：`{file, targetDir, machineName?, dryRun?, overwrite?, force?}` |

包内结构（`manifest.json` 记录 `cwd`、`sessionIds`、逐文件 sha256）：

```
memory/**            记忆目录（排除 backup / sessions / node_modules / scratch / shadow）
machine.json         来源机器身份
sessions/<sid>/**    选中的 DSH 会话日志（逐帧 zstd，导入时改 header.cwd）
roles/*.md           人设卡
dsmp/settings.json   插件设置（导入后 memoryDir / liveCwd 改新路径）
```

导入做的事：校验整包 sha256 → 目标非空先备份改名 → 记忆写 `target.importing-<pid>` 再整体 rename → 会话按 `escapeCwd(newCwd)` 落到 `<DSH_HOME>\sessions\…\<sid>\` 并逐帧改写 cwd → `storages/workspace.json` 里指向旧工作区的条目改新路径（`updatedAt` 用 ISO）→ bridge `config.json` 的 `sessionCwd`（若配了 bridge 目录）→ DSMP settings 的 `memoryDir` / `session.liveCwd` → 新 `machine.json` 并把旧 machineId 记进 `state/machine-history.jsonl`；任一步失败删新建目录、把备份改回。

单机锁：每 5 分钟写一次 `state/machine-heartbeat.json`；导入时目标目录 10 分钟内有别的 machineId 心跳 → 409 `DSMP_MACHINE_BUSY`（确认覆盖传 `force:true`）。

面板「设置」页签里的「一键换机」卡片就是这套接口的 UI：导出换机包 → 新机器选包 → 预检（显示旧/新工作区、文件数、目标是否已存在）→ 确认导入。

离线验收：`node dev\verify-b1.mjs --pack <zip>` 在 `%TEMP%` 里做一次完整导入（不碰真实 sessions / workspace.json / bridge），12 项对账。

## 备份与恢复（B2，2026-11-08）

面板「设置」页签里的「备份与恢复」卡片：点「立即备份」生成一份记忆包，列表里每份都能「恢复…」（先预检，再确认）。备份是本地文件，不依赖 QQ / bridge，也不需要停 DSH。

| 请求 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /api/dsmp/backup` | 备份根目录、保留份数、已有备份列表（按时间新→旧） |
| `POST /api/dsmp/backup/now` | `{name?}` → 生成 `<root>\<YYYYMMDD-HHmmss>-<name>.zip`；不是记忆写者时 409 |
| `POST /api/dsmp/backup/restore` | `{file, dryRun?, overwrite?}`；`dryRun` 只校验并回报包内文件数，`overwrite:true` 才替换 |

备份根目录默认 `<DSH_HOME>\dsmp\backups`，可在设置里改 `backup.dir`；`backup.keep`（默认 10）控制只保留最近几份，清理只删最旧的、失败跳过。

一份备份就是一个 `dsmp-memory-pack`：`manifest.json`（来源目录、文件数、逐文件 sha256）+ `memory/**` + 可选 `workspace/agent/**` + `roles/*.md` + `dsmp/settings.json`；`backup/sessions/node_modules/scratch/shadow/.git` 不进包。写盘前先 `verifyArchive` 自检，自检不过直接报错、不留半截文件。

恢复做的事：校验 manifest 与哈希 → 目标非空且没 `overwrite` 就停在预检 → 解到临时目录（只取 `memory/`、`roles/`、`workspace/agent/`，**跳过 `sessions/` 与 `dsmp/settings.json`**）→ 当前记忆目录整体改名 `<memoryDir>.before-restore-<stamp>` → 临时目录 rename 就位；任一步失败删临时、把旧目录改回。旧目录永不删除，回滚就是把它改回来。

> 恢复会改动生产记忆；面板默认先预检，确认按钮上写明「会先把当前记忆目录改名备份」。不是记忆写者（另一个进程持租约）时两条写路由都返回 409 `DSMP_NOT_WRITER`。

离线验收：`node dev\verify-b2.mjs --file <备份.zip> [--base http://127.0.0.1:<GUI 端口>]` 在 `%TEMP%` 里做一次真实恢复与二次拒绝，14 项对账。

## 健壮性：写令牌 / 诊断 / 乐观锁 / 启动自检（D，2026-11-08）

四项都在插件里，不依赖外部服务：

- **写令牌**：启动时生成 `<DSH_HOME>\dsmp\api-token`（32 hex，仅当前用户可读）。所有写路由要求 `x-dsmp-token`，或浏览器同源（`Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin`），bridge 的内部转发用 `x-dsmp-internal: bridge`；其余一律 `403 DSMP_WRITE_FORBIDDEN`。`/api/dsmp/status` 只在同源时回 `writeToken`，所以面板不用自己存令牌。它防的是跨站伪造和误调用，不防同一用户下的本机进程。
- **诊断**：设置页「诊断与自检」折叠卡，数据来自 `GET /api/dsmp/diagnostics`——3100/7351/8188/9880 端口、租约、残留锁、`.exporting`/未完成迁移、6 个日志的尾部 20 行、6 项自检。
- **乐观锁**：`?view=facts|claims|activation|history` 回 `etag`；写请求带 `ifMatch`，对不上回 `409 DSMP_STALE`，面板自动刷新并提示「数据已更新，已刷新」。四类写（claims / fact-edit / fact / activation）都覆盖。
- **启动自检**：`status.selfCheck[]` 六项——记忆目录可写、租约是否本机、bridge 是否在线、残留 panel-lock（超过 5 分钟且进程已死会清）、运行模式（生产模式 / 开发热重载，两种都算通过，只作信息展示）、写令牌就绪。有失败项时面板顶部出黄条，点「重新检查」会调用 `POST /api/dsmp/selfcheck` 真正重跑（`status` 只回启动时那份缓存）。

离线验收：`node dev\verify-d.mjs --base http://127.0.0.1:<GUI 端口>`（15 项，含跨站 403、同源 200、带令牌 200、过期 ifMatch 409）。


## 单写者租约（M6）

默认 `settings.memory.owner = "bridge"`：DSMP **不抢租约**，QQ 侧记忆仍由 bridge 自己写，生产行为与 M5 完全一致。

把 owner 改成 `"dsmp"` 之后：

1. DSMP 在 `<记忆目录>/state/engine-lease.json` 抢租约：`{owner:"dsmp", pid, startedAt, heartbeatAt, ttlMs:60000}`，每 15s 心跳；抢不到就降级只读（不会双写）。
2. bridge 侧（`cfg.memory.owner = "dsmp"` 且租约有效、owner 为 dsmp）不再自己写账本，改为把 `begin-turn` / `note-spoken` / `finish-turn` 转发到 `POST /api/dsmp/memory/*`；转发失败只记日志、**不回落本地写入**（宁可少记一轮，也不允许双写）。
3. 切回 `"bridge"` 或删除租约文件即回滚；DSMP 的写入口在租约失效时一律返回 `409 DSMP_NOT_WRITER`。

路由：

| 方法 | 路径 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/api/dsmp/memory/lease` | 租约摘要（owner / live / mine / 心跳时间） |
| POST | `/api/dsmp/memory/lease` | `{action:"acquire"\|"release"\|"heartbeat"\|"status"}` |
| POST | `/api/dsmp/memory/begin-turn` | bridge 转发：开一轮（key/sessionId/userRaw/windowText/blocks/media/model/mode） |
| POST | `/api/dsmp/memory/note-spoken` | bridge 转发：她真正发出去的一句（tool/text/feels） |
| POST | `/api/dsmp/memory/finish-turn` | bridge 转发：收尾（reply/reason/pressureTokens/contextWindow/incomplete） |
| GET | `/api/dsmp/memory/writer` | 当前写者状态与计数（begun/finished/spoken/skipped/errors） |

> M6 阶段仍按「只测试」执行：默认 owner=bridge，租约只会在测试记忆目录里演练；真实 QQ 回合不会被转发。切到生产需要主人点头后再改 `settings.json` 与 bridge `config.json` 两处 owner。

## 记忆单写者已切到 DSMP（P2，2026-11-07）

本机现状：`memory.owner = "dsmp"` 已生效，生产记忆账本（`window/*/turns.jsonl`）由 DSMP 写，bridge 只转发。

切过去要改三处（缺一不可）：

1. `settings.json`：`memory = { "owner": "dsmp", "leaseTtlMs": 60000, "dir": "<DSMP_MEMORY_DIR>" }` —— `dir` 必须显式写生产记忆目录，否则测试期会落到 `test/memory` 副本。
2. bridge `config.json`：`memory.owner = "dsmp"`，然后重启 bridge。日志出现 `记忆单写者：owner=dsmp，租约=dsmp（有效）` 即生效；若仍是 `owner=bridge`，说明租约文件没被 DSMP 抢到或 owner 没读到。
3. 确认 `/api/dsmp/status` 的 `memory.lease` 是 `{owner:"dsmp", live:true, mine:true}`、`memory.writer.writer === true`。

切换后一轮的完整链路：面板/QQ 消息 → bridge `deliverPrompt` → bridge 调 `POST /api/dsmp/memory/begin-turn` → DSMP 写 `<记忆目录>/window/<sessionId>/turns.jsonl` → `finish-turn` 收尾。账本里的 `userRaw` 只保留主人原话（面板消息的「【来自桌面面板 · 不发 QQ】…」包装会在写入前剥掉）。

回滚（任一步都立刻恢复 bridge 独占）：

```powershell
# 1) DSMP 让出：owner 改回 bridge（下一次心跳会把租约文件删掉）
# 2) bridge 恢复自写：config.json 的 memory.owner 改回 bridge 或直接删掉该键
# 3) 重启 bridge，日志应变回「记忆单写者：owner=bridge，租约=无」
```

边界：切到 DSMP 后，日终派生（情境段 / 事实抽取 / 归档 / 轮转 / 到期提醒）也由 DSMP 跑（A2，见下节），bridge 不再启动自己的维护定时器；两边共用同一个记忆目录，靠租约互斥。

# `dsh-backend-restart`

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A DSH plugin that adds a **Restart backend** row at the end of the **General** settings page, just
above the version information. The action asks the running Host for permission to replace itself and then
relaunches the same command with the same working directory and environment, so the backend comes back on the
same port with the same Harness home. Running turns, terminals, and browser connections are interrupted; the
browser reloads itself once the successor listens again.

The wire format shared by the two halves is frozen in [CONTRACT.md](CONTRACT.md).

## Install

The plugin is a profile bundle, not a workspace package. Install it from this repository's root with the
DSH Plugin Manager, which links the directory into the active profile and records the bundle row:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add link:"$PWD/dsh-backend-restart"
```

In a running GUI session the same step is the `plugin_manager` tool with `action: install_bundle` and
`target: <absolute path to dsh-backend-restart>`; `application: "applied"` means the profile changed
and no restart was needed. The plugin then loads on the next full page load.

Beyond a local checkout, the bundle is distributable without a registry: `npm pack` in this directory
produces a tarball that installs by absolute path (or an `https:` URL), and a clone installs by Git with a
subdirectory selector, because this repository has no root `package.json`:

```sh
npm pack    # -> dsh-<name>-<version>.tgz (local only; nothing is published)
```

```js
plugin_manager({ action: "install_bundle", target: "/abs/path/dsh-<name>-<version>.tgz" })
plugin_manager({ action: "install_bundle", target: "git+https://github.com/jinluchang/deepseek-harness-plugins.git#<commit>&path:/dsh-<name>" })
```

Nothing here is published to an npm registry.

## Use

Open Settings (the account menu at the bottom of the sidebar, then **Settings**), stay on **General**, and
choose **Restart** on the **Restart backend** row that closes the page, immediately above the version line.
Confirm with **Restart**. On Linux web builds there is no keyboard shortcut for Settings; the account menu is
the entry point.

The action stays disabled with a localized note while a restart already owns the process, and it explains
itself when the running process cannot relaunch (an Electron main process, a launcher without swappable
argv, or a launcher that never exits).

## Verify

- Self-check: `node dsh-backend-restart/verify.mjs` parses the manifest and both halves, then asserts
  the channel contract, the refusal rules, the mounted route's trust fence and Connection-shaped envelope
  round-trip (guards, failure results, and handler-failure framing), the supervisor's flags and probes,
  and the spawn-failure classification. Thirteen checks, hermetic: it never restarts anything.
- Syntax and manifest: `node --check dsh-backend-restart/index.js dsh-backend-restart/restart-helper.js
  dsh-backend-restart/verify.mjs` and `node -e "JSON.parse(require('node:fs').readFileSync('dsh-backend-restart/package.json'))"`.
- Supervisor behavior without a Host: the supervisor is a plain ESM module; its exported
  `parseArguments`, `probePort`, `waitForSlot`, `startSuccessor`, and `supervise` are exercised directly by
  passing flags on the command line and reading the exit codes documented in the module header.
- Host half without a browser: the plugin's `apply()` only needs a Cordis context exposing
  `webServer.register`, `webServer.getOrigin`, `connection.admit`, and `appExit`, so a fake
  context drives the mounted route with Connection-shaped envelopes and asserts the `status` and `restart`
  responses, the refusal cases, the trust fence, the request guards, and the launch command it records.
- Full cycle: run an isolated instance with its own `DSH_HOME` on a spare port, mint a browser-session
  cookie from that profile, call `POST /backend-restart/restart`, and watch the pid change across the
  down/up transition.

## Files

| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Host half: the channel, the refusal rules, the launch command, the exit request. |
| `restart-helper.js` | Detached successor supervisor; waits for the slot, starts and settles the new backend. |
| `client.js` | Browser half: the General-settings restart row, the confirmation, and the reload recovery. |
| `locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.json` | Plugin display metadata for the Plugin Manager and Settings inventory. |
| `icon.svg` | Plugin artwork, declared as the manifest `icon` for the Plugin Manager. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch that inserts the plugin row into the profile. |
| `verify.mjs` | Hermetic self-check for the manifest, both halves, and the supervisor. |

## Limitations

- The Host cannot rebind its own port, so a restart is always a process replacement: the recorded launch
  command must be re-runnable, and the successor inherits only the predecessor's terminal, not its
  supervision. A backend started by hand in a shell that exits will not come back.
- The successor inherits the predecessor's environment, including `DSH_HOME`, so an isolated instance stays
  isolated across a restart.
- Two generations must not share one Harness home. The supervisor waits for the predecessor's process death
  observed through the inherited death pipe, and while that pipe is readable the death alone opens the gate,
  so a free port cannot start the successor early. The Host half always passes that pipe. The port-free grace
  is a fallback for a launcher that does not pass it and for one whose pipe fails while it runs: it waits
  6 seconds, longer than the launcher's own 5 second forced-exit bound, and then starts the successor even if
  the predecessor is alive, preferring a short overlap to no successor at all. A predecessor that outlives its
  own forced-exit bound is already abnormal, so the fallback bounds the overlap rather than removing it.

## License

The bundles in this repository are licensed under **GPL-3.0-or-later**. The canonical GNU GPL v3 text
ships with the package as [LICENSE](LICENSE); the "or later" grant lives in the `license` field of
`package.json` and in this notice, not in the unchanged license text.

Copyright (c) 2026 Luchang Jin.

Nothing here is published to an npm registry: installing a bundle means a local checkout, a local
`npm pack` tarball, or a Git URL pointing at this repository.

# deepseek-harness-plugins

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Five standalone DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin bundles.
Each one installs into a DSH host as a profile bundle, carries its own English and Simplified Chinese
README, and ships a hermetic verification suite that runs without a live Host.

| Bundle | What it does | Where it appears | Documentation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dsh-backend-restart` | Adds a **Restart backend** action: asks the Host to replace itself over the `/backend-restart` RPC channel, then reloads the page once the successor answers. | Settings → **General**, in a row above the version line | [English](dsh-backend-restart/README.md) · [中文](dsh-backend-restart/README.zh.md) |
| `dsh-compaction-tuner` | One page that owns the full eleven-key `compaction-basic` policy and pushes the tune into every agent preset in the active profile. | Settings → **Compaction tuner** (last nav row) | [English](dsh-compaction-tuner/README.md) · [中文](dsh-compaction-tuner/README.zh.md) |
| `dsh-lead-agent-only-leads` | Adds the **Lead agent only leads** preset — a Team Lead that delegates every job and never waits on a teammate — plus the host plugin that enforces the tool restrictions. | Session preset picker; Settings → **Lead agent only leads** for the tool toggles | [English](dsh-lead-agent-only-leads/README.md) · [中文](dsh-lead-agent-only-leads/README.zh.md) |
| `dsh-llm-api-call-tuning` | One Settings page that tunes the model-request retry policy of every active provider route — retry mode, max retries, backoff delays, jitter, and retryable failure codes — plus the per-route provider timeouts (stream idle, SDK request, Files API) and the two process-wide HTTP fetch timeouts shared by every provider, web search, and HTTP MCP server. | Settings → **LLM API call tuning** (last nav row) | [English](dsh-llm-api-call-tuning/README.md) · [中文](dsh-llm-api-call-tuning/README.zh.md) |
| `dsh-use-repo-tmp` | Prompt-only guidance that sends scratch files to `<workspace>/tmp` instead of `/tmp`, as one static system-prompt section plus a runtime-context line. | No UI | [English](dsh-use-repo-tmp/README.md) · [中文](dsh-use-repo-tmp/README.zh.md) |

## Requirements

- **DSH `^0.2.2-rc.3`** — declared as `engines.dsh` in every manifest, so a DSH host outside that range
  refuses the install.
- These packages declare no separate Node.js version. Their verification scripts are plain ESM and run
  with the `node` binary you already use for DSH.

## Installation

A bundle is an npm package whose `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch`; installing it adds that patch
layer to the active DSH profile. Three routes work today. Only the path/`link:` route is registry-free: a
tarball or Git install of `dsh-lead-agent-only-leads` also resolves its one declared dependency,
`@deepseek-ai/schemastery@3.19.0`, from the registry, so that route needs a reachable registry, or that
dependency already present on the host.

### From a local checkout (absolute path)

From this repository's root, with the installed DSH CLI on `PATH`:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add link:"$PWD/dsh-backend-restart"
```

From a DSH source checkout instead, run its own script with an absolute bundle path:
`pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add link:/abs/path/to/deepseek-harness-plugins/dsh-backend-restart`.

Or from a running GUI session, with the `plugin_manager` tool:

```js
plugin_manager({ action: "install_bundle", target: "/abs/path/to/deepseek-harness-plugins/dsh-backend-restart" })
```

The installer links the package into the profile and records the bundle row; the plugin loads on the next
full page load.

### From a tarball

`npm pack` inside a bundle directory produces a local tarball that installs by absolute path (or by an
`https:` URL):

```sh
cd dsh-backend-restart
npm pack    # -> dsh-backend-restart-0.2.2-rc.3.tgz
```

```js
plugin_manager({ action: "install_bundle", target: "/abs/path/dsh-backend-restart-0.2.2-rc.3.tgz" })
```

### From Git (subdirectory selector)

There is no root `package.json`, so a bare `github:jinluchang/deepseek-harness-plugins` install cannot
resolve a package. Address one bundle with a `path:` selector instead:

```js
plugin_manager({ action: "install_bundle", target: "git+https://github.com/jinluchang/deepseek-harness-plugins.git#<commit>&path:/dsh-backend-restart" })
```

Pin a commit for `<commit>`; the same spec form works for the other four bundles with their own
`path:/dsh-<name>`.

## Nothing is published to npm

These bundles are **not published**: no version of these packages exists on npm. Their manifests set
`"private": false` and carry publish metadata, so a release is possible later, but nothing has been
published to any registry.

## Notes

- `dsh-compaction-tuner` writes its tune into the profile's preset rows on the first boot; uninstalling it
  does not revert that. See *Install behaviour change* in its [README](dsh-compaction-tuner/README.md).
- The preset added by `dsh-lead-agent-only-leads` is identified from the preset a session currently runs,
  not from its creation header: a session switched or resumed under **Lead agent only leads** is
  constrained without a restart. Installing the bundle itself still needs one Host restart to load its
  patch.

## Verification

Each bundle ships a self-contained `verify.mjs`; no network, no server, and no live Host. Set
`DSH_HARNESS_CHECKOUT` to a DSH source checkout — it is required for a green run: the compaction tuner
fails loudly without it, and the other suites resolve the checkout's libraries through it.

```sh
export DSH_HARNESS_CHECKOUT=/path/to/deepseek-harness

node dsh-backend-restart/verify.mjs          # 13 checks passed
node dsh-compaction-tuner/verify.mjs         # 99 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped (99 checks)
node dsh-lead-agent-only-leads/verify.mjs    # 59/59 checks passed
node dsh-llm-api-call-tuning/verify.mjs      # 164 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped (164 checks)
node dsh-use-repo-tmp/verify.mjs             # 14 checks passed
```

## Repository layout

```text
.
├── LICENSE                     GPL-3.0-or-later
├── THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md      upstream MIT text + provenance
├── dsh-backend-restart/        README.md README.zh.md CONTRACT.md LICENSE verify.mjs package.json …
├── dsh-compaction-tuner/       README.md README.zh.md CONTRACT.md LICENSE verify.mjs package.json …
├── dsh-lead-agent-only-leads/  README.md README.zh.md CONTRACT.md LICENSE verify.mjs package.json …
├── dsh-llm-api-call-tuning/    README.md README.zh.md CONTRACT.md LICENSE verify.mjs package.json …
└── dsh-use-repo-tmp/           README.md README.zh.md CONTRACT.md LICENSE verify.mjs package.json …
```

## License

[LICENSE](LICENSE).

Copyright (c) 2026 Luchang Jin.

[THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md](THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md) records the MIT-licensed DeepSeek Harness plan-mode
prompt text embedded unchanged in `dsh-lead-agent-only-leads/cordis.patch.yml`; that text stays under the
MIT License, and the notice carries its provenance and hashes.

# `dsh-compaction-tuner`

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A DSH plugin that puts **one** control in Settings for the compaction policy of **every agent
preset in the active profile**. A profile usually declares several
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` rows, each with its own `compaction-basic` child; this plugin owns the
**full eleven-key `compaction-basic` policy surface** in its own row, renders it as the **Compaction
tuner** Settings section, and pushes it into every preset row so all of them run the same tune. Today
those values are edited by hand in each preset patch, and forgetting one preset leaves it on different
compaction behaviour.

Every option is documented and rendered with **both** facts the request asks for:

- its **upstream code default** — the value `compaction-basic` itself resolves to when nothing is set
  (`packages/compaction/compaction-basic/src/config.ts`), stated per field in the page and in the
  *Use* table below; and
- its **allowed range** — the load-time asserts it runs (`validatePolicy` `config.ts:277-304`, `assertRatio` `config.ts:358-361`),
  which its own schema does NOT carry: that `Config` declares **no `.max()`** and leaves the two ratio
  nodes bare `z.number()` (`packages/compaction/compaction-basic/src/index.ts:87,89,123,125`); only the
  token/count nodes carry `.min(0)`/`.min(1)` (`index.ts:88,90,93-95`). So the `(0, 1]` ratio bound
  lives solely in `assertRatio`, and the tuner's schema carries its own bounds and its checks mirror
  the asserts.

**Nothing is seeded.** The bundle inserts the tuner row with no stored values, so the tuner's own
defaults **are** the upstream `compaction-basic` code defaults and a fresh install changes no preset on
its own: a preset whose `compaction-basic` child already omits the eleven keys already runs them, and the
first retune pass skips it with no write. The tune changes only when the user edits a value on the page;
see *Initial values* and *Install behaviour change* below.

The wire format shared by the two halves is frozen in [CONTRACT.md](CONTRACT.md).

## Install behaviour change (read before installing)

The tuner owns **every** `compaction-basic` option and projects its stored tune into each preset row at
the first boot. On a fresh install that tune is the upstream code defaults, and a preset that declares a
**different** value for any of these **ten** keys is overwritten, and the result is written into the
profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: uninstalling the plugin does not revert it, and reverting it means
hand-editing the profile. (A preset that already omits the keys is skipped: the install is a no-op for
it. A profile installed before the seed was removed keeps its stored `0.5 / 0.15 / 2` — see *Initial
values*.)

| Key | What the first pass does to a preset that disagrees |
| --- | --- |
| `thresholdRatio` | set to the tuner's value (the code default is `0.8` on a fresh install) |
| `headroomTokens` | set to the tuner's value (`65536` when unset, so `1234 → 65536`) |
| `retainRatio` | written when the tuner is on the ratio form; a stale `retainTokens` is deleted |
| `retainTokens` | written when the tuner is on the token form; a stale `retainRatio` is deleted |
| `summarizationProvider` | set to the tuner's string; `''` clears a preset's local summarizer route (`"local" → ""`) |
| `summarizationModel` | set to the tuner's string, as the other half of the pair |
| `maxTokens` | set to the tuner's resolved cap (`maxTokens ?? headroomTokens`) |
| `compactionRetries` | set to the tuner's value (the code default is `1` on a fresh install) |
| `maxOverflowRetries` | set to the tuner's value (`1` when unset, so a preset's `0` is re-enabled: `0 → 1`) |
| `auto` | set to the tuner's value (`true` when unset, so a manual-only preset is re-enabled: `false → true`) |

`modelPolicies` is the deliberate exception: an **empty** tuner table leaves each preset's own table
untouched (see *Optional fields and the retention XOR* and the page note), so a preset's per-model
overrides are replaced only when the user enters a non-empty table.

The concrete consequences above are fixtures the offline suite pins: `auto: false → true`,
`summarizationProvider: "local" → ""`, `maxOverflowRetries: 0 → 1`, `headroomTokens: 1234 → 65536`, and
a preset's `retainTokens` deleted in favour of the ratio form.

## Install

The plugin is a profile bundle, not a workspace package. Install it from this repository's root with
the DSH Plugin Manager, which links the directory into the active profile and records the bundle row:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add link:"$PWD/dsh-compaction-tuner"
```

In a running GUI session the same step is the `plugin_manager` tool with `action: install_bundle` and
`target: <absolute path to dsh-compaction-tuner>`; `application: "applied"` means the profile changed.
The plugin then loads on the next full page load.

The sibling bundle's README states that a first install needs one Host restart for the client half to
be discovered, and that a `link:`ed client bundle needs a page reload after a rebuild. That reload/HMR
behaviour was **not** re-verified for this plugin (see Limitations).

Beyond a local checkout, the bundle is distributable without a registry: `npm pack` in this directory
produces a tarball that installs by absolute path (or an `https:` URL), and a clone installs by Git with a
subdirectory selector, because this repository has no root `package.json`:

```sh
npm pack    # -> dsh-<name>-<version>.tgz (local only; nothing is published)
```

```js
plugin_manager({ action: "install_bundle", target: "/abs/path/dsh-<name>-<version>.tgz" })
plugin_manager({ action: "install_bundle", target: "git+https://github.com/jinluchang/deepseek-harness-plugins.git#<commit>&path:/dsh-<name>" })
```

Nothing here is published to an npm registry.

## Use

Open Settings (the account menu at the bottom of the sidebar, then **Settings**) and choose
**Compaction tuner**, the last nav row. The page shows one control per owned option, in this order.
The *Accepts* column is the allowed range the Host enforces (or that `compaction-basic` enforces at
load, marked *upstream*); the *Code default* column is the upstream `compaction-basic` resolution
fallback. **That code default is also what this install runs**: the bundle seeds nothing, so the tuner's
stored tune starts at these defaults and the page shows them until a value is edited and saved.

| Option | Meaning | Accepts | Code default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `thresholdRatio` | Share of the context budget at which compaction triggers. | ratio in (0, 1], step 0.01; upstream accepts any finite `(0, 1]` ratio, the tuner schema admits only 0.01-multiples | `0.8` |
| `headroomTokens` | Extra token headroom beyond the routed output reservation before pressure is measured. | integer >= 0 | `65536` |
| `retainRatio` | Share of the message budget kept as the verbatim tail. | ratio in (0, 1], step 0.01; must stay below `thresholdRatio`; mutually exclusive with `retainTokens` | `0.16` |
| `retainTokens` | Absolute verbatim-tail token budget. | integer >= 0; mutually exclusive with `retainRatio`; the resolved value must stay below the target `thresholdTokens` (upstream, capacity-dependent) | unset (the retainRatio default 0.16 governs) |
| `summarizationProvider` | Provider that writes the summary. | any string; must be set together with `summarizationModel` as an empty or non-empty pair | `''` (inherit the routed target) |
| `summarizationModel` | Model that writes the summary. | any string; same pair rule with `summarizationProvider` | `''` (inherit the routed target) |
| `maxTokens` | Provider generation cap for the summarization request. | integer >= 1; when unset it resolves to the effective `headroomTokens` | unset (derives from headroomTokens: 65536) — the TUNER's headroom, or an explicit tuner cap |
| `compactionRetries` | Extra attempts after the first compaction while pressure stays above the threshold. | integer >= 0 | `1` |
| `maxOverflowRetries` | Attempts after a canonical context overflow; `0` disables overflow recovery. | integer >= 0; `0` disables overflow recovery | `1` |
| `modelPolicies` | Exact-target override table (provider/model picker on the page). | array of `{provider, model, ...policy}`; `provider` and `model` non-empty and unique per entry; per-entry policy fields obey the same rules as the top level; per-entry cap obeys the resolved-cap rule | `[]` |
| `auto` | Automatic step-boundary pressure and overflow-recovery listeners. | true or false | `true` |

`modelPolicies` is the one structured option, and the page edits it without any JSON: the **provider**
and **model** selects are populated from the deployment's own model catalog (read through the nested
`ctx.get('remote.session')` namespace, `session.modelCatalog()` — no provider or model id is hardcoded), **Add
override** appends the selected pair, and each override card carries one labelled box for each of the
nine policy keys —

```
thresholdRatio, headroomTokens, retainRatio, retainTokens, summarizationProvider,
summarizationModel, maxTokens, compactionRetries, maxOverflowRetries
```

— so the entry the page submits is exactly

```json
[
  { "provider": "openai", "model": "gpt-5", "thresholdRatio": 0.7 },
  { "provider": "anthropic", "model": "claude-sonnet-4", "retainTokens": 4096, "compactionRetries": 3 }
]
```

Each entry requires a non-empty `provider` and `model`, may carry any of the nine keys above, may not
carry any other key, and may not repeat a `provider`/`model` pair. The picker cannot add a pair that
already has an override (Add disables), and a saved override whose pair is not in the current catalog
stays listed, is marked *not in the current catalog*, and remains editable and removable. An override
whose nine boxes are all empty changes nothing and is **dropped when you save**; if that leaves no
override, the page submits `unset` for `modelPolicies`. The page refuses an out-of-range box
(a fractional token budget, a ratio at or above the threshold, both retention forms in one entry, a
zero resolved cap) with its own localized message, and the Host re-checks all of it before any preset
is written, so an accepted table cannot abort `compaction-basic`'s own load at runtime.

If the deployment does not expose the model catalog, the page says so (and distinguishes "not
available" from "the read failed") while any saved override keeps working; the rest of the page is
unaffected.

Edit any field and choose **Save**. The page validates the draft locally first (an out-of-range ratio,
a retained tail at or above the threshold, both retention forms at once, an out-of-range per-model box,
or a fractional retry count is refused with a localized message and no Host call), then submits
**one op per option** as **one atomic write** with the revision the page last read. A blank *optional*
field (`retainRatio`, `retainTokens`, `maxTokens`) is submitted as an `unset` op — see *Optional fields
and the retention XOR*. **Save** stays disabled while nothing has changed, while a write is in flight,
and when the deployment reports the namespace read-only. A successful save shows **no separate
confirmation line** — the restart-required notice below the Save button is the post-save message. The
stored values are accurate for the tuner's own namespace, but they are **not** a promise that the preset rows of a running profile re-tune — see *Save and reload semantics*. A refusal by the
Host shows a localized alert and the fields re-seed from whatever the Host reports next. If the
deployment does not serve the `compaction-tuner` namespace, the page says so and disables the fields
instead of pretending to write.

### Optional fields and the retention XOR

`retainRatio` and `retainTokens` are **mutually exclusive** upstream (`config.ts:292-294`): setting
both is a load-time error. The tuner expresses that as "exactly one may hold a value":

- **Neither field holds a value** — the tune is in the ratio form with the code default (`DEFAULT_RETAIN_RATIO` `config.ts:23`, `resolveRetention` `config.ts:220-227`), and the page submits `unset retainRatio` plus `unset retainTokens`.
- **The ratio field holds a value** — the tune is in the ratio form; `retainTokens` is unset.
- **The token field holds a value** — the tune is in the token form; `retainRatio` is unset.

`maxTokens` is the third optional field: blank means "derive it from the effective
`headroomTokens`", which is exactly how upstream resolves it. A blank optional field therefore
**must** be written as `unset`, and the tuner's own `Config` deliberately gives these three fields
**no schemastery `.default()`**: a default is materialized into the running config, and a materialized
`retainRatio` next to an explicit `retainTokens` would make the XOR impossible to detect. A
maintainer adding `.default()` to either retention field silently breaks that rule — the offline suite
asserts its absence.

Because the tuner projects exactly one retention form, a preset that declares `retainTokens` of its
own is moved onto the ratio form (and vice versa) unless the tuner's own field selects the other form.
The one key `withTune()` ever deletes from a preset child is that counterpart.

**`modelPolicies` is the fourth optional field, and empty means unmanaged.** While the tuner's own
table is empty (the default), the projection omits the key entirely: every preset keeps its own
per-model overrides, and `retune()` reports those rows in a separate `unmanaged` list so a skip caused
by this rule is not confused with "already in tune". Entering a non-empty table replaces every preset's
table with it. An explicit "clear every preset's table" is deliberately **not** offered — the empty
table already means "no opinion", and adding a second empty meaning would be ambiguous. Removing the
last override card on the page therefore returns to the default "no opinion" state, not to "clear the
presets".

The background-token budget is validated against the safe-integer range at every layer
(`Number.isSafeInteger`), which makes the tuner **narrower than upstream**: `compaction-basic` accepts
`1e21` and silently loses precision on it, while the tuner refuses anything above
`9007199254740991` and any non-decimal input (`0x10` is not `16` here). That is a deliberate refusal of
silent corruption; see Limitations.

### How `maxTokens` is derived, and which headroom decides it

`maxTokens` is projected as the **tuner row's** `maxTokens ?? headroomTokens` — upstream's own
resolution order (`config.maxTokens ?? headroomTokens` `config.ts:76`), but applied to the tuner's
values, not the preset's. The precise
consequences for a preset whose child omits `maxTokens`:

- the child's resolved cap is preserved when its own `headroomTokens` equals the tuner's (the common
  case, and always the case when the child omitted both);
- when the child's `headroomTokens` differs, the **tuner's** headroom decides the projected cap, and
  the child's old cap is not preserved. A child with `headroomTokens: 1800` under a tuner headroom of
  `65536` is projected `maxTokens: 65536`.

The tuner does not read the child's headroom when deriving the cap. That is the documented projection
rule, not an accident; changing it would be a change to what "one tune for every preset" means.

**After saving, restart the backend.** A saved tune reaches the agent presets at the next DSH backend
start; propagation from the running Host does not work in measured runs (see *Save and reload
semantics*). The page states this in bold — *"Saving stores the values, but they reach the agent presets
only after the DSH backend restarts."* (zh: *"保存只会存下这些值，它们只有在 DSH 后端重启后才会应用到各 Agent
预设。"*) — and offers a **Restart backend** action beside it, or restart DSH yourself.

## Restart action

The page renders the bold restart-required notice in **every** state, and a **Restart backend** action
when the backend reports that it can restart itself. Choosing it opens an inline confirmation (never a
native dialog); confirming interrupts running turns, terminals, and open connections, and the page
reloads itself once the successor answers. If the successor does not answer inside the recovery budget
(20 s for the old listener to disappear, then 60 s for the successor), the page offers a manual
**Reload page** instead of leaving a dead tab. Unmounting the section aborts a restart already crossing
the wire.

The action calls the existing authenticated Connection channel `/backend-restart`, owned by the separate
`dsh-backend-restart` plugin — so this is a **soft runtime dependency, not a required one**:
nothing is imported from that package, this plugin loads and its page works without it, and when the
channel is absent, refuses, or reports `restartable:false`, the page degrades to localized
manual-restart copy ("This deployment cannot restart itself from here. Restart DSH yourself to apply the
saved values."). A per-code refusal (`busy`, `unsupported`, `spawn-failed`, anything else) is shown as
localized copy; the diagnostic `message` from the channel is never rendered. A **transport rejection** is
treated as possibly restarting, because the backend may exit before its reply arrives — the same rule
`dsh-backend-restart/CONTRACT.md` sets for its own client.

The full client contract is frozen in [CONTRACT.md](CONTRACT.md).

## Initial values

The bundle's mount patch seeds **nothing**: it inserts the tuner row with no `config`, so the tuner's
own defaults are the upstream `compaction-basic` code defaults (`DEFAULT_THRESHOLD_RATIO` `config.ts:20`, `DEFAULT_RETAIN_RATIO` `config.ts:23`, `compactionRetries` `config.ts:105`), recorded once in `index.js` `OPTION_SPECS` and documented with their ranges in the *Use* table above. De-seeding was a
deliberate change: the request was to use the system defaults rather than an install-time choice.

They were never carried over from a shipped preset patch. An earlier revision of this file claimed
`packages/bundle/web-app/presets/standard.patch.yml` committed those numbers; that was false. The
standard preset declares its `compaction-basic` child with **no** config of its own
(`compaction-basic` `standard.patch.yml:79-80`), and a grep of every `*.yml`/`*.yaml` in the checkout finds no preset or
bundle row that sets any **compaction-basic** option — only snapshot fixtures under `snapshots/` set
them. (The sibling pruner's `thresholdChars` / `headChars` / `tailChars` **are** set by shipped
presets, e.g. `tailChars` `standard.patch.yml:85-88`; this tuner does not touch that plugin.)

The consequence is a real behaviour statement, not a formality: because `retune()` reads this row's
live values and `withTune()` projects them into every preset's `compaction-basic` child, a preset that
declares none of these keys is already in tune and is **skipped with no write**. A preset that declares
a different value for one of the ten always-projected keys is still overwritten with the tuner's value
(the code default on a fresh install); see *Install behaviour change*.

Comparison is **whole-projection, not per-key**: `sameTune()` compares every key the tune manages, and
a pass writes nothing only when all of them already match. When any one differs, `withTune()` writes
the entire projected set — including keys whose value already equals the default — so a preset with one
stale key gets all ten rewritten (with equal values for the rest).

The page states that rule: each field shows its upstream code default beside its description, and the
note above the fields says the bundle seeds nothing, so those defaults are what a fresh install runs
until a value is edited. `retainRatio` carries **no** schema default — so "unset" stays expressible for
the retention XOR — and its empty input shows the effective code default `0.16` as a placeholder.

**No automatic migration.** A profile that installed an earlier revision of this bundle stored
`thresholdRatio: 0.5`, `retainRatio: 0.15`, `compactionRetries: 2` in its own `cordis.patch.yml` (or a
`--patch` overlay), and already-projected preset children hold those values. Removing the seed does not
rewrite either: the stored row keeps its values and the tuner keeps projecting them, so such a profile
only moves onto the system defaults when the user clears it — uninstalling does not revert the written
profile patch either, and nothing runs on boot.

### Reset to system defaults (the explicit, manual route)

The page has a secondary **Reset to system defaults** action next to **Save** (same enabled/disabled
rule as Save: not ready or not writable, or a write in flight). Choosing it:

1. replaces the whole draft with the **unset** state — every one of the eleven managed fields blank and
   the per-model override table empty — and **writes nothing**;
2. lets the user review it, then **Save** issues the same one atomic mutate, now with an `unset` op for
   **all eleven** managed keys. That is the part that matters: the page otherwise always sets the eight
   materialized code defaults, and those explicit values are exactly what keeps an old row alive. The
   settings layer resolves each `unset` against the `inherited` layer and applies either the deletion
   or a set of the inherited value (`packages/settings/settings/src/index.ts:372-373`); when the
   resulting config deep-equals that inherited layer, the config editor removes the row's `config` from
   the profile patch — and deletes the row itself when only `id`/`name` remain (the `next` it derives at
   `packages/boot/config-editor/src/index.ts:98-99,119-125`). With this bundle's seedless mount patch
   the inherited config is `{}`, so a reset leaves no explicit override at all;
3. the retune pass then resolves the code defaults (`liveTune` on an empty row) and rewrites every
   preset child it manages that still holds other values — this is what moves the stale
   `0.5 / 0.15 / 2` children onto `0.8 / 0.16 / 1`. It still writes explicit code-default keys, so the
   profile patch is **not pristine**: the behaviour becomes the defaults; the file is not emptied.

**Adoption point.** The save itself does not reliably propagate to the preset rows live (see *Save and
reload semantics*); the reliable adoption point is the next boot/recompose. The retune pass **is**
scheduled by the save — the plugin listens to the form's `loader/volatile-update` and to
`app-boot/config-reload` — so the Reset action is not cosmetic; what is unreliable in measured runs is
the live delivery to the preset rows, not the scheduling. HMR watches only the profile
patch, the home patch and the profile `package.json` (`packages/boot/hmr/src/index.ts:384-385,406-407`), so
bundle-code changes are re-read only on a recompose. After pressing Reset and Save, restart the backend
(the page's **Restart backend** action, or your own restart).

**Back up first.** The profile patch is outside version control and has no automatic backup, and the
reset is irreversible from the UI: copy `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` before pressing it.
The action is deliberately explicit and manual — there is **no** automatic migration and no heuristic
that guesses whether stored values were the old seed or a deliberate choice.

The other three shipped presets (`ptc`, `minimal`, `cordis`) commit no compaction config, so the first
pass is a **no-op** for them: their `compaction-basic` children already omit the eleven keys, which is
exactly the tuner's own state on a fresh install. That is the point of the plugin — one tune for every
preset — and with the seed gone the install itself no longer moves them.

## Scope

- Every declaration row in the active profile whose plugin name is `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset`
  **and** which already has a `compaction-basic` child. This includes presets another bundle adds;
  the tuner matches by plugin name, never by a hardcoded preset id.
- The tuner pushes values into an existing child and **never inserts rows into a preset**. A preset
  without a `compaction-basic` child is out of scope: it is skipped, with no write and no warning.
- Not a per-preset knob, not a change to any other profile, and not a global setting.

The isolated boot runs confirm the name-based match end to end: a `--patch` overlay was propagated in
one boot pass to five preset rows, including a third-party bundle's `preset-lead-agent-only-leads`.

## Save and reload semantics

**The save persists; the presets do not follow it live.** On an isolated instance with a real
`POST /api/settings/mutate`, the write succeeds (`ok:true`, `applies:"live"`), the new values persist
into the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, and the tuner's own namespace reports them (`autoGenerate:false`
also confirms the auto-form suppression works). But propagation from that save to the preset rows does
not work in measured runs: an earlier loose run saw 2 of 5 identical saves propagate, the retry-only
build propagated **0 of 1** measured rounds, and the candidate-walk build propagated **0 of 1**. In the
failing round the plugin's own timestamps (`Date.now()`, plus a `SAVE_SEEN` line emitted from the
`app-boot/config-reload` listener) recorded **16 empty passes in the 30 s after the save, each
returning the production `{"changed":[],"skipped":[]}`**, and every empty result was followed within
**0–1 ms** by
a probe reporting the editor view at **214 rows containing 5 rows named exactly
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset`** — the exact predicate the retune loop filters on, with `undef=0` and
no duplicate ids. The loop's own view and the probe disagree about rows that are demonstrably present,
so the failure is **downstream of editor selection and of the retry**, the cause is unidentified, and
**the plugin cannot address this from its side**. **Edit the values, then restart the backend** — the
page's **Restart backend** action, or your own restart: the save persists, and preset propagation is
reliably effective at the next boot only. `applies:"live"` describes
the settings write, not the presets.

**Both plugin-side defences are shipped, and neither is a fix.** A pass first walks every candidate
configuration editor it can resolve (`configEditorsOf()`, deduplicated by identity) and stops at the
first result that finds anything; if every candidate is empty it retries on the bounded, exported
`RETUNE_BACKOFF = [250, 1000, 3000, 10000]` ms (exported from `index.js`), resetting as soon as a pass sees an
addressable row or a definitive refusal, warning exactly once after the last attempt, and clearing both
timers on disposal. The retry was armed throughout the measured failure and the failure persisted
regardless; the candidate walk changed nothing either. No pre-fix baseline contrast was measured (arm B
never ran), so neither defence is claimed to have moved the rate in either direction.

Two gaps stay recorded rather than papered over: arm B (the pre-fix baseline) was never measured, and in
that round four passes returned a non-empty result while nothing reached the patch, with no breakdown
captured of whether they were `skipped`-only or refusals.

**Boot-time propagation is reliable and idempotent.** At boot the tuner wrote the differing preset rows
in one pass (~262 ms after app-ready); a second boot produced a byte-identical patch; and a `--patch`
overlay propagated to five preset rows, including a third-party bundle's preset, with removing the
overlay restoring the exact earlier patch hash.

New sessions get the new tune once the values have reached the preset rows; **sessions already running
keep the retired revision**, because `compaction-basic` resolves its policy once when a preset mounts and
there is no runtime override path for a preset that is already running.

A retune pass is triggered by the tuner row's **own** volatile commits, by the profile-reconcile
completion signal (`app-boot/config-reload`), and by a preset row activating later. Because
`loader/volatile-update` is dispatched to the owning fiber only, editing a preset row directly on its own
Settings page does **not** retune it; that row is retuned only when it remounts or when the tuner's
values change again.

## Maintenance cost

A patch replaces a row's **whole** config (`overrides` `vendor/include/src/patch.ts:63-105`) and preset children
are not addressable, so the tuner must restate each preset's entire `plugins` list in the replacement
config. Any later upstream edit to a shipped preset is silently hidden behind that restatement until the
preset row is reset. Treat the tuner's copies as a fork of the preset patches and run the drift check
after any upstream update: diff the tuner's restated `plugins` list against the shipped preset rows.
This is the dominant cost of the chosen mechanism; a smaller core seam (an addressable preset child, or
a compaction policy read from a service rather than a row) would remove it.

## Verify

```sh
DSH_HARNESS_CHECKOUT=/path/to/deepseek-harness node dsh-compaction-tuner/verify.mjs
```

Run from this repository's root (or inside the plugin directory with the same variable exported). The
suite is hermetic — `node:assert/strict`, fake Context doubles, no network, no server — and resolves
the **real** schemastery through `$DSH_HARNESS_CHECKOUT`, so set that variable or the schema checks
cannot run.

**Observed run — green, and still a regression gate.** With the per-model picker and the Reset action
in place, the command above printed `97 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped (97 checks)` and exited `0` (about
280 ms wall in my measurement, including Node startup). Two consecutive runs in one shell call produced
byte-identical output. The suite grew from 71 to 97 checks: the rewritten and new ones pin the option
table (`Config.dict` is exactly the eleven keys, every field `.volatile()`, the three optional keys
carry no `.default()`), `DEFAULT_TUNE` against the upstream literals, `TUNE_OPTIONS` metadata, the
projection (`maxTokens` derived as `maxTokens ?? headroomTokens`, exactly one rete
